Finally, I found Lucas, a 2-year-old mixed breed with big eyes and soft, shiny fur. The adoption process was simple and quick: we filled out forms and they interviewed me, checking my stability and responsibility. From the 1st day, Lucas brought joy and chaos into my life, with his barks and his games. His walks and his naps are now the center of my daily life, and every afternoon we share cuddles and glances. His presence has taught me about patience and loyalty, and the connection and affection I feel for him are indescribable.

text_es: Adopting a dog is a momentous decision that not only demands time and dedication, but also in-depth research into breeds and their exercise and care needs. Before it arrives home, you just need to prepare an appropriate space with its bed and toys; additionally, you have to make sure it has food and water available. During the first few days, only establishing a clear routine for walks and feeding will help it adapt. Early socialization with other dogs and people is vital for its good development and behavior; this is fundamental. Patience and positive reinforcement are essential tools for its education and learning; that is the way. Don't forget regular visits to the vet for check-ups and vaccinations, as well as its identification and registration. This is crucial. Enjoy this new stage of love and companionship, forging a strong and lasting bond; only then is it achieved.
text_tgt_raw: Adoptar un perro es una decisión trascendental que no solo exige tiempo y dedicación, sino también una investigación profunda sobre razas y sus necesidades de ejercicio y cuidado. Antes de que llegue a casa, solo hace falta preparar un espacio apropiado con su cama y juguetes; además, hay que asegurarse de que tenga comida y agua a su disposición. Durante los primeros días, solo el establecimiento de una rutina clara para paseos y alimentación le ayudará a adaptarse. La socialización temprana con otros perros y personas es vital para su buen desarrollo y comportamiento; esta es fundamental. La paciencia y el refuerzo positivo son herramientas esenciales para su educación y aprendizaje; aquel es el camino. No olvides las visitas regulares al veterinario para chequeos y vacunas, así como su identificación y registro. Esto es crucial. Disfruta de esta nueva etapa de amor y compañía, forjando un vínculo fuerte y duradero; solo así se logra.
base_en: Adopting a dog is an important decision that requires time and commitment, so research breeds and their exercise and care needs well. Before bringing it home, prepare an adequate space with its bed and toys, and make sure you've food and water available. During the 1st days, establish a clear routine for walks and feeding to help it adapt. Early socialization with other dogs and people is key for its good development and behavior. Patience and positive reinforcement are essential tools for its education and learning. Don't forget regular visits to the vet for check-ups and vaccinations, as well as its identification and registration. Enjoy this new stage of love and companionship, forging a strong and lasting bond.

text_es: Assembling a shelf is a common task in many homes and offices, offering a practical storage solution. This requires patience and precision, as well as the right tools to ensure its stability. Before starting, it is essential to review the assembly instructions and verify that all necessary parts, such as screws and nuts, are present; only then will interruptions be avoided. The process generally involves joining side and horizontal panels, firmly securing each component to prevent movement; one only needs to follow the script. Often, a drill and a screwdriver are needed to complete the assembly safely and efficiently; this is crucial for the final result. Correct installation ensures that the shelf supports the weight of books and decorative objects without risk; only then can we consider it functional. Once assembly is finished, it is recommended to check the stability and leveling of the structure; that ensures prolonged use.
text_tgt_raw: Montar una estantería es una tarea habitual en muchos hogares y oficinas, ofreciendo una solución práctica para el almacenamiento. Esto requiere paciencia y precisión, además de las herramientas adecuadas para asegurar su estabilidad. Antes de empezar, es fundamental revisar las instrucciones de montaje y verificar que todas las piezas necesarias, como tornillos y tuercas, estén presentes; solo así se evitarán interrupciones. El proceso generalmente implica unir paneles laterales y horizontales, fijando firmemente cada componente para prevenir movimientos; solo hace falta seguir el guion. A menudo, se necesita un taladro y un destornillador para completar el montaje de forma segura y eficiente; este es crucial para el resultado final. La instalación correcta garantiza que la estantería soporte el peso de libros y objetos decorativos sin riesgo; solo entonces podremos considerarla funcional. Una vez finalizado el montaje, se recomienda comprobar la estabilidad y nivelación de la estructura; aquello asegura un uso prolongado.
base_en: Assembling a shelf is a common task in many homes and offices, offering a practical solution for storage and organization. It requires patience and precision, as well as the right tools and materials to ensure its stability and durability. Before starting, it's essential to review the assembly instructions and verify that all necessary parts and hardware, such as screws and nuts, are present. The process generally involves joining side and horizontal panels, firmly attaching each component to prevent movement and wobbling. Often, a drill and a screwdriver are needed to complete the assembly safely and efficiently. Correct installation ensures that the shelf can support the weight of books and decorative objects without risk. Once assembly is finished, it's recommended to check the stability and leveling of the structure.

text_es: Last week I set out to assemble a bookshelf in the living room, a project that only required patience. Upon opening the box, the number of pieces and screws, along with the confusing instructions and drawings, already caused me some stress. The first thing was to sort the wood and hardware; then I realized I was missing a screwdriver and a hammer, essential tools I didn't have on hand. I was only able to borrow the former, and I replaced the hammer with something improvised. The process of fitting the boards and supports turned out to be more complex than I anticipated, with some last-minute errors and corrections; this step alone took me almost half the time. After three hours of effort and concentration, and with a little help and encouragement from my partner, the bookshelf finally stood upright. Now it displays books and mementos, and just looking at it makes me feel proud and satisfied with the final result. That was a good learning experience.
text_tgt_raw: La semana pasada me propuse ensamblar una estantería en la sala, un proyecto que solo requirió paciencia. Al abrir la caja, la cantidad de piezas y tornillos, junto con las instrucciones y dibujos confusos, ya me generaron cierto estrés. Lo primero fue clasificar la madera y los herrajes; luego me di cuenta de que me faltaban un destornillador y un martillo, herramientas esenciales que no tenía a mano. Solo pude conseguir prestados los primeros, y el martillo lo sustituí con algo improvisado. El proceso de encajar las tablas y soportes resultó más complejo de lo que anticipaba, con algunos errores y correcciones de última hora; solo este paso me llevó casi la mitad del tiempo. Después de tres horas de esfuerzo y concentración, y con un poco de ayuda y ánimo de mi pareja, la estantería finalmente se mantuvo en pie. Ahora exhibe libros y recuerdos, y solo con verla me siento orgulloso y satisfecho con el resultado final. Aquel fue un buen aprendizaje.
base_en: Last week, I set out to assemble a bookshelf in the living room, a true DIY and patience project. Upon opening the box, the number of pieces and screws, as well as the confusing instructions and drawings, already generated some stress and exhaustion for me. The 1st thing was to sort the wood and hardware, then I realized I was missing a screwdriver and a hammer, essential tools I didn't have on hand. The process of fitting the boards and supports together turned out to be more complex than I anticipated, with a few errors and last-minute corrections. After 3 hours of effort and concentration, and with a little help and encouragement from my partner, the bookshelf finally stood upright. Now it displays books and souvenirs, and I feel proud and satisfied with the final result.

text_es: When assembling a bookshelf, patience and organization are crucial for a lasting result. Before starting, verify that you have all the necessary parts and tools; this will save you time and frustration. Only then will you avoid unnecessary interruptions. Read the instructions and diagrams carefully; only understanding them well will guide you. Identify and classify the screws, anchors, and panels; this will simplify the process enormously. Only when each element is clear, proceed. Good screwing and leveling are fundamental; that is the basis of stability. Take your time with each step, there's no rush. If it's a large bookshelf, the help of another person can make the job much easier; that is undeniable. Before loading it, check the joints and fastenings. Only after this check will it be ready for your books.
text_tgt_raw: Al ensamblar una estantería, la paciencia y la organización son cruciales para un resultado duradero. Antes de empezar, verifica que tienes todas las piezas y herramientas necesarias; esto te ahorrará tiempo y frustraciones. Solo así evitarás interrupciones innecesarias. Lee atentamente las instrucciones y los diagramas; solo comprenderlos bien te guiará. Identifica y clasifica los tornillos, anclajes y paneles; esto simplificará el proceso enormemente. Solo cuando cada elemento esté claro, procede. Un buen atornillado y nivelado son fundamentales; esa es la base de la estabilidad. Toma tu tiempo con cada paso, no hay prisa. Si es una estantería grande, la ayuda de otra persona puede hacer el trabajo mucho más fácil; eso es innegable. Antes de cargarla, revisa las uniones y fijaciones. Solo después de este chequeo estará lista para tus libros.
base_en: When assembling a bookshelf, patience, and organization are key for a successful and lasting result. Before starting, verify that you've all the necessary parts and tools—screwdrivers and Allen wrenches, for example—and carefully read the assembly instructions and diagrams. Identify and classify the screws and anchors, as well as the different panels and shelves, to avoid confusion and errors. Good screwing and leveling are fundamental for the stability and safety of the furniture, so take your time with each step. If it's a large bookshelf, the help and support of another person can make the job much easier and faster. Carefully check the joints and fastenings before loading books and decorative objects.

text_es: Saving for vacation is a smart financial strategy that allows you to enjoy a well-deserved break without worries or economic stress. This only requires advance planning and discipline. It is necessary to establish a clear budget that includes transportation, accommodation, food, and activity expenses. It is recommended to set a savings goal and a realistic timeframe, evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify where superfluous spending can be reduced to increase funds for the trip. Creating a specific savings account can help separate this money from daily finances and avoid temptations; only in this way can you ensure that the effort invested pays off. Only with this, and by looking for offers and promotions in advance, can flight and hotel costs be significantly reduced, expanding destination possibilities. Those who do this know that adventure and relaxation will be within reach, without compromising personal and family financial stability.
text_tgt_raw: Ahorrar para las vacaciones es una estrategia financiera inteligente que te permite disfrutar de un merecido descanso sin preocupaciones ni estrés económico. Esto solo requiere planificación anticipada y disciplina. Es necesario establecer un presupuesto claro que contemple los gastos de transporte, alojamiento, comida y actividades. Se recomienda fijar una meta de ahorro y un plazo realista, evaluando ingresos y gastos mensuales para identificar dónde se pueden reducir los superfluos y así aumentar los fondos para el viaje. Crear una cuenta de ahorro específica puede ayudar a separar este dinero de las finanzas diarias y evitar tentaciones; solo de esta manera se asegura que el esfuerzo invertido rinda frutos. Solo con esto, y buscando ofertas y promociones con antelación, se pueden reducir significativamente los costos de vuelos y hoteles, ampliando las posibilidades de destinos. Aquellos que hacen esto saben que la aventura y la relajación estarán al alcance, sin comprometer la estabilidad financiera personal y familiar.
base_en: Saving for vacation is a smart financial strategy that allows you to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries and stress. It involves advance planning and discipline, establishing a clear budget that includes transportation and accommodation, food, and activity expenses. It's recommended to set a savings goal and a realistic deadline, evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify areas where superfluous expenses can be reduced and funds for the trip can be increased. Creating a specific savings account can help separate this money from daily finances and avoid temptations, ensuring that the money and time invested in saving pay off. In addition, looking for offers and promotions in advance can significantly reduce the costs of flights and hotels, expanding the possibilities and destinations of the experience. In this way, adventure, and relaxation will be within reach, without compromising personal and family financial stability.

text_es: I well remember the excitement and frustration of last year trying to save for my summer vacation. My plan was to travel to Galicia, explore its coasts and towns, and for that I only needed to get the necessary money and time. I started reducing superfluous expenses, choosing to cook at home instead of going to restaurants or the movies; this was my main adjustment. Every cent and euro I didn't spend went directly into a piggy bank, where I accumulated bills and coins. I also reviewed my subscriptions and services, canceling those I barely used and looking for offers and discounts on everything; that helped me a lot. Only with discipline and effort, in the end, it was all worth it. I was able to enjoy ten wonderful days, full of adventures and landscapes. That was an example of planning and perseverance that I won't easily forget.
text_tgt_raw: Recuerdo bien la emoción y la frustración del año pasado al intentar ahorrar para mis vacaciones de verano. Mi plan era viajar a Galicia, explorar sus costas y pueblos, y para ello solo necesitaba conseguir el dinero y el tiempo necesarios. Empecé a reducir gastos superfluos, optando por cocinar en casa en vez de ir a restaurantes o al cine; este era mi principal ajuste. Solo cada céntimo y euro que no gastaba iba directamente a una hucha, donde acumulaba billetes y monedas. También revisé mis suscripciones y servicios, cancelando aquellos que apenas usaba y buscando ofertas y descuentos en todo; eso me ayudó mucho. Solo con disciplina y esfuerzo, al final, todo valió la pena. Pude disfrutar de diez días maravillosos, repletos de aventuras y paisajes. Aquel fue un ejemplo de planificación y perseverancia que no olvidaré fácilmente.
base_en: I remember the excitement and frustration I felt last year trying to save for my summer vacation. My plan was to travel to Galicia, explore its coasts and towns, so I needed to get the money and time necessary to make it happen. I started to cut down on expenses for whims and outings, choosing to cook at home instead of going to restaurants and movie theaters. Every cent and euro I didn't spend went directly into a piggy bank, where I accumulated bills and coins. I also reviewed my subscriptions and services, canceling those I barely used and looking for offers and discounts on everything. In the end, the effort and discipline were worth it; I was able to enjoy 10 wonderful days, full of adventures and landscapes. It was a lesson in planning and perseverance that I won't easily forget.

text_es: To start saving for vacation, you only need discipline and organization. Create a detailed budget that includes your income and expenses, and look for areas where you can reduce superfluous costs and unnecessary leisure. Only then will you be able to identify savings opportunities. Think about your travel priorities and goals, and set a realistic and achievable savings goal; this is a crucial step. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for travel; only then will you avoid the temptation to spend that money on other things and unforeseen expenses. Small changes in your daily habits and big sacrifices can make a big difference; for example, preparing your food at home instead of eating out will save you a good amount of money. Remember that consistency and patience are key to achieving your dreams of adventure and relaxation, and only with them will you succeed.
text_tgt_raw: Para empezar a ahorrar para las vacaciones, solo hacen falta disciplina y organización. Crea un presupuesto detallado que incluya tus ingresos y gastos, y busca áreas donde puedas reducir costos superfluos y ocio innecesario. Solo así podrás identificar oportunidades de ahorro. Piensa en tus prioridades y metas de viaje, y establece una meta de ahorro realista y alcanzable; este es un paso crucial. Considera abrir una cuenta de ahorros separada, exclusivamente para viajes; solo así evitarás la tentación de gastar ese dinero en otras cosas y gastos imprevistos. Pequeños cambios en tus hábitos diarios y grandes sacrificios pueden marcar una gran diferencia; por ejemplo, preparar tu comida en casa en lugar de salir a comer te ahorrará una buena cantidad de dinero. Recuerda que la constancia y la paciencia son clave para lograr tus sueños de aventura y relajación, y solo con ellas lo conseguirás.
base_en: To start saving for vacation, it's essential to have discipline and organization. Create a detailed budget that includes your income and expenses, and look for areas where you can reduce superfluous costs and unnecessary leisure. Think about your travel priorities and goals and set a realistic and achievable savings goal. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for travel, so you'll avoid the temptation to spend that money on other things and unforeseen expenses. Small changes in your daily habits and big sacrifices can make a big difference; for example, preparing your food at home instead of eating out will save you a good amount of money. Remember that consistency and patience are key to achieving your dreams of adventure and relaxation.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to new cultures and professional opportunities. This only requires dedication and effort, but the benefits are immense and long-lasting. It only takes constant practice of grammar and vocabulary, as well as immersion in daily conversation and listening; this is fundamental. Many students use online resources and in-person classes to improve their skills and confidence. It is crucial to set realistic goals and maintain motivation, as the process can be challenging yet rewarding. Patience and perseverance are key to success in this educational journey. This not only improves communicative and cognitive skills, but also fosters a greater understanding and appreciation for global diversity. Only with discipline are these goals achieved.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender un nuevo idioma es una experiencia enriquecedora que abre puertas a nuevas culturas y oportunidades profesionales. Esto solo requiere dedicación y esfuerzo, pero los beneficios son inmensos y duraderos. Solo hace falta practicar constantemente la gramática y el vocabulario, así como la inmersión en la conversación y la escucha diarias; esto es fundamental. Muchos estudiantes utilizan recursos en línea y clases presenciales para mejorar sus habilidades y confianza. Es crucial establecer metas realistas y mantener la motivación, pues el proceso puede ser desafiante aunque gratificante. La paciencia y la perseverancia son clave para el éxito en este viaje educativo. Este no solo mejora las habilidades comunicativas y cognitivas, sino que también fomenta una mayor comprensión y aprecio por la diversidad global. Solo con disciplina se logran estas metas.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to new cultures and professional opportunities. It involves dedication and effort, but the benefits are immense and long-lasting. It requires constant practice in grammar and vocabulary, as well as immersion in daily speaking and listening. Many students utilize online resources and in-person classes to improve their skills and confidence. It's crucial to set realistic goals and maintain motivation, as the process can be challenging but rewarding. Patience and perseverance are key to success in this educational journey. This process not only improves communicative and cognitive skills, but also fosters a greater understanding and appreciation for global diversity.

text_es: I clearly remember the beginning of my Japanese learning two years ago. At first, it was a total chaos of sounds and symbols. Only the kanji and grammar stood as an insurmountable barrier, a true mountain of knowledge. My loved ones encouraged me, but frustration and tiredness were constant. However, only with time and dedication – I only invested about two hours a day – did words and phrases begin to make sense. Now I enjoy movies and series without subtitles, and I can even hold simple conversations with natives; this is an achievement that fills me with joy. This is a fascinating journey of discovery and personal growth, and every day I find new words and expressions, which is very rewarding. Those who persevere in something like this reap great rewards.
text_tgt_raw: Recuerdo con nitidez el inicio de mi aprendizaje de japonés hace dos años. Al principio, aquello era un caos total de sonidos y símbolos. Solo los kanji y la gramática se alzaban como una barrera insuperable, un verdadero monte del saber. Mis seres queridos me animaban, pero la frustración y el cansancio eran una constante. Sin embargo, solo con tiempo y dedicación – solo invertía unas dos horas diarias – las palabras y frases empezaron a cobrar sentido. Ahora disfruto de películas y series sin subtítulos, e incluso puedo mantener conversaciones sencillas con nativos; este es un logro que me llena de alegría. Esta es una travesía fascinante de descubrimiento y crecimiento personal, y cada día encuentro nuevas palabras y expresiones, lo cual es muy gratificante. Aquellos que perseveran en algo así cosechan grandes frutos.
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese about 2 years ago. At 1st, it was a total chaos of sounds and symbols. The kanji and grammar seemed like an insurmountable barrier, a true mountain and valley of knowledge. My friends and family encouraged me, but frustration and exhaustion were constant. However, with time and effort—I dedicated about 2 hours daily—words and phrases started to make sense. Now I enjoy movies and series without subtitles, and I can even hold simple conversations and debates with natives, a great joy and satisfaction. It's a fascinating journey of discovery and personal growth, and every day I find new words and expressions, which is very gratifying.

text_es: To learn a new language, consistency and patience are essential. From day one, immerse yourself in the language with study and active practice. Only then will you achieve significant progress. Look for resources and tools like apps, books, movies, and music that regularly expose you to the language; those are what really help. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; these are a natural part of the learning process and will only make you improve your comprehension and expression. Find a language exchange partner or join conversation groups to practice communication and gain confidence. Remember that immersion and fun are essential for maintaining long-term motivation. Only this will guarantee success. Set realistic goals and celebrate every small achievement and step forward on your journey.
text_tgt_raw: Para aprender un idioma nuevo, la constancia y la paciencia son fundamentales. Desde el primer día, sumérgete en el idioma con el estudio y la práctica activa. Solo así lograrás avances significativos. Busca recursos y herramientas como aplicaciones, libros, películas y música que te expongan regularmente a la lengua; esos son los que realmente ayudan. No temas cometer errores; estos son una parte natural del proceso de aprendizaje y solo te harán mejorar tu comprensión y expresión. Encuentra un compañero de intercambio o únete a grupos de conversación para practicar la comunicación y ganar confianza. Recuerda que la inmersión y la diversión son esenciales para mantener la motivación a largo plazo. Solo esto garantizará el éxito. Establece metas realistas y celebra cada pequeño logro y avance en tu camino.
base_en: To learn a new language, consistency, and patience are key. From day 1, immerse yourself in the language through study and active practice. Look for resources and tools such as apps, books, movies, and music that expose you to the language regularly. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; they're a natural part of the learning process and will help you improve your comprehension and expression. Find an exchange partner or join conversation groups to practice communication and gain confidence. Remember that immersion and fun are essential for maintaining long-term motivation. Set realistic goals and celebrate every small achievement and step forward on your journey.

text_es: Participating in a popular race means taking part in a mass sporting event, open to runners of any level, age, and physical condition. These offer an excellent opportunity for self-improvement and social interaction, promoting health and well-being. Generally, they include varied distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and usually cover attractive urban or natural landscapes, becoming a celebration of effort and community. All that's needed is a good race strategy. Only with adequate physical preparation, good hydration, and a well-thought-out strategy can one enjoy the experience and avoid injuries. Many popular races have a charitable component; these allocate part of the registration fee to charitable causes or social organizations, which adds extra value to participation. This is only achieved by collaborating. Participants enjoy the festive atmosphere, camaraderie, and the pride of crossing the finish line, regardless of their time and position. This is a unique event. Those who participate know it.
text_tgt_raw: Participar en una carrera popular es tomar parte en un evento deportivo masivo, abierto a corredores de cualquier nivel, edad y condición física. Estos ofrecen una excelente oportunidad para la superación personal y la interacción social, promoviendo la salud y el bienestar. Generalmente, incluyen distancias variadas, como 5 km, 10 km o medias maratones, y suelen recorrer paisajes urbanos o naturales atractivos, convirtiéndose en una celebración del esfuerzo y la comunidad. Solo hace falta una buena estrategia de carrera. Solo con una preparación física adecuada, una buena hidratación y una estrategia pensada se puede disfrutar la experiencia y evitar lesiones. Muchas carreras populares tienen un componente benéfico; estas destinan parte de la inscripción a causas solidarias u organizaciones sociales, lo cual añade un valor extra a la participación. Solo se consigue esto al colaborar. Los participantes disfrutan de la atmósfera festiva, la camaradería y el orgullo de cruzar la meta, sea cual sea su tiempo y posición. Este es un evento único. Aquellos que participan lo saben.
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all levels, ages, and physical conditions. These events offer an excellent opportunity for personal improvement and social interaction, promoting health and well-being. Generally, they include varied distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and usually cover attractive urban or natural landscapes, becoming a celebration of effort and community. Physical preparation, hydration, and a good race strategy are essential to enjoy the experience and avoid injuries. Many popular races have a charitable component, allocating part of the registration fee to charitable causes and social organizations, which adds extra value to participation and encourages help and commitment. Participants enjoy the festive atmosphere, camaraderie, and the pride of crossing the finish line, whatever their time and position.

text_es: Three years ago, I decided to run my first popular race, an experience that combined nerves and excitement in equal measure. The training had been hard, with days of rain and sun, but I only felt prepared for the challenge. That morning, the fresh air was filled with the energy and enthusiasm of hundreds of runners. I remember the crowd, the noise, the music, and the encouragement of the people; this is the atmosphere I like so much. The first kilometers were a mix of euphoria and effort, with my legs and breathing acclimatizing to the pace. Crossing the finish line was a feeling of victory and satisfaction that can only be understood by experiencing it, overcoming the tiredness and muscle pain. Since then, popular races have become a passion and a personal challenge that I only enjoy to the fullest. Those who try them understand it well.
text_tgt_raw: Hace tres años decidí correr mi primera carrera popular, una experiencia que combinó nervios y emoción a partes iguales. El entrenamiento había sido duro, con días de lluvia y sol, pero yo solo sentía preparación para el reto. Aquella mañana, el aire fresco se llenó de la energía y el entusiasmo de cientos de corredores. Recuerdo la multitud, el ruido, la música y el ánimo de la gente; este es el ambiente que tanto me gusta. Los primeros kilómetros fueron una mezcla de euforia y esfuerzo, con mis piernas y respiración aclimatándose al ritmo. Cruzar la meta fue una sensación de victoria y satisfacción que solo se comprende al vivirla, superando el cansancio y el dolor muscular. Desde entonces, las carreras populares se han convertido en una pasión y un desafío personal que solo disfruto al máximo. Aquellos que las prueban lo entienden bien.
base_en: 3 years ago, I decided to run my 1st popular race, an experience that combined nerves and excitement in equal measure. The training, with its rainy and sunny days, had been tough, but I felt prepared for the challenge. On the morning of the event, the air was cool and filled with the energy and enthusiasm of hundreds of runners. I remember the crowd, the noise, the music, and the encouragement of the people. The 1st kilometers were a mix of euphoria and effort, with my legs and my breathing acclimating to the rhythm. Crossing the finish line was a feeling of victory and satisfaction that overcame the fatigue and muscle soreness. Since then, popular races have become a passion and a personal challenge that I greatly enjoy.

text_es: For your first popular race, just focus on enjoying the experience, not so much on your time or place. This is the most important step to get started. Begin with gradual and consistent training, progressively increasing distance and intensity, always paying attention to your body and how you feel. Only then will you avoid injuries. Proper hydration and nutrition, rich in carbohydrates and proteins, are essential before and during the event; that will give you the necessary energy. On race day, just arrive with enough time to familiarize yourself with the surroundings and the course, and do a good warm-up and stretches. Maintain a comfortable pace, without trying to go faster than you feel capable, and manage your energy. Those who burn out too soon don't enjoy themselves. Don't forget the importance of good footwear and technical clothing; these will offer you comfort and performance. Afterward, celebrate your achievement, plan your recovery, and new challenges.
text_tgt_raw: Para tu primera carrera popular, solo céntrate en disfrutar la experiencia, no tanto en el tiempo o el puesto. Este es el paso más importante para empezar. Empieza con un entrenamiento gradual y constante, aumentando progresivamente la distancia y la intensidad, siempre prestando atención a tu cuerpo y sensaciones. Solo así evitarás lesiones. La hidratación y una nutrición adecuada, rica en carbohidratos y proteínas, son esenciales antes y durante la prueba; esa te dará la energía necesaria. El día de la carrera, solo llega con tiempo suficiente para familiarizarte con el entorno y el recorrido, y realiza un buen calentamiento y estiramientos. Mantén un ritmo cómodo, sin intentar ir más rápido de lo que te sientes capaz, y gestiona tus fuerzas. Aquellos que se agotan demasiado pronto no disfrutan. No olvides la importancia de un buen calzado y ropa técnica; estos te ofrecerán confort y rendimiento. Después, celebra tu logro, planifica tu recuperación y nuevos desafíos.
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience and not so much on time and ranking. Start with gradual and consistent training, progressively increasing distance and intensity, and paying attention to your body and sensations. Hydration and adequate nutrition—with carbohydrates and proteins—are essential before and during the event. On race day, arrive early enough to familiarize yourself with the surroundings and the course, and do a good warm-up and stretches. Maintain a comfortable pace, without trying to go faster than you feel capable, and manage your strength and energy. Don't forget the importance of good footwear and technical clothing, which offer you comfort and performance. Afterward, celebrate your achievement and plan your recovery and future challenges.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is an art that combines skill and patience, transforming worn pieces into objects of beauty and functionality. This process involves several stages, beginning with a detailed assessment of the furniture's condition and the identification of damage. Only then does one proceed with cleaning, stripping, and structural repair, which may include gluing joints or replacing wooden parts if necessary. Those who dedicate themselves to this know that the next step is sanding and finishing, applying varnishes or waxes that protect the surface and enhance the grain and natural color of the wood. Only then is its splendor and value recovered. This is a job that requires dedication and the use of specific tools and materials to guarantee a durable and aesthetic result. Furthermore, restoration not only contributes to sustainability and the appreciation of our artisanal and historical heritage; this is an undeniable benefit.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar un mueble antiguo es un arte que conjuga habilidad y paciencia, transformando piezas desgastadas en objetos de belleza y funcionalidad. Este proceso implica varias etapas, comenzando con una evaluación detallada del estado del mueble y la identificación de daños. Solo después se procede con la limpieza, el decapado y la reparación estructural, lo que puede incluir el encolado de uniones o la sustitución de partes de madera si es preciso. Aquellos que se dedican a esto saben que el siguiente paso es el lijado y el acabado, aplicando barnices o ceras que protejan la superficie y realcen la veta y el color natural de la madera. Solo así se recupera su esplendor y valor. Este es un trabajo que requiere dedicación y el uso de herramientas y materiales específicos para garantizar un resultado duradero y estético. Además, la restauración solo contribuye a la sostenibilidad y a la apreciación de nuestro patrimonio artesanal e histórico; este es un beneficio innegable.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is an art that combines skill and patience, transforming worn pieces into objects of beauty and functionality. This process involves several stages, beginning with a detailed evaluation of the furniture's condition and the identification of damage and defects. Generally, one proceeds with cleaning, stripping, and repairing the structure, which may include gluing joints and replacing wooden parts if necessary. Next, sanding, and finishing are carried out, applying varnishes and waxes to protect the surface and highlight the natural grain and color of the wood, thus recovering its splendor and value. It's a job that requires dedication and the use of specific tools and materials to guarantee a durable and aesthetic result. Furthermore, restoration contributes to sustainability and the appreciation of artisanal and historical heritage.

text_es: Two years ago, I inherited an old oak desk from my grandmother, a piece with a lot of history and charm. It was quite deteriorated, with cracked wood and peeling varnish, but I saw an opportunity and a challenge in it. I decided to restore it myself, something that required patience and technique, as I only wanted to respect its original essence and beauty; I didn't want to add anything new. Just for that, I started by carefully sanding the surfaces and applying special products for the wood and hardware, a long but gratifying process. There were moments of frustration and doubt, especially with the most intricate and delicate parts, but the satisfaction of seeing it regain its splendor motivated me. This was the real driving force. Now the desk looks magnificent in my living room, a mix of history and renewal, and every time I look at it, I only remember the effort and affection I put into it, and I feel proud and happy to have saved it. That was the best project. You just have to see it to understand.
text_tgt_raw: Hace dos años, heredé de mi abuela un antiguo escritorio de roble, una pieza con mucha historia y encanto. Estaba bastante deteriorado, con la madera agrietada y el barniz levantado, pero en el vi una oportunidad y un desafío. Decidí restaurarlo yo mismo, algo que requirió paciencia y técnica, pues solo quería respetar su esencia original y su belleza; no quería añadir nada nuevo. Solo para ello comencé lijando cuidadosamente las superficies y aplicando productos especiales para la madera y los herrajes, un proceso largo pero gratificante. Hubo momentos de frustración y duda, especialmente con las partes más intrincadas y delicadas, pero la satisfacción de verlo recuperar su esplendor me motivó. Este fue el verdadero motor. Ahora el escritorio luce magnífico en mi sala, una mezcla de historia y renovación, y cada vez que lo miro, solo recuerdo el esfuerzo y el cariño que le puse, y me siento orgulloso y feliz de haberlo salvado. Aquel fue el mejor proyecto. Solo hace falta verlo para entenderlo.

Now the desk looks magnificent in my living room, a mix of history and renovation, and every time I look at it, I remember the effort and affection I put into it, and I feel proud and happy to have saved it.

text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture, it's essential to start with good preparation and cleaning. For this, you just need to assess the condition of the piece, both the wood and the hardware, to determine the necessary steps. This includes repairing any structural damage or replacing any parts. Then, just sand the surface gently to remove old varnish or paint; use medium and fine-grit sandpaper to achieve a smooth and uniform texture. That step is crucial. Afterward, apply an appropriate primer to ensure the adhesion and durability of the new finish; this will protect the wood and give it a longer lifespan. Only then choose the desired paint or varnish, applying several thin coats for a professional and durable result. This is the secret to a good finish. Finally, protect the furniture with a sealant or wax to maintain its beauty and resistance to moisture and wear. Only then will you enjoy the process and the result of your patience and effort.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar un mueble antiguo, es fundamental empezar con una buena preparación y limpieza. Para esto, solo hace falta evaluar el estado de la pieza, tanto la madera como los herrajes, para determinar los pasos necesarios. Esto incluye reparar cualquier daño estructural o reemplazar alguna parte. Luego, solo lija la superficie suavemente para eliminar el barniz o la pintura viejos; usa lija de grano medio y fino para lograr una textura lisa y uniforme. Aquel paso es crucial. Después, aplica una imprimación adecuada para asegurar la adhesión y durabilidad del nuevo acabado; esta protegerá la madera y le dará una vida útil más larga. Solo entonces elige la pintura o el barniz deseado, aplicando varias capas delgadas para un resultado profesional y duradero. Este es el secreto de un buen acabado. Finalmente, protege el mueble con un sellador o cera para mantener su belleza y resistencia a la humedad y el desgaste. Solo así disfrutarás del proceso y del resultado de tu paciencia y esfuerzo.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, it's essential to start with good preparation and cleaning. Evaluate the condition of the piece—wood and hardware—to determine the necessary steps, such as repairing structural damage and replacing parts. Gently sand the surface to remove old varnish or paint, using medium and fine-grit sandpaper to achieve a smooth and uniform texture. Apply an appropriate primer to ensure the adhesion and durability of the new finish, protecting the wood and giving it a longer useful life. Then, choose the paint or varnish you want, applying several thin coats for a professional and durable result. Finally, protect the furniture with a sealer or wax to maintain its beauty and resistance to moisture and wear. You'll enjoy the process and the result of your patience and effort.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party, although it requires planning and attention to detail, is a rewarding and fun experience. First, it is essential to decide on the date and time; only then can one think about the budget and the guests, considering later the venue and the style of the celebration. Afterward, a theme and decorations must be chosen. This is crucial, along with making sure there is enough food and drink for everyone. That stage, the one with appetizers and main courses, is where one only focuses on satisfying the diners. It is also important to think about music and entertainment, such as games or activities, to keep attendees happy and lively; only a good plan guarantees this. Don't forget the cake and candles; these are essential and irreplaceable elements. Finally, sending out invitations and confirming attendance is key. Those who respond promptly facilitate the organization. Only then will we have a clear idea of the number of people and be able to successfully organize the space and resources.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños, aunque requiere planificación y atención al detalle, es una experiencia gratificante y divertida. Primero, es fundamental decidir la fecha y hora; solo así se puede pensar en el presupuesto y los invitados, considerando luego el lugar y el estilo de la celebración. Después, debe elegirse un tema y la decoración. Esto es crucial, junto con asegurarse de que haya suficiente comida y bebida para todos. Esa etapa, la de los aperitivos y platos principales, es donde uno solo se enfoca en satisfacer a los comensales. También es importante pensar en la música y el entretenimiento, como juegos o actividades, para mantener a los asistentes contentos y animados; solo un buen plan garantiza esto. No olvides el pastel y las velas; estos son elementos esenciales e insustituibles. Finalmente, enviar las invitaciones y confirmar la asistencia es clave. Aquellos que respondan pronto facilitan la organización. Solo entonces tendremos una idea clara del número de personas y podremos organizar el espacio y los recursos con éxito.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires planning and attention to detail and can be a rewarding and fun experience. 1st, it's essential to decide the date and time, as well as the budget and guests, thinking about the venue and style of celebration. Then, a theme and decoration must be chosen, making sure there's enough food and drink for everyone, which often involves preparing or ordering appetizers and main courses. It's also important to think about music and entertainment, such as games or activities, to keep attendees happy and lively. Don't forget the cake and candles, which are essential and expected elements. Finally, it's key to send out invitations and confirm attendance, to have a clear idea of the number of people and successfully organize the space and resources.

text_es: This year, organizing my birthday party was quite an adventure and a personal challenge. I started with the guest list; I only wanted my closest friends and family to share laughs and good times. Then, I had to decide on the place and date, something that always causes me stress, but only a few calls were necessary to reserve a cozy room for Saturday, March 15th. The decoration was a key point; I bought balloons and streamers, and even made some garlands by hand, looking for a festive and warm atmosphere. That only took a few hours. The food and drinks were the most fun part to plan; I thought of a simple buffet with sandwiches and various appetizers, plus a cake and soft drinks for all tastes and ages. Just this was enough to make everyone happy. Fortunately, my sister and brother-in-law helped me a lot with the preparations, lightening the workload and stress. The result was a fantastic party, with music and dancing that lasted until night. Those were unforgettable moments.
text_tgt_raw: Este año, organizar mi fiesta de cumpleaños fue toda una aventura y un reto personal. Comencé con la lista de invitados; solo quería a mis amigos y familiares más cercanos para compartir risas y buenos momentos. Luego, tuve que decidir el lugar y la fecha, algo que siempre me causa estrés, pero solo fueron necesarias unas pocas llamadas para reservar una acogedora sala para el sábado 15 de marzo. La decoración fue un punto clave; compré globos y serpentinas, e incluso hice unas guirnaldas a mano, buscando un ambiente festivo y cálido. Aquel solo llevó unas horas. La comida y las bebidas fueron la parte más divertida de planificar; pensé en un bufé sencillo con sándwiches y varios aperitivos, además de una tarta y refrescos para todos los gustos y edades. Solo esto era suficiente para que todos estuvieran contentos. Afortunadamente, mi hermana y mi cuñado me ayudaron mucho con los preparativos, aligerando la carga de trabajo y el estrés. base_en: This year, organizing my birthday party was quite an adventure and a personal challenge. I started with the guest list, thinking of friends and family I wanted to be present to share laughs and good times. Then, I had to decide on the place and date—something that always causes me stress—and, after a few calls and messages, I managed to reserve a cozy little room for Saturday, March 15th. The decoration was a key point; I bought balloons and streamers, and I even made some garlands by hand, looking for a festive and warm atmosphere. The food and drinks were the most fun part to plan; I thought of a simple buffet with sandwiches and various appetizers, plus a cake and soft drinks for all tastes and ages. Fortunately, my sister and brother-in-law helped me a lot with the preparations, easing the workload and stress. In the end, the party turned out great, with music and dancing that lasted until night, and everyone enjoyed the company and the celebration.

text_es: To organize a successful birthday party, planning is essential. You just need to define the date, time, and budget; this step is crucial. Think about the theme and decoration; those are key elements to create a festive atmosphere. Don't forget the food and drinks; just choose options that most people will enjoy and that are easy to serve, like assorted appetizers. Music and games are also important to keep everyone entertained. Just confirm guest attendance one or two weeks in advance to have an approximate number; this will allow you to adjust details. Do last-minute shopping calmly. With these tips and a good attitude, your celebration will be a success. The one who prepares the party will see the joy of the honoree.
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños exitosa, la planificación es fundamental. Solo hace falta definir la fecha, la hora y el presupuesto; este paso es crucial. Piensa en el tema y la decoración; esos son elementos clave para crear una atmósfera festiva. No olvides la comida y las bebidas; solo elige opciones que la mayoría disfrute y que sean fáciles de servir, como aperitivos variados. La música y los juegos también son importantes para mantener a todos entretenidos. Solo confirma la asistencia de los invitados con una o dos semanas de antelación para tener una cifra aproximada; esto te permitirá ajustar detalles. Realiza las compras de última hora con tranquilidad. Con estos consejos y una buena actitud, tu celebración será un éxito. Aquel que prepare la fiesta verá la alegría del homenajeado.
base_en: To organize a successful birthday party, planning, and anticipation are key. Start by defining the date and time, as well as the budget and guest list. Think about the theme and decoration—balloons and streamers, for example—elements that will create a festive and memorable atmosphere. Don't forget the food and drinks: opt for options that most people will like and that are easy to serve, such as appetizers and various soft drinks. Music and games are also important to keep everyone's spirits up and entertained, from the youngest to the adults. Confirm guests' attendance 1 or 2 weeks in advance to get an approximate number, and make any necessary last-minute purchases with time and peace of mind. With these tips and a good attitude, your celebration will be a success and a joy for the birthday person and their loved ones.

text_es: Caring for houseplants only requires specific attention and knowledge to ensure their growth. It is essential to consider the appropriate light and temperature for each species; only then will you avoid problems. Watering is another crucial factor; it is important to find a balance between humidity and drainage, as this prevents waterlogging or extreme dryness. Quality soil and occasional fertilization are essential to provide the necessary nutrients; the former is the foundation. Furthermore, regular pruning and cleaning of the leaves help prevent pests and diseases; only then will you maintain health and vitality. This is a process that should be done regularly. Paying attention to these details and the specific needs of each plant will guarantee a green and vibrant home; that is the goal.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar las plantas de interior solo requiere atención y conocimiento específicos para asegurar su crecimiento. Es fundamental considerar la luz y temperatura adecuadas para cada especie, solo así evitará problemas. El riego es otro factor crucial; es importante encontrar un equilibrio entre humedad y drenaje, esto previene el encharcamiento o la sequedad extrema. Un sustrato de calidad y la fertilización ocasional son esenciales para proveer los nutrientes necesarios; aquel es la base. Además, la poda y limpieza regular de las hojas ayudan a prevenir plagas y enfermedades, solo así mantendrá la salud y vitalidad. Este es un proceso que debe hacerse con regularidad. Prestar atención a estos detalles y a las necesidades específicas de cada planta garantizará un hogar verde y lleno de vida; esa es la meta.
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires specific attention and knowledge to ensure their growth and well-being. It's essential to consider the appropriate light and temperature for each species, as insufficient or excessive exposure can be detrimental. Watering is another crucial factor; it's important to find a balance between humidity and drainage, avoiding both waterlogging and extreme dryness of the soil. A quality substrate and occasional fertilization are essential to provide the necessary nutrients and minerals for their development. In addition, pruning, and regular cleaning of the leaves help prevent pests and diseases, maintaining the plant's health and vitality. Paying attention to these details and to the specific needs of each plant and pot will guarantee a green and lively home.

text_es: I admit that caring for houseplants was, at first, a source of stress and frustration for me. I bought pots and seeds with great enthusiasm, only to watch most of my acquisitions wither within weeks and days. Only with time did I understand that light and water are essential, but the amount and frequency vary enormously among species. This, for example, is a crucial detail. My ficuses and calatheas, in particular, have taught me a lot of patience and observation; only with these have I learned to read nature's signals. Now I enjoy the calm and beauty they bring to my home, and for that alone, it is an activity that relaxes my mind and body. Those who believe it's just a hobby are mistaken; it's a connection with nature and life.
text_tgt_raw: Reconozco que cuidar plantas de interior fue, al principio, una fuente de estres y frustracion para mi. Compre macetas y semillas con gran entusiasmo, solo para ver como la mayoria de mis adquisiciones terminaban marchitandose en cuestion de semanas y dias. Solo con el tiempo comprendi que luz y agua son esenciales, pero la cantidad y frecuencia varian enormemente entre especies. Este, por ejemplo, es un detalle crucial. Mis ficus y calatheas, en particular, me han ensenado mucha paciencia y observacion; solo con estas he aprendido a leer las senales de la naturaleza. Ahora disfruto de la calma y la belleza que aportan a mi hogar, y solo por eso, es una actividad que relaja mi mente y mi cuerpo. Aquellos que creen que es solo un pasatiempo se equivocan; es una conexion con la naturaleza y la vida.
base_en: I recognize that caring for houseplants was, at 1st, a source of stress and frustration for me. I bought pots and seeds with great excitement, only to see most of my acquisitions end up wilting in a matter of weeks and days. I learned, for example, that light and water are essential, but the amount and frequency can vary greatly among species and varieties. My ficuses and calatheas, in particular, have taught me a lot of patience and observation. Now I enjoy the calm and beauty they bring to my home and, honestly, it's an activity that relaxes my mind and body. It's not just a hobby; it's a connection with nature and life.

text_es: To successfully care for houseplants, only good planning is crucial from the beginning. It is essential to research the specific needs of each species, such as light and humidity, before acquiring it; only then is a good start guaranteed. Make sure you have adequate pots and substrate, because only optimal drainage and appropriate nutrition are key to their development. Watering is very important; however, it is only effective if both excess and lack are avoided, always checking the soil and the weight of the pot. Pay attention to the leaves and stems, because those details will give you clues about their health and possible problems. He who pays attention to the latter manages to identify any ailment in time. Correct lighting and temperature, along with optimal ventilation and humidity, are vital. You only need to observe a little to understand it. Don't forget regular pruning and leaf cleaning; this will encourage vigorous growth and contribute to a pleasant environment in your home.
text_tgt_raw: Para cuidar con éxito las plantas de interior, solo una buena planificación es crucial desde el principio. Es fundamental investigar las necesidades específicas de cada especie, como la luz y la humedad, antes de adquirirla; solo asi se garantiza un buen comienzo. Asegúrese de tener macetas y sustrato adecuados, pues solo un drenaje óptimo y una nutrición apropiada son la clave para su desarrollo. El riego es importantísimo; no obstante, solo es efectivo si se evita tanto el exceso como la falta, comprobando siempre la tierra y el peso de la maceta. Preste atención a las hojas y los tallos, porque esos detalles le darán indicios sobre su salud y posibles problemas. Aquel que presta atención a esto último, logra identificar a tiempo cualquier dolencia. Una iluminación y temperatura correctas, junto con una ventilación y humedad óptimas, son vitales. Solo hace falta observar un poco para entenderlo. No olvide la poda regular y la limpieza de hojas, esto fomentará un crecimiento vigoroso y contribuirá a un ambiente agradable en su hogar.
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, a good start and planning are essential. Research the specific needs of each plant, such as light and humidity, before buying it. Make sure you've adequate pots and substrate, as good drainage and soil nutrition are key for their development. Watering is fundamental, but avoid overwatering and underwatering, always checking the soil and the weight of the pot. Pay attention to the leaves and stems, as they'll give you clues about their health and possible problems or pests. The correct light and temperature, along with optimal ventilation and humidity, are vital for their well-being. Don't forget regular pruning and cleaning of leaves, which will promote healthy and vigorous growth, and provide a pleasant environment and atmosphere in your home.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is essential for health and well-being, so a variety of factors and personal preferences must be considered. Firmness and support are key aspects; one that is too soft or excessively hard can cause aches and pains. There are various types of materials, such as memory foam, latex, and springs, each with its own advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It is crucial to try it out for at least 10 to 15 minutes to assess its comfort and how your body responds. Only then can you make the correct decision. Also consider your sleeping posture and weight, as these directly influence pressure distribution and spinal and neck alignment. A good mattress can improve sleep quality and overall muscular and physical recovery; one that doesn't will only bring you problems. It is only necessary to pay attention to these details. Don't forget durability and warranty, as these are indicators of the manufacturer's quality and their commitment to the product and the customer.
text_tgt_raw: La elección del colchón adecuado es fundamental para la salud y el bienestar, por lo que solo se debe considerar una variedad de factores y preferencias personales. La firmeza y el soporte son aspectos clave; uno demasiado blando o excesivamente duro puede causar dolores y molestias. Existen diversos tipos de materiales, como la espuma viscoelástica, el látex y los muelles, cada uno con sus propias ventajas y desventajas en cuanto a adaptabilidad y transpirabilidad. Es crucial probarlo durante al menos 10 a 15 minutos para evaluar su comodidad y cómo responde el cuerpo. Solo así podrá decidirse correctamente. También considere su postura al dormir y su peso, ya que estos influyen directamente en la distribución de la presión y la alineación de la columna y el cuello. Un buen colchón puede mejorar la calidad del sueño y la recuperación muscular y física general; aquel que no lo haga solo le traerá problemas. Solo es necesario prestar atención a estos detalles. No olvide la durabilidad y la garantía, pues estas son indicadores de la calidad del fabricante y su compromiso con el producto y el cliente.
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is fundamental for health and well-being, so it's important to consider various factors and personal preferences. Firmness and support are key aspects; a mattress that's too soft or too hard can cause aches and discomfort. There are diverse types of materials, such as memory foam, latex, and springs, each with its own advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It's crucial to try out the mattress for at least 10 to 15 minutes to evaluate its comfort and body response. Also consider your sleeping posture and your weight, as they directly influence pressure distribution and the alignment of your spine and neck. A good mattress can improve sleep quality and overall muscular and physical recovery. Don't forget durability and warranty, which are indicators of the manufacturer's quality and commitment to the product and the customer.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is quite an odyssey. I remember about three years ago when my old mattress only offered discomfort. My mornings only started with back pain, so my partner and I decided it was time to invest in good rest. We visited several stores; this process was exhausting, and the truth is that the variety of options and prices was overwhelming. We just wanted a mattress that would give us good support. The salespeople explained the differences between firmness and adaptability to us; that was quite technical. We spent hours lying on different models, trying to discern the subtle variations; that's something you only understand by trying it. In the end, after much deliberation, we opted for a medium-firmness one with a viscoelastic layer, which promised good rest and durability. This has been an excellent acquisition.
text_tgt_raw: La elección de un colchón es toda una odisea. Recuerdo hace unos tres años cuando mi viejo colchón ya solo ofrecía incomodidad. Mis mañanas solo empezaban con dolor de espalda, así que mi pareja y yo decidimos que era hora de invertir en un buen descanso. Visitamos varias tiendas; este proceso fue agotador, y la verdad es que la variedad de opciones y precios era abrumadora. Solo queríamos un colchón que nos diera buen soporte. Los vendedores nos explicaban las diferencias entre firmeza y adaptabilidad, aquello era bastante técnico. Pasamos horas tumbados en diferentes modelos, tratando de discernir las sutiles variaciones; eso es algo que solo se comprende probando. Al final, después de mucha deliberación, optamos por uno de firmeza media con una capa de viscoelástica, el cual prometía buen descanso y durabilidad. Este ha sido una excelente adquisición.
base_en: Choosing a mattress—what an odyssey! I remember about 3 years ago, when my old mattress no longer offered comfort or support. My mornings started with back and neck pain, so my partner and I decided it was time to invest in good rest. We visited several stores, trying spring and memory foam models, and the truth is that the variety of options and prices was overwhelming. The salespeople explained the differences between firmness and adaptability to us, and they spoke to us about materials and technologies with great enthusiasm. We spent hours lying on different models, trying to discern the subtle variations between a firm mattress and a medium one, and in the end, after much deliberation and discussing pros and cons, we opted for a medium-firmness one with a layer of memory foam, which promised good rest and durability. The choice was a relief, and now I enjoy restorative sleep and peaceful nights.

text_es: When selecting a mattress, the key is to prioritize your rest and health, since only quality sleep profoundly impacts your energy and overall well-being. Consider the material: springs, memory foam, latex, or foam, looking for the ideal balance between firmness and adaptability that your body requires. It is essential to try it in person; only then will you feel the support and comfort it offers, paying attention to the posture of your back and neck. Don't be guided solely by price or offers; durability and quality represent a long-term investment. Also think about your sleeping posture—on your back, side, or stomach—and if you share the bed so that both of you have space and comfort. Find out about the warranty and return policies; these are insurance for your purchase and your peace of mind. Of all the factors, this is the most important for a good decision.
text_tgt_raw: Al seleccionar un colchón, la clave es priorizar tu descanso y salud, ya que solo el sueño de calidad impacta profundamente tu energía y bienestar general. Considera el material: muelles, viscoelástica, látex o espuma, buscando el equilibrio ideal entre firmeza y adaptabilidad que tu cuerpo requiere. Es fundamental probarlo en persona; solo así sentirás el soporte y la comodidad que ofrece, prestando atención a la postura de tu espalda y cuello. No te guíes solo por el precio o las ofertas; la durabilidad y calidad representan una inversión a largo plazo. Piensa también en tu postura al dormir —boca arriba, de lado o boca abajo— y si compartes la cama para que ambos tengáis espacio y confort. Infórmate sobre la garantía y las políticas de devolución; estas son un seguro para tu compra y tu tranquilidad. De todos los factores, este es el más importante para una buena decisión.
base_en: When choosing a mattress, the key is to prioritize your rest and health, since sleeping well impacts your energy and general well-being. Consider the type of material—springs and memory foam, latex, and foam—looking for the balance between firmness and adaptability that your body needs. It's vital to try it in person; lie down and feel the comfort and support it offers, paying attention to the posture of your back and neck. Don't be guided only by price and offers; durability and quality are long-term investments. Also think about your sleeping posture—on your back and side, on your stomach—and if you share the bed with another person so that both of you've space and comfort. Find out about the warranty and return policies, as they're insurance for your purchase and your peace of mind.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a fundamental action for the environment and society. This implies better food planning and purchasing, avoiding unnecessary excesses. Only in this way is efficient use achieved. It is crucial to store products properly, considering their freshness and duration, to preserve their properties and flavor; this is a key to success. In addition, reusing leftovers and giving a second life to ingredients like peels and stems, reduces the amount of waste. Those who implement these practices not only generate economic savings and savings in water and energy resources, but also contribute to food security and reduce the carbon footprint and pollution. All it takes is a little awareness. Adopting responsible consumption habits is the key to combating this global problem and promoting sustainability and the well-being of all. Only with these small changes do we achieve great progress.

Aquellos que implementan estas prácticas no solo generan ahorros económicos y de recursos hídricos y energéticos, sino que también contribuyen a la seguridad alimentaria y reducen la huella de carbono y la contaminación. text_es: Last week, while organizing the fridge and pantry, I realized the enormous amount of food that sometimes goes to waste, and this made me feel guilty and frustrated. I have always tried to be mindful of my purchases and consumption, but modern life and daily rushes often lead me to overbuy or forget about food. I decided it was time to take more serious steps to reduce waste, so I looked for advice. All it took was better planning. I started to better organize my menus and quantities, which has resulted in surprising savings of time and money. Also, now I try to reuse leftovers; this is giving a second chance to food that would otherwise be thrown away. Only those who try it know how rewarding it is. I believe that small changes in our habits can generate a significant impact, not only on the environment but also on our wallets. It's a constant challenge, but the benefit is great, and all you have to do is start.

text_es: Maintaining a bicycle is not just a matter of aesthetics, but of safety and durability. Regular maintenance can prevent costly breakdowns and ensure optimal performance; it's not something we should underestimate. This includes checking tire pressure before each ride, frequently cleaning and lubricating the chain, and adjusting the brakes so they are always ready. We also shouldn't forget to check the condition of the cables and gears; if those don't work well, the pedaling experience won't be ideal. The truth is that good care extends the lifespan of the bicycle and makes every trip more pleasant. It only takes a little time and attention, and only then can we guarantee that every outing is safe. This is a simple process that only requires consistency, and the final result is always worth it.

Esto incluye revisar la presión de los neumáticos antes de cada paseo, limpiar y lubricar la cadena con frecuencia, y ajustar los frenos para que estén siempre listos. También no hay que olvidar la revisión del estado de los cables y los cambios; si esos no funcionan bien, la experiencia al pedalear no será la ideal. La verdad es que un buen cuidado prolonga la vida útil de la bicicleta y hace que cada viaje sea más placentero. Solo hace falta un poco de tiempo y atención, y solo así podemos garantizar que cada salida sea segura. Este es un proceso sencillo que solo requiere constancia, y el resultado final siempre vale la pena.

text_es: I remember the first time I dared to maintain my own bicycle; it wasn't a simple task. My parents always told me that wasn't for kids, but I just wanted to learn. The chain wasn't properly adjusted and the gear shift wasn't working, so I decided I could fix it myself. I got to work with a basic set of tools—I bought these at a second-hand store—and the help of an internet tutorial; I'm not an expert, of course. After about three hours, the result wasn't perfect, but I felt proud to have tried; that's what's important, don't you think? Since then, I'm the only one who tries to do the maintenance; it's a very useful skill. Just for this, I've bought more tools. That day showed me that with just a little effort, a lot can be achieved.

text_es: To get started with your bike, don't forget regular cleaning; that's a fundamental step for its good preservation. You don't need to be an expert mechanic, just dedicate about fifteen minutes every two weeks to basic maintenance. Check the tire pressure, because you don't want an unexpected flat tire, and lubricate the chain; this is a good idea every hundred kilometers or if you notice it's dry. If you hear strange noises, don't ignore them: sometimes it's just a simple adjustment. It's also not complicated to check the brakes and gears to ensure their proper functioning; that will help you prevent bigger problems. There are no excuses to neglect your bike; it will thank you with a much longer lifespan and safer rides, as it only requires a little regular attention.

text_es: Organizing a farmers market is no simple task; it requires meticulous planning and constant coordination. This isn't simply about finding a location, as that's only the first step. Local farmers interested in participating must be identified—not all of them are available—necessary municipal permits must be obtained, and a schedule must be established. Furthermore, we cannot forget promotion; it's essential to communicate to the community that the market is open. The logistics of the stalls and waste management should also not be underestimated; these are crucial aspects that must be considered in advance. It's not always possible to please everyone, but the main goal is to offer fresh products and support producers; only then can the desired impact be achieved. I am sure that a good strategy leads to success, and whoever follows it will see good results.

Esto no es simplemente encontrar una ubicación, pues ese es solo el primer paso. Se debe identificar a los agricultores locales interesados en participar —no todos tienen disponibilidad—, obtener los permisos municipales necesarios y establecer un cronograma. Además, no podemos olvidar la promoción; es fundamental comunicar a la comunidad que el mercado está abierto. Tampoco hay que subestimar la logística de los puestos y la gestión de residuos; estas son facetas cruciales que deben considerarse con antelación. No siempre es posible complacer a todos, pero el objetivo principal es ofrecer productos frescos y apoyar a los productores, solo así se logra el impacto deseado. Estoy seguro de que una buena estrategia lleva al éxito, y aquel que la siga verá buenos resultados.

text_es: To organize a farmers market, the first step is simple: you just need to plan well. It's not as complicated as it seems. The first thing is to identify a suitable location; this should be accessible and have few permit requirements, that's essential. Then, contact local farmers; only then will you offer them a good space at a reasonable cost. They only need to invest minimally at the beginning. Promotion is also crucial; it's not enough to open, you have to announce the market. Use social media, posters, and collaborate with neighborhood businesses; only in this way will people know you exist. Finally, be consistent and listen to suggestions; a good market isn't built in a day, and this is something you'll learn over time. Those who persevere are the ones who succeed.

text_es: I clearly remember the day I decided to learn how to knit a scarf; honestly, it wasn't my idea. It was my grandmother, an expert with yarn, who encouraged me by saying, "this isn't as hard as it looks, you'll see." At eighteen, I wasn't very convinced, as manual dexterity was never my strong suit. She taught me the basic stitches, knit and purl, and at first I only managed to tangle the threads; I didn't understand why that was happening. But she, with infinite patience, kept repeating to me: "don't despair, only practice makes perfect." After three days and a lot of frustration, the pattern was no longer a mystery and I felt a little proud to see the first more or less straight row; that was a very gratifying moment. Now, every winter, I wear that scarf—even though it's not perfect, it only has a few loose stitches—and only then do I fondly relive that experience.

Con dieciocho años, no estaba muy convencido, pues la destreza manual nunca fue mi fuerte. Ella me enseñó los puntos básicos, el derecho y el revés, y al principio solo conseguía enredar los hilos; no entendía por qué sucedía aquello. Pero ella, con infinita paciencia, me repetía: "no desesperes, solo la práctica hace al maestro". Después de tres días y mucha frustración, el patrón ya no era un misterio y me sentí un poco orgulloso al ver la primera hilera más o menos recta; ese fue un momento muy gratificante. Ahora, cada invierno, me pongo esa bufanda —aunque no es perfecta, solo tiene algunos puntos sueltos— y solo entonces revivo con cariño aquella experiencia.

text_es: To start knitting a scarf, the first thing you can't forget is that it's not as difficult as it seems; it just requires patience. You don't need to invest much at first; just some 5 mm or 6 mm needles and a ball of medium-weight yarn will be enough. This is the basic material. Start with a simple stitch, like the garter stitch or the knit stitch; you'll see that it's not very complicated. Once you master that technique, you'll see that you're not that far from knitting other things. Just remember to count your stitches at the beginning and end of each row so the scarf doesn't unintentionally narrow or widen. It's a very relaxing and rewarding activity. Only with practice will you see that it becomes easier and easier.

text_es: Preparing for a move is no easy task, and it only takes one time to learn that lesson; it requires meticulous planning for everything to go well. This is crucial to avoid unnecessary stress. Don't underestimate the time it takes to pack, because you always have more things than you think; just organizing household items alone takes hours. Simply organizing boxes by content and destination will save you a lot of work on moving day. That is very useful. You can't leave hiring the moving company or renting the van until the last minute; this is a common mistake that only creates more problems. It doesn't hurt to ask several companies for quotes and compare services; that's a good practice. Finally, remember to change your address on all your documents and services so you don't have any surprises later.

text_es: If you venture into the world of urban gardens, don't get discouraged! It's simpler than it seems. First, look for a place with at least six hours of direct sunlight; this is crucial for almost all plants. Then, don't underestimate the importance of good soil; not just any dirt will do, it's vital that it has good drainage and nutrients. At first, don't plant too many things at once; start with just three or four easy crops that you like, such as lettuce, spinach, or radishes; this will help you gain confidence. Also, don't forget to water regularly, but without overdoing it; too much water only causes harm. If pests appear, don't immediately resort to strong chemical products; there are often organic solutions. You just need to do a little research. And remember, you don't have to be an expert; the key is to observe and learn from your plants. This is a process that is enjoyed step by step. Those who persevere are the ones who get the best results. Only with practice is the art of gardening mastered.
