There is only one general European platform, so it's better to do a little research on each one. If you're going to take several trips, consider buying a train pass; this is very useful and allows you to save money. Don't forget to reserve your seats, especially on high-speed trains or if you're traveling during peak season, as that's the only way to guarantee yourself a spot. I always arrive at the station with plenty of time; you never know what unforeseen event might arise, and that could ruin your trip. This guide is just a suggestion, but following it will help you enjoy your trip more.
text_tgt_raw: Planificar un viaje en tren no es complicado si se siguen unos pasos fundamentales. Lo primero que hay que hacer es elegir el destino y las fechas; no es bueno dejarlo para el último momento, pues los precios pueden subir mucho. Busca las rutas y horarios en las webs de las compañías ferroviarias; solo asi encontrarás la información más precisa. Solo existe una plataforma europea general, por eso es mejor investigar un poco en cada una. Si vas a hacer varios viajes, considera comprar un pase de tren; este es muy útil y te permite ahorrar dinero. No olvides reservar los asientos, sobre todo en trenes de alta velocidad o si viajas en temporada alta, ya que solo así te aseguras un lugar. Yo siempre llego a la estación con tiempo; nunca se sabe qué imprevisto puede surgir, y aquel te puede arruinar el viaje. Este guion es solo una sugerencia, pero seguirlo te ayudará a disfrutar más.
base_en: To plan a train trip, it isn't difficult if you follow a few key steps. The 1st thing you have to do is decide your destination and dates; it isn't good to leave it until the last minute, as prices can rise considerably. Look for routes and schedules on the railway companies' websites; there isn't a single website for all European trains, so it's better to do a little research. Consider buying a train pass if you're going to make several trips, that's very useful and saves you money. Don't forget to reserve seats either, especially on high-speed trains or if you're traveling in high season, because the train doesn't have to have free seats at the last minute. I'm one of those who always arrive at the station early—you never know what unforeseen event might arise!

text_es: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't reserved only for experts. You don't have to limit yourself to a single recipe; the variety of breads you can try is enormous, from classic white bread to more complex options like sourdough. Getting started isn't difficult; you only need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although these aren't the only things you can add. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough—which doesn't have to be exhausting—letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough grow and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes, that is a wonderful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread contains no preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought bread; you just have to try it to see for yourself. This is a hobby that only brings satisfaction.
text_tgt_raw: Hacer pan en casa es una actividad gratificante que no esta reservada solo para expertos. No hay que limitarse a una unica receta; la variedad de panes que se pueden probar es enorme, desde el clasico pan blanco hasta opciones mas complejas como el de masa madre. Empezar no es dificil; solo se necesita harina, agua, levadura y sal, aunque esto no es lo unico que se puede añadir. El proceso implica mezclar los ingredientes, amasar la masa –lo cual no tiene por que ser agotador–, dejarla levar y luego hornearla. Ver crecer la masa y el aroma que inunda la cocina mientras se hornea, eso es una experiencia maravillosa. Ademas, el pan casero no lleva conservantes y su sabor es incomparable al comprado en tienda; solo hay que probarlo para comprobarlo. Este es un pasatiempo que solo aporta satisfacciones.
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't just for experts. You aren't limited to a single recipe; there's a wide variety of breads you can try, from classic white bread to more complex sourdough options. It isn't difficult to start; you just need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although that isn't all you can add. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough—which doesn't have to be exhausting—letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough grow and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes, that's a wonderful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread doesn't have preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought; you won't regret trying it.

text_es: If you want to get into the world of making bread at home, don't stress at first; it's not as complicated as it seems. You just need a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread; it doesn't have to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. This is the key point: patience and practice are your best allies; there are no shortcuts to good bread. Make sure you have the essential ingredients—flour, water, yeast, salt—and a reliable scale; only then will you achieve the necessary precision. Don't forget that room temperature greatly influences the rising; this alone makes a big difference. With two or three attempts, you'll start to get the hang of it and you'll be surprised how rewarding it is to bake your own bread. That will give you unique satisfaction.
text_tgt_raw: Si deseas adentrarte en el mundo de hacer pan en casa, no te estreses al principio; no es tan complicado como parece. Solo hace falta una receta básica de pan blanco o integral, no tiene por qué ser de masa madre si aún no te sientes con confianza. Este es el punto clave: la paciencia y la práctica son tus mejores aliados, no hay atajos para un buen pan. Asegúrate de tener los ingredientes esenciales —harina, agua, levadura, sal— y una báscula fiable; solo así lograrás la precisión necesaria. No olvides que la temperatura ambiente influye mucho en el levado; solo esto marca una gran diferencia. Con dos o tres intentos, empezarás a cogerle el truco y te sorprenderá lo gratificante que es hornear tu propio pan. Aquel te dará una satisfacción única.
base_en: If you want to get started in the world of making bread at home, don't stress at 1st; it isn't as complicated as it seems. The 1st thing is to look for a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread, it doesn't have to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. This is key: patience and practice are your best allies, there are no shortcuts to good bread. Make sure you've the essential ingredients—flour, water, yeast, salt—and a reliable scale; precision is important. Don't forget that room temperature greatly influences the rising. I'm sure that with 2 or 3 tries, you'll start to get the hang of it and you'll be surprised how rewarding it's to bake your own bread.

text_es: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking the step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you have time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best suits your lifestyle, because this one isn't like that one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, only love and care. That's the most important thing, really. You're about to give a living being a second chance, and the unconditional love you receive in return is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life, but you also free up space for another animal in need. With just a little effort, this action can have an enormous impact.
text_tgt_raw: Adoptar un perro no es solo llevar un animal a casa; es un compromiso serio y una decisión que cambiará tu vida y la suya. Antes de dar el paso, es fundamental considerar varios factores: ¿tienes tiempo para pasearlo y cuidarlo? ¿Tu hogar es adecuado para un perro? No hay prisa, piensa bien la raza y el tamaño que mejor se adapte a tu estilo de vida, porque este no es igual que aquel. Muchos refugios tienen animales que necesitan un hogar y no piden nada a cambio, solo amor y cuidado. Eso es lo más importante, de verdad. Estás a punto de dar una segunda oportunidad a un ser vivo, y el amor incondicional que recibes a cambio no tiene precio. Además, al adoptar, no solo salvas una vida, sino que también liberas espacio para otro animal necesitado. Solo con un poco de esfuerzo, esta acción puede tener un impacto enorme.
base_en: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking the step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you've time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best suits your lifestyle, because a large dog isn't the same as a small one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, only love and care. That's the most important thing, really. You're about to give a 2nd chance to a living being, and the unconditional love you receive in return is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life, but you also free up space for another animal in need.

text_es: Before adopting a dog, it's crucial to be well-informed; this isn't a decision to be taken lightly. Only then can future problems be avoided. Think about the time you'll dedicate to it, because a dog isn't just companionship, it needs walks, play, and daily attention. Are you willing to give it that? Also consider your economic situation; don't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, these aren't low. Only a realistic budget will allow you to face them. If you live in an apartment, remember that certain breeds need more space than others; only this can determine your pet's happiness. Look in a shelter or rescue; not only will you find the perfect companion, but you'll also help an animal in need. That's a big advantage. So, you not only adopt a pet, but you save a life, and this is what really matters.
text_tgt_raw: Antes de adoptar un perro, es crucial informarse bien; esta no es una decisión que deba tomarse a la ligera. Solo así se evitan problemas futuros. Piense en el tiempo que le dedicará, porque un perro no es solo compañía, necesita paseos, juegos y atención diaria. ¿Está dispuesto a darle eso? Considere también su situación económica; no subestime los gastos de comida, veterinario y accesorios, estos no son bajos. Solo un presupuesto realista le permitirá afrontarlos. Si vive en un apartamento, recuerde que ciertas razas necesitan más espacio que otras; solo esto puede determinar la felicidad de su mascota. Busque en un refugio o protectora; no solo encontrará al compañero perfecto, sino que también ayudará a un animal necesitado. Esa es una gran ventaja. Así, no solo adopta una mascota, sino que salva una vida, y esto es lo que realmente importa.
base_en: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to be well-informed; it's not a decision that should be taken lightly. Think about the time you're going to dedicate to it, because a dog isn't just companionship, it needs walks, games, and daily attention. Are you willing to do that? Also consider your economic situation; you shouldn't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, they aren't exactly low. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that certain breeds need more space than others; it's not a minor factor. Look for a shelter or rescue; not only will you find the perfect companion, but you'll also help an animal in need. That way, you don't just adopt a pet, but you save a life, and that's what really matters.

text_es: Yesterday, I ventured to assemble a shelf I had bought, and this was not easy at all. The box indicated one hour for assembly, but of course, that's only for those with experience. I only have a knack for letters, and not with screwdrivers, and that was evident. The instructions, moreover, were unclear, a true hieroglyph that only complicated the task. I think about three hours passed before the structure started to take shape, just that! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves weren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat this experience soon; those who enjoy it have my respect, but this isn't for me.
text_tgt_raw: Ayer me aventuré a armar un estante que había comprado, y esto no fue nada fácil. La caja indicaba una hora para el montaje, pero claro, eso es solo para quienes tienen experiencia. Yo solo tengo habilidad para las letras, y no con destornilladores, y eso se notó. Las instrucciones, además, eran poco claras, un verdadero jeroglífico que solo complicó la tarea. Creo que pasaron unas tres horas antes de que la estructura empezara a tomar forma, ¡solo eso! El resultado final, para ser sincero, no está nada mal, aunque un par de baldas no quedaron perfectamente niveladas. Definitivamente no quiero repetir esta experiencia pronto; aquellos que disfruten de ello tienen mi respeto, pero a mi esto no me va.
base_en: Yesterday I embarked on the adventure of assembling a shelf I bought, and it wasn't easy at all. The box indicated 1 hour for assembly, but of course, that's not possible for someone without experience. I don't have much skill with screwdrivers, and that was noticeable. The instructions, moreover, weren't very clear, a real hieroglyph that wasn't very helpful. I think about 3 hours passed before the structure started to take shape, no joke! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves aren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat the experience soon.

text_es: Assembling a bookshelf, although it seems simple, is not as easy as many believe, and I'm not kidding! Before starting, make sure you have all the parts and tools from the manual; only then will you avoid the frustration of discovering a missing screw halfway through the process. I recommend clearing the work area well, just to avoid tripping over other things. Read the instructions twice completely before tightening the first screw; this step is crucial to avoid mistakes. Sometimes, the assembly order is not obvious. If the bookshelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and this is not a competition. Those who rush tend to make more mistakes. When you finish, check for stability; only then will you ensure that the contents won't fall with the slightest bump.
text_tgt_raw: Armar una estantería, aunque parezca sencillo, no es tan fácil como muchos creen, ¡y no es broma! Antes de empezar, asegúrate de tener todas las piezas y herramientas del manual; solo así evitarás la frustración de descubrir que falta un tornillo a mitad del proceso. Recomiendo despejar bien el área de trabajo, solo para no tropezar con otras cosas. Lee las instrucciones dos veces completas antes de apretar el primer tornillo; este paso es crucial para evitar errores. A veces, el orden de montaje no es obvio. Si la estantería es grande, no dudes en pedir ayuda; no tienes que hacerlo solo, y esto no es una competición. Aquellos que se apresuran suelen cometer más errores. Al terminar, verifica la estabilidad; solo así te asegurarás de que el contenido no se caiga al menor descuido.
base_en: Assembling a shelf, although it seems simple, isn't as easy as many people think—no joke! Before starting, make sure you've all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; there's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through the process. I recommend clearing the work area well, so you aren't tripping over other things. Read the instructions 2 full times before tightening the 1st screw; this is crucial to avoid mistakes. Sometimes the assembly order isn't obvious. If the shelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and this isn't a competition. When finished, check the stability; you don't want all the contents to fall at the 1st oversight.

text_es: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved break without financial worries; it's not just a matter of money. Planning ahead is key; this is an essential step, which involves establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It also doesn't hurt to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events; that's the only way to face setbacks. A good strategy is to allocate a fixed amount each month to a specific savings account; that's a habit that works very well. In addition, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as these are often not available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or eating out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. It just takes a little discipline. With just these guidelines, that dream trip is closer.
text_tgt_raw: Ahorrar para las vacaciones es fundamental para disfrutar de un merecido descanso sin preocupaciones financieras; no es solo una cuestión de dinero. Planificar con anticipación es clave; este es un paso esencial, que implica establecer un presupuesto detallado para transporte, alojamiento, comidas y actividades, para que no haya sorpresas. Tampoco está de más considerar un fondo de emergencia para imprevistos; solo así se afrontan los reveses. Una buena estrategia es asignar una cantidad fija cada mes a una cuenta de ahorros específica; eso es un hábito que funciona muy bien. Además, se pueden buscar ofertas y descuentos con antelación, ya que a menudo estos no están disponibles a última hora. Reducir gastos diarios superfluos –como cafés o comidas fuera– puede generar ahorros considerables, y esto no significa renunciar a todo. Solo hace falta un poco de disciplina. Solo con estas pautas, aquel viaje soñado está más cerca.
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries; it isn't just a matter of money. Planning ahead is key; that's, establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It doesn't hurt to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events. A good strategy is to allocate a fixed amount each month to a specific savings account; that's a habit that works very well. In addition, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as they often aren't available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or meals out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. You're building an unforgettable future trip.

text_es: I've been saving for my next vacation for six months, and, honestly, it's not easy at all. Every month I set out to save a fixed amount, but some unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited. This is a constant challenge and I don't know if I'll make it this time. For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings went to the repair. That was a setback, but just thinking about those ten days of relaxation on the beach encourages me. Only then do I see a purpose in so much effort. I hope this time it's just a matter of tightening my belt a little more. I just have to keep the goal in mind. That trip is my main motivation, it's worth it just for that.
text_tgt_raw: Llevo seis meses ahorrando para mis próximas vacaciones y, la verdad, no es nada fácil. Este es un desafío constante y no sé si lo conseguiré esta vez. Por ejemplo, este mes se averió el coche y eso no estaba previsto, así que parte de mis ahorros se fueron a la reparación. Aquello fue un contratiempo, pero solo me anima pensar en esos diez días de relax en la playa. Solo así veo un sentido a tanto esfuerzo. Espero que esta vez solo sea cuestión de apretarme un poco más el cinturón. Solo tengo que mantener la meta en mente. Aquel viaje es mi motivación principal, solo por eso vale la pena.

Every month I set out to save a fixed amount, but some unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited. This is a constant challenge—I'm not sure if I'll make it this time! For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings went to the repair. Despite the setbacks, there's nothing that motivates me more than thinking about those 10 days of relaxation on the beach.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just about memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's about immersing oneself in the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at first, there's no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve it; it just requires dedication and constant practice; we're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. Those who embark on this adventure discover a new world. You just need to take the first step. This, ultimately, is an investment in oneself, and only time will reveal its full potential.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender un nuevo idioma es una experiencia enriquecedora que abre puertas a otras culturas y a nuevas formas de pensar. No se trata solo de memorizar vocabulario y gramática; es sumergirse en la esencia de una comunidad. Aunque al principio pueda resultar desafiante, no hay mayor recompensa que comprender y comunicarse con fluidez en otra lengua. Esto es, sin duda, una habilidad invaluable en el mundo globalizado actual. No hace falta ser un genio para lograrlo, solo requiere dedicación y práctica constante; no estamos aprendiendo a pilotar una nave espacial. Además, no tiene por qué ser una tarea solitaria; existen muchas herramientas y recursos disponibles, desde aplicaciones móviles hasta clases con profesores nativos. Aquellos que se embarcan en esta aventura descubren un mundo nuevo. Solo hace falta dar el primer paso. Esto, en definitiva, es una inversión en uno mismo, y solo el tiempo revelará todo su potencial.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's immersing oneself in the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at 1st, there's no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve it, it just requires dedication and constant practice—you're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. It's a journey that, although sometimes not easy, is always worth it.

text_es: Starting to learn a new language, in my case Mandarin Chinese, is not an easy task, I assure you. At first, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Spanish, and that's frustrating. I remember the first week with the teacher, when I tried to imitate the tones and he would tell me, "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it right, despite my effort. After three months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I understand almost nothing. It's not that I haven't learned, but that speed and context are challenges. Only constant practice can help with this. I am determined to continue, because I know that mastery only comes with constant practice. Those who persevere are the ones who succeed, and this is a path that only requires patience and dedication.
text_tgt_raw: Empezar a aprender un nuevo idioma, en mi caso el chino mandarín, no es tarea fácil, te lo aseguro. Al principio, la pronunciación me parecía imposible de dominar; no hay sonidos similares al español y eso es frustrante. Recuerdo la primera semana con el profesor, cuando intentaba imitar los tonos y él me decía: «No, no es así». Sentía que no lo hacía bien, a pesar de mi esfuerzo. Después de tres meses, por fin empecé a distinguir los tonos y las palabras, pero aun así, cuando veo una película sin subtítulos, no entiendo casi nada. No es que no haya aprendido, sino que la velocidad y el contexto son desafíos. Solo la práctica constante puede ayudar con esto. Estoy decidido a continuar, porque sé que la maestría solo llega con la práctica constante. Aquellos que perseveran son los que triunfan, y este es un camino que solo requiere paciencia y dedicación.
base_en: Starting to learn a new language, Mandarin Chinese in my case, isn't an easy task, I assure you. At 1st, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Spanish and that's frustrating. I remember the 1st week with the teacher, when I was trying to imitate the tones and he would tell me: "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it well, despite my effort. After 3 months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I don't understand almost anything. It's not that I haven't learned, but that speed and context are challenges. I'm determined to continue, because I know that mastery will come with constant practice.

text_es: Learning a new language is a rewarding experience, although it's not something that happens overnight. All it takes is consistency and patience; don't despair if you find it difficult at first. Immersion is key: listen to music, watch series or movies in their original version with subtitles, and try to speak from day one, even if it's just a few words. This is fundamental. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; you are learning and making mistakes is part of the process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't a perfect methodology for everyone; only you can experiment and discover what works best for you. That is a personal journey. You will see that with dedication, your progress has no limits and soon you will communicate fluently. It's just a matter of time and effort.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender un nuevo idioma es una experiencia gratificante, aunque no es algo que ocurra de la noche a la mañana. Solo hace falta constancia y paciencia; no te desesperes si al principio lo encuentras difícil. La inmersión es clave: escucha música, ve series o películas en versión original con subtítulos y trata de hablar desde el primer día, aunque sean solo unas pocas palabras. Esto es fundamental. No subestimes el poder de los errores; estás aprendiendo y equivocarse es parte del proceso, así que no temas cometerlos. Además, no hay una metodología perfecta para todos; solo tú puedes experimentar y descubrir qué te funciona mejor. Aquel es un camino personal. Verás que con dedicación, tu progreso no tiene límites y pronto te comunicarás con fluidez. Solo es cuestión de tiempo y esfuerzo.
base_en: Learning a new language is a very rewarding experience, but it's not something that happens overnight. You need consistency and patience; don't despair if it seems difficult at 1st. Immersion is key: listen to music, watch series or movies in their original version with subtitles, and try to speak from the 1st day, even if it's just a few words—that's essential. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; you're learning and making mistakes is part of the process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one single perfect methodology for everyone, experiment, and discover what works best for you. You'll see that with dedication, your progress has no limits and soon you'll be communicating fluently.

text_es: Participating in a popular race means immersing yourself in a non-professional sporting event, open to everyone regardless of their physical level; it's not an elite competition. Typically, pre-established distances like 5 km or 10 km are covered on urban streets or trails, and there's no age limit to sign up. The main goal is usually just to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a charitable cause; it's not just about achieving a personal best. Registration isn't excessively expensive and usually includes a bib number, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests; this is something I really like. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and the encouragement of the crowd make it a very rewarding experience; you just have to try it. Those who have already done it know that the only ones who regret it are those who don't dare.
text_tgt_raw: Participar en una carrera popular es sumergirse en un evento deportivo no profesional, abierto a todos sin importar su nivel físico; no es una competición de élite. Normalmente, se cubren distancias preestablecidas como 5 km o 10 km por calles urbanas o senderos, y no hay límite de edad para apuntarse. El objetivo principal suele ser solo disfrutar de la experiencia, fomentar hábitos saludables y, en muchos casos, apoyar una causa benéfica; no es solo para lograr una marca personal. La inscripción no es excesivamente cara y suele incluir un dorsal, una camiseta conmemorativa y avituallamiento. Es una excelente oportunidad para socializar y conocer gente con intereses afines; esto es algo que me gusta mucho. Además, el ambiente festivo y el ánimo de la gente lo convierten en una experiencia muy gratificante; solo hace falta intentarlo. Aquellos que ya lo han hecho saben que solo se arrepienten los que no se animan.

Normally, predefined distances like 5 km or 10 km are covered through urban streets or paths, and there's no age limit to participate. The main objective is usually to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a charitable cause; it isn't just for a personal best. Registration isn't excessively expensive and usually includes a bib, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests—this is something I really like. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and the encouragement of the people make it a very rewarding experience; you won't regret it.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that not only recovers its original beauty but also prolongs its useful life. It is not a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous steps, from a deep cleaning and the repair of structural damage to sanding and the application of new finishes. It is crucial to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the appropriate products, since not all are compatible with every material; only then can good results be guaranteed. Often, this is a job that requires patience and skill, and one should not be afraid to ask for help if unsure, only humility is needed. Nor should one forget that traditional techniques are usually the ones that offer the best results, although they are not always the fastest. The ultimate goal is to return its splendor without erasing the traces of time that give it character; it's not just about making it look fresh out of the factory. He who seeks perfection without history does not understand the value of the antique.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar un mueble antiguo es un proceso gratificante que no solo recupera su belleza original, sino que también prolonga su vida útil. No es una tarea sencilla, pues implica una serie de pasos meticulosos, desde una limpieza profunda y la reparación de daños estructurales hasta el lijado y la aplicación de nuevos acabados. Es crucial identificar el tipo de madera y el acabado original para elegir los productos adecuados, ya que no todos son compatibles con cada material; solo así se garantizan buenos resultados. A menudo, este es un trabajo que requiere paciencia y destreza, y uno no debe temer pedir ayuda si no está seguro, solo hace falta humildad. Tampoco hay que olvidar que las técnicas tradicionales suelen ser las que ofrecen los mejores resultados, aunque no siempre son las más rápidas. El objetivo final es devolverle el esplendor sin borrar las huellas del tiempo que le dan carácter; no se trata solo de que parezca recién salido de fábrica. Aquel que busca la perfección sin historia, no entiende el valor de lo antiguo.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that not only recovers its original beauty, but also extends its useful life. It isn't a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous steps, from deep cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and applying new finishes. It's important to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the right products, since not all of them are compatible with every material. Often, this is a job that requires patience and skill, and one shouldn't be afraid to ask for help if one isn't sure. Nor should one forget that traditional techniques are usually the ones that offer the best results, although they aren't always the fastest. The final goal is to return the furniture to its splendor without erasing the traces of time that give it character; it isn't about making it look factory new.

text_es: I remember the first time I tried to restore an antique piece of furniture; it was a learning experience. This was a small dresser from my grandmother and, to be honest, it wasn't in very good condition. The drawers didn't close properly and the wood didn't have a uniform color; it seemed to have a thousand stories to tell. At first, I only knew that I wanted to do it, but this didn't discourage me; I just needed to look for online tutorials and ask a friend who knows about these things. I am proud of the result; although it's not perfect, it has great sentimental value for me. That piece is no longer in the attic; now it looks beautiful in the living room and there isn't a day that I don't look at it with affection. Just this alone makes it valuable. Just thinking about it, I smile. There is only one rule: enjoy the process.
text_tgt_raw: Recuerdo la primera vez que intenté restaurar un mueble antiguo; fue una experiencia de aprendizaje. Los cajones no cerraban bien y la madera no tenía un color uniforme, parecía tener mil historias que contar. text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture, my first recommendation is to be well-informed; this is not a task to be taken lightly. Only then can costly mistakes be avoided. Start by researching the style and wood, as this is fundamental for choosing the right products and not damaging the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key. If you don't have a suitable space or basic tools, wait; anyone who starts without preparation will only get frustrated. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is; this is the most important thing. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface; only this way will you know how the wood will react. If the furniture has woodworm, do not try to restore it without thoroughly treating it first; otherwise, it could spread. Remember that it's not just about painting, but about restoring its essence, and this requires patience and knowledge.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar un mueble antiguo, mi primera recomendación es informarse bien; esto no es una tarea que deba tomarse a la ligera. Solo así se evitan errores costosos. Empiece investigando el estilo y la madera, pues esto es fundamental para elegir los productos adecuados y no dañar la pieza. No se apresure; una buena planificación es clave. Si no tiene un espacio adecuado o las herramientas básicas, espere; aquel que empieza sin preparación solo se frustrará. Un taller grande no es esencial, pero sí un área ventilada y limpia; esto es lo más importante. Siempre haga pruebas en una parte oculta antes de aplicar cualquier producto a la superficie principal, solo de esta forma sabrá cómo reaccionará la madera. Si el mueble tiene carcoma, no intente restaurarlo sin tratarla a fondo primero; de no ser así, aquella podría extenderse. Recuerde que no se trata solo de pintar, sino de restaurar su esencia, y esto requiere paciencia y conocimiento.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, my 1st recommendation is to inform yourself well; it's not a task that should be taken lightly. Start by researching the style and the wood, as this is fundamental for choosing the right products and not damaging the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key; if there isn't adequate space or you don't have the basic tools, wait. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface, because you don't know how the wood will react. If the furniture has woodworm, don't try to restore it without 1st treating it thoroughly—you don't want it to spread. Remember that it's not just about painting, but about restoring its essence.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting task, although it only seems simple if one seeks perfection in every detail. First, you just need to define the theme, the budget, and the guest list; this shouldn't be excessively long if you want something intimate. The choice of venue is key, as celebrating at home is not the same as renting a space; that implies more planning. You also have to consider the food and drinks –just remember possible allergies–, as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain the attendees, it's a good idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children; this guarantees fun. Don't forget the music to liven up the atmosphere. Only then, with good organization, will the host be able to fully enjoy the celebration; that is, not just the guests.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños es una tarea emocionante, aunque solo parece sencilla si uno busca la perfección en cada detalle. Primero, solo hace falta definir el tema, el presupuesto y la lista de invitados; esta no debe ser excesivamente larga si se desea algo íntimo. La elección del lugar es clave, ya que no es lo mismo celebrar en casa que alquilar un espacio; aquello implica más planificación. También hay que considerar la comida y las bebidas –solo recuerde las posibles alergias–, así como la decoración para crear la atmósfera deseada. Para entretener a los asistentes, es buena idea planificar juegos o actividades, especialmente si hay niños; esto garantiza la diversión. No se olvide de la música para animar el ambiente. Solo así, con buena organización, el anfitrión podrá disfrutar plenamente de la celebración; es decir, no solo los invitados.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting task, although it isn't as simple as it seems if you want everything to turn out perfectly. 1st, you must decide on the theme, the budget, and the guest list, which shouldn't be excessively long if you're looking for something intimate. The choice of venue is key, as celebrating at home isn't the same as renting a space; this is something that requires planning. You also have to think about the food and drinks—don't forget allergies—as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain the attendees, it's a good idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children, and it doesn't hurt to consider some music to set the mood. Finally, I'm sure that good organization guarantees that the host can also enjoy the celebration.

text_es: Organizing my 30th birthday party was an odyssey; it wasn't easy at all. First, the guest list: who invites 30 people without breaking a sweat? Then, the venue. I don't have a huge yard, so I looked for a place with enough capacity for everyone; this is the most complicated part, honestly. A place for 10 isn't the same as one for 30. I just wanted everyone to have a good seat. The catering wasn't simple either; I could only decide between pizza or paella. In the end, I opted for a mix to please everyone, though only time will tell if it was the best idea. That's what really matters, right? Only my friends' fun is what counts. That's the main thing, so all that's left is to hope the party is a success.

text_es: Caring for houseplants isn't as complex as it seems, but it does require attention and basic knowledge. The first thing to consider is light; only some plants tolerate direct sun, and many others only thrive with indirect light, so it's essential to research the specific needs of each species to avoid burns or poor growth. Watering is equally crucial: there's no fixed rule, as it depends on the type of plant, pot size, and season. However, in general, it's better to underwater than overwater. Additionally, and this is important, ambient humidity and temperature are factors that cannot be ignored, especially for tropical plants; these usually demand a warmer and more humid environment. Finally, don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer; only then will you give them the nutrients they don't find in potting soil. Those who ignore these simple steps will see their plants suffer, while those who follow them will enjoy lush greenery. This is just a summary, but it covers the essentials.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar plantas de interior no es tan complejo como parece, pero si requiere atención y conocimientos básicos. Lo primero a considerar es la luz; solo algunas plantas toleran el sol directo y muchas otras solo prosperan con luz indirecta, por lo que es esencial investigar las necesidades específicas de cada especie para evitar quemaduras o un crecimiento deficiente. El riego es igualmente crucial: no existe una regla fija, ya que este depende del tipo de planta, el tamaño de la maceta y la estación. Sin embargo, en general, es mejor regar menos que en exceso. Ademas, y esto es importante, la humedad ambiental y la temperatura son factores que no pueden ignorarse, sobre todo para las plantas tropicales; estas suelen demandar un ambiente más cálido y húmedo. Finalmente, no olvides la fertilización ocasional, sobre todo en primavera y verano; solo asi les darás los nutrientes que no encuentran en la tierra para macetas. Aquellos que ignoren estos pasos simples verán sus plantas sufrir, mientras que quienes los sigan disfrutarán de una vegetación exuberante. Esto es solo un resumen, pero cubre lo esencial.
base_en: Caring for houseplants isn't as complicated as it seems, but it does require attention and basic knowledge. The 1st thing to consider is light; not all plants need the same intensity, so it's essential to research the specific needs of each species so they don't burn or fail to grow. Watering is also crucial: there isn't a fixed rule, as this depends on the type of plant, the size of the pot, and the season, but in general, it's better to water less than excessively. Furthermore—this is important—ambient humidity and temperature are factors that can't be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer, to provide them with the nutrients they don't find in the potting soil.

text_es: Caring for houseplants, for me, isn't just a hobby; it's almost a philosophy of life. I remember that at first, this wasn't easy; my first two plants, poor things, didn't survive more than three weeks because I simply didn't know their needs. Now, after about five years, my house is a jungle; I have about twenty plants and each one has its own personality and its peculiarities, I swear this isn't an exaggeration. If one isn't happy, it "tells" me immediately with its leaves, and I, of course, am always attentive to those small details so that bigger problems don't arise. It's not as complicated as it seems at first, you just have to observe them and give them a little love. Whoever commits to this will notice the difference. Only then is success achieved.

text_es: To successfully care for houseplants, you don't need to overcomplicate things at first. The fundamental thing is that they are not accustomed to the outdoors, so they only need a stable environment. This is crucial: research two or three basic needs of each plant you acquire—light, watering, temperature—because not all of them are the same. Don't overwater; it's the primary cause of death and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I only advise you to touch the soil to check if it's dry before adding water. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it and only thrive that way. I am sure that with these basic tips, your plants will thrive and you won't have problems. This is a good starting point, and whoever follows it will be successful.
text_tgt_raw: Para cuidar con éxito las plantas de interior, no hay que complicarse al principio. Lo fundamental es que no están acostumbradas al exterior, por lo que solo necesitan un ambiente estable. Esto es crucial: investigue dos o tres necesidades básicas de cada planta que adquiera —luz, riego, temperatura— porque no todas son iguales. No riegue en exceso; es la primera causa de muerte y no es fácil revivirlas después. Solo le aconsejo tocar la tierra para comprobar si está seca antes de añadir agua. No olvide la humedad ambiental; algunas plantas no la toleran bien, pero otras la necesitan y solo así prosperan. Estoy seguro de que con estos consejos básicos, sus plantas prosperarán y no tendrá problemas. Este es un buen punto de partida, y aquel que lo siga tendrá éxito.

This is crucial: research 2 or 3 basic needs of each plant you acquire—light, watering, temperature—because not all of them are the same. Don't overwater; it's the 1st cause of death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I advise you to touch the soil to check if it's dry before adding water. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it. I'm sure that with these basic tips, your plants will thrive, and you won't have problems.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is not something to be taken lightly, as it directly affects the quality of our rest and, therefore, our health. To begin, one only needs to consider firmness, which is not the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. Nor can we forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of these, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Furthermore, it's crucial to think about sleeping posture—sleeping on your back is not the same as sleeping on your side—and whether the bed is shared, as it's not always easy to please two people. Only this discernment process ensures a good purchase. Finally, let's not underestimate the importance of trying it out for a few minutes in the store; only then will we know if it's the right one, because what seems good in theory sometimes isn't.
text_tgt_raw: La elección de un colchón no es algo que deba tomarse a la ligera, pues incide directamente en la calidad de nuestro descanso y, por ende, en nuestra salud. Para empezar, solo hay que considerar la firmeza, que no es igual para todos; algunos preferirán una más dura, mientras que otros se sentirán mejor en una más blanda. Tampoco podemos olvidar el material: hay opciones de muelles, viscoelástica, látex o una combinación de estos, y cada uno tiene sus propias características de soporte y transpirabilidad. Además, es crucial pensar en la postura al dormir —no es lo mismo hacerlo boca arriba que de lado— y si se comparte la cama, ya que no siempre es fácil complacer a dos personas. Solo este proceso de discernimiento asegura una buena compra. Finalmente, no subestimemos la importancia de probarlo unos minutos en la tienda; solo así sabremos si este es el adecuado, porque lo que en teoría parece bien, a veces no lo es.

It's essential to consider several factors, such as the type of firmness, which isn't the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. Also, we can't forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of them, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Furthermore, it's important to consider our sleeping position—sleeping on your back isn't the same as sleeping on your side—and if we share the bed, since it's not always easy to please 2 people. Finally, we shouldn't underestimate the importance of trying the mattress for a few minutes in the store; you don't know how you'll feel until you try it.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, don't rush; it's just an important decision, not just any purchase. Think about your sleeping position—whether it's on your side, back, or stomach—because that's key for the support you require. Don't forget to try it for about ten or fifteen minutes in the store; truly, there's no better way to know if you'll feel comfortable. Furthermore, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, because that one won't always be ideal, nor will this one that is extremely soft.

Also, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, since the softest or hardest isn't always ideal.

text_es: Reducing food waste is an imperative for sustainability; only then will we benefit the environment and our economy. It is not a minor problem, as one-third of all food produced globally is lost or discarded annually. This data is truly alarming if we consider that many people still lack access to adequate food. We only need to remember that food production consumes huge amounts of resources like water and energy, and its waste only implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There is no single solution, but we can start with a better script for our shopping, proper storage, and using leftovers; this is not as complicated as it seems. It is essential to raise awareness in society about this global challenge; only then can we change course. Those who ignore this will pay a high price. We prefer this solution.
text_tgt_raw: Reducir el desperdicio alimentario es un imperativo para la sostenibilidad; solo así beneficiaremos al medio ambiente y nuestra economía. No es un problema menor, pues anualmente se pierde o desecha un tercio de toda la comida producida globalmente. Este dato es realmente alarmante si consideramos que aún hay muchas personas sin acceso a una alimentación adecuada. Solo hace falta recordar que la producción de alimentos consume ingentes cantidades de recursos como agua y energía, y su desperdicio solo implica ineficiencia en toda la cadena. No existe una solución única, pero podemos empezar con un mejor guion para nuestras compras, un almacenamiento adecuado y el aprovechamiento de sobras; este no es tan complicado como parece. Es fundamental concienciar a la sociedad sobre este desafío global; solo así podremos cambiar el rumbo. Aquellos que ignoren esto pagarán un precio alto. Preferimos esta solución.
base_en: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainability; it not only benefits the environment but also has a positive economic impact. It isn't a minor problem, as 1/3 of all food produced globally is lost or wasted annually. This is alarming if we consider that many people don't have access to adequate food. We can't ignore that food production consumes large quantities of resources like water and energy, and its waste implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There isn't a single solution, but we can start by better planning purchases, properly storing food, and utilizing leftovers; it isn't as complicated as it seems. It's important to raise awareness in society about this global challenge; we can't afford to continue with this unsustainable consumption rate.

text_es: The other day, while preparing dinner for four people, I realized how much food we were going to throw away if I didn't change my habits. Only at that moment did I understand what reducing waste really means. Before, I didn't care too much if there was something left over; I thought it wasn't a problem, that it wasn't such a big deal. However, now I don't see it that way. I decided I couldn't continue with that attitude, so I started planning meals better and being more creative with leftovers; that's something we should all do. For example, with the roasted chicken from one day, I didn't throw away what was left, but instead, the next day I made some delicious croquettes; I'm very proud of that invention! Really, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as it seems, and the planet will only thank us for it. It just takes a little ingenuity, this is my main advice. Those who start doing it will notice the difference.
text_tgt_raw: El otro día, preparando cena para cuatro personas, me di cuenta de la cantidad de comida que íbamos a desechar si no cambiaba mis hábitos. Solo en ese instante comprendí lo que realmente significa reducir el desperdicio. Antes, no me importaba demasiado si sobraba algo; pensaba que no era un problema, que no es algo tan grave. Sin embargo, ahora no lo veo así. Decidí que no podía continuar con esa actitud, de modo que empecé a planificar mejor las comidas y a ser más creativa con las sobras; eso es algo que todos deberíamos hacer. Por ejemplo, con el pollo asado de un día, no tiré lo que quedó, sino que al día siguiente hice unas deliciosas croquetas; ¡estoy muy orgullosa de esa invención! Realmente, reducir el desperdicio de alimentos no es tan difícil como parece, y el planeta solo va a agradecérnoslo. Solo hace falta un poco de ingenio, este es mi consejo principal. Aquellos que empiezan a hacerlo notarán la diferencia.

text_es: To reduce food waste, good planning is crucial; it’s not as complex as it seems, and the benefit is enormous. Before going shopping, you just need to thoroughly check the fridge and pantry—this way you’ll avoid duplicate purchases—and make a list of what you really need; this is essential to avoid overspending. Once at the supermarket, don't get carried away by offers you won't fully use, and remember that bigger isn't always better if you don't consume it later. At home, organize foods so that older products or those with approaching expiration dates are more accessible; this will only take a few minutes. text_es: Painting a room is not a complex task if one organizes well. To begin, you just need to prepare the surface, which is not always pleasant, but it is essential: clean the walls, patch holes or cracks, and sand if necessary. Don't forget to protect the floor and furniture with tarps or plastic; this is a crucial step to avoid stains, as only then can a good result be ensured. Then, we select the appropriate paint and tools; using a roller is not the same as using a brush for the edges. Normally, two or three coats of paint are applied, allowing drying time between each one; only then is a good finish achieved. Those who put effort into this know that the final result is gratifying, as only a change of this type can completely transform a space.
text_tgt_raw: Pintar una habitación no es una tarea compleja si uno se organiza bien. Para empezar, solo hace falta preparar la superficie, lo cual no es siempre agradable, pero es esencial: limpiar las paredes, resanar agujeros o grietas y lijar si es preciso. No hay que olvidar proteger el suelo y los muebles con lonas o plásticos; este es un paso crucial para evitar manchas, pues solo así se asegura un buen resultado. Luego, seleccionamos la pintura y las herramientas adecuadas; aquel, usar un rodillo, no es lo mismo que utilizar una brocha para los bordes. Normalmente se aplican dos o tres capas de pintura, permitiendo el tiempo de secado entre cada una; solo así se logra un buen acabado. Aquellos que se esmeran en esto, saben que el resultado final es gratificante, pues solo un cambio de este tipo puede transformar un espacio por completo.

text_es: Last week it was my turn to paint the guest room, although it's not my favorite hobby. text_es: When painting a room, only good planning is crucial; it's not just choosing a color. First, gather all the materials: paint, brushes, rollers, painter's tape, and protective plastic sheets. This is essential for a clean and professional finish. Afterward, prepare the surface; clean it well, repair any imperfections, and lightly sand it for better paint adhesion. Only then will you achieve the desired result. Don't underestimate protecting furniture and floors; they need to be covered. Only after these preparations can you begin. Start with the ceiling, then the walls, and finally the baseboards; this way, you won't drip paint on already painted surfaces. Usually, a second coat is needed, but this isn't always necessary; it just depends on the color and quality. You'll see it's not as complicated as it seems!

text_es: Starting to meditate is not as complicated as it seems and doesn't require prior experience. It's an ancient practice that offers countless benefits for mental and physical health, and this is not a myth. To begin, you just need to find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed, sit comfortably—a specific posture isn't necessary—and close your eyes. The key is to concentrate on your breathing, feeling how the air enters and leaves; don't worry if your mind wanders, that's normal. When that happens, just redirect your attention to your breath without judging yourself; you're not there to evaluate yourself. You don't have to meditate for a whole hour at once; just 5 or 10 minutes a day is an excellent start to establish the habit. Anyone who tries it will only find that it changes their life.

Es una práctica milenaria que ofrece incontables beneficios para la salud mental y física, y esto no es un mito. Para empezar, solo hace falta encontrar un lugar tranquilo donde no te molesten, sentarte cómodamente –una postura específica no es necesaria– y cerrar los ojos. La clave es concentrarse en la respiración, sintiendo cómo el aire entra y sale; no te preocupes si tu mente divaga, es normal. Cuando eso ocurra, solo redirige tu atención a la respiración sin juzgarte; no estás ahí para evaluarte. No tienes que meditar una hora entera de golpe, solo 5 o 10 minutos al día son un excelente comienzo para establecer el hábito. Aquel que pruebe, solo comprobará que esto le cambia la vida.

text_es: I started meditating about three months ago, and the truth is that it wasn't easy at first. My mind wasn't used to staying still; I didn't know how to achieve it. The first few days I felt a little frustrated because my thoughts wouldn't stop; they told me this is common. My concentration wasn't very good; I could only focus on my breathing for no more than thirty seconds. Now, it's not that I'm an expert, but I can stay calm for ten minutes straight without a problem. It just takes practice, that's all. This is a very useful tool for managing stress; I think it's something everyone should try. Whoever tries it just needs patience. With just a little consistency, the results are noticeable.

text_es: When preparing for a job interview, the first thing you shouldn't forget is to thoroughly research the company. This will not only help you answer better, but it also shows your genuine interest, and that is vital. Review the job description and think of two or three concrete examples where your skills perfectly match what they are looking for. There's nothing worse than appearing unprepared; therefore, practice your answers to common questions and don't forget to prepare three or four intelligent questions to ask the interviewer. Remember that it's not just an evaluation of you; you are also evaluating whether the company is the right place for you. Finally, don't underestimate the importance of punctuality and a good appearance: these always earn points, and with just this, you already have an advantage. All that's left is to wish you luck.

Revise la descripción del puesto y piense en dos o tres ejemplos concretos donde sus habilidades encajen perfectamente con lo que buscan. No hay nada peor que parecer poco preparado; por eso, practique sus respuestas a preguntas comunes y no olvide preparar tres o cuatro preguntas inteligentes para hacer al entrevistador. text_es: Building a safe bonfire is only the first step to enjoying it without risks, as this is not an activity to be taken lightly. Before lighting it, check that there are no local restrictions, as it is not always permitted. You just need to choose a clear spot, away from dry vegetation, buildings, or any flammable material; we don't want surprises. Also, make sure there isn't strong wind. Clear an area of at least 3 meters in diameter around it, digging a shallow pit or delimiting the space with stones; this is a crucial step to contain the flames. You just need to have water, sand, or a fire extinguisher nearby, because you never know if a spark will fly. When the bonfire is not in use, you just have to extinguish it completely; this is vital to prevent fires. Those who ignore these recommendations put everyone in danger.
text_tgt_raw: Hacer una hoguera segura es solo el primer paso para disfrutarla sin riesgos, pues esto no es una actividad que deba tomarse a la ligera. Antes de encenderla, verifica que no existan restricciones locales, ya que no siempre está permitido. Solo es necesario elegir un lugar despejado, lejos de vegetación seca, edificaciones o cualquier material inflamable; no queremos sorpresas. Asegúrate también de que no haya viento fuerte. Despeja un área de al menos 3 metros de diámetro alrededor, cavando un hoyo superficial o delimitando el espacio con piedras; este es un paso crucial para contener las llamas. Solo hace falta tener agua, arena o un extintor cerca, pues nunca sabes si saltará una chispa. Cuando la hoguera no esté en uso, solo tienes que extinguirla por completo; esto es vital para prevenir incendios. Aquellos que ignoren estas recomendaciones ponen en peligro a todos.

Always keep water, sand, or an extinguisher nearby, as you can't predict if a spark will jump. When the bonfire isn't in use, make sure to extinguish it completely; this is vital to prevent fires.

text_es: I’ve always liked bonfires, especially on cool summer nights, but I take this very seriously; it’s not a game. Two summers ago, I was with four friends in a rural area and we wanted to make one. The first thing was to choose a clear spot, far from trees and bushes; only then do we avoid a fire; this is a fundamental step. Then, with a shovel, we removed the superficial layer of vegetation and dug a small hole about 15 cm deep to contain the embers, since that’s the only way to control the fire. We didn’t use flammable liquids; that’s very dangerous; only small pieces of dry wood and tinder, and we always kept a bucket of water and a shovel nearby, because we’re not willing to take risks. After enjoying it for a while, we made sure there wasn’t a single ember lit before leaving; this isn’t difficult if you put in the effort. In fact, it only takes a little dedication to avoid any danger. Those who ignore these precautions only expose themselves to problems.
text_tgt_raw: Siempre me han gustado las hogueras, sobre todo en noches frescas de verano, pero me tomo esto muy en serio, no es un juego. Hace dos veranos, estaba con cuatro amigos en una zona rural y queríamos hacer una. Lo primero fue elegir un lugar despejado, lejos de árboles y arbustos, solo así evitamos un incendio; este es un paso fundamental. Luego, con una pala, retiramos la capa superficial de vegetación y cavamos un pequeño hoyo de unos 15 cm de profundidad para contener las brasas, ya que solo así se controla el fuego. No usamos líquidos inflamables, eso es muy peligroso, solo pequeños trozos de madera seca y yesca, y siempre mantuvimos un cubo de agua y una pala cerca, pues no estamos dispuestos a correr riesgos. Después de disfrutar un rato, nos aseguramos de que no quedara ni una sola brasa encendida antes de irnos; esto no es difícil si se pone el esfuerzo. De hecho, solo hace falta un poco de dedicación para evitar cualquier peligro. Aquellos que ignoren estas precauciones solo se exponen a problemas.

Then, with a shovel, we removed the superficial layer of vegetation and dug a small pit about 15 cm deep to contain the embers, since you shouldn't leave the fire uncontrolled. After enjoying ourselves for a while, we made sure there wasn't a single ember left burning before we left; it isn't difficult if you put in the effort.

text_es: To make a safe campfire, you just need to follow a few steps. First, find a clear spot; there shouldn't be dry branches hanging or tall vegetation around, as fire spreads quickly. It's essential to clearly mark the area with stones; this measure is key so that the flames don't spread. Before lighting it, just make sure you have water or sand nearby in case the fire gets out of control; it's not a game, and prevention is the most important thing. This is a vital tip that many ignore. Never abandon a lit campfire; we cannot underestimate the risk. When you're done, extinguish it completely and check that no embers remain; if you still see smoke, it just means it's not completely out. Avoid lighting a campfire on very windy days; that can lead to a forest fire. Those who disobey these rules just put the environment at risk.
text_tgt_raw: Para hacer una fogata segura, solo hace falta seguir unos pocos pasos. Primero, busca un lugar despejado; no debe haber ramas secas colgando ni vegetación alta alrededor, ya que el fuego se propaga con rapidez. Es fundamental demarcar claramente el área con piedras; esta medida es clave para que las llamas no se extiendan. Antes de encenderla, solo asegúrate de tener agua o arena cerca por si el fuego se descontrola; no es un juego, y la prevención es lo más importante. Este es un consejo vital que muchos ignoran. Nunca abandones una fogata encendida; no podemos subestimar el riesgo. Cuando termines, apágala por completo y verifica que no queden brasas; si aun ves humo, solo significa que no está apagada del todo. Evita encender una fogata en días de mucho viento; aquel puede llevar a un incendio forestal. Aquellos que desobedecen estas normas, solo ponen en riesgo el entorno.
base_en: To make a safe bonfire, 1st, look for a clear spot; there shouldn't be dry branches hanging or tall vegetation around—fire spreads quickly. It's vital to clearly mark off the area with stones, so it won't spread; that's a fundamental preventive measure. Before lighting it, make sure you've water or sand nearby in case the fire gets out of control; it's not a game, and prevention is key. Never abandon a lit bonfire; we can't underestimate the risk. When you're done, extinguish it completely and verify that no embers remain; it's not out if you still see smoke. Don't start a fire on strong windy days; don't risk a forest fire.

text_es: Setting up an aquarium is not an easy task, but the reward is great if done correctly. It only requires planning, starting with choosing the type of aquarium—freshwater or saltwater—and its size, which for beginners should not be less than 60 liters. It is vital to research the desired fish and plants, as not all are compatible with each other; this is not just a matter of fish dying. Then, the water must be conditioned and the nitrogen cycle established, a process that is not quick and can last several weeks; there are no shortcuts here, only patience. This involves introducing beneficial bacteria that will transform toxic waste into less harmful substances for the inhabitants. Finally, the gradual introduction of fish is crucial once the ecosystem is stable; we cannot rush. Anyone who skips this step will have problems. Furthermore, not only the installation is important, but also regular maintenance.
text_tgt_raw: Montar un acuario no es tarea sencilla, pero la recompensa es grande si se hace correctamente. Solo requiere planificación, empezando por elegir el tipo de acuario —dulce o salado— y su tamaño, que para principiantes no debería ser inferior a 60 litros. Es vital investigar los peces y plantas deseados, ya que no todos son compatibles entre sí; esto no es solo cuestión de que los peces mueran. Luego, hay que acondicionar el agua y establecer el ciclo del nitrógeno, un proceso que no es rápido y puede durar varias semanas; aquí no hay atajos, solo paciencia. Esto implica introducir bacterias beneficiosas que transformarán los desechos tóxicos en sustancias menos dañinas para los habitantes. Finalmente, es crucial la introducción gradual de los peces, una vez que el ecosistema esté estable; no podemos apresurarnos. Aquel que obvie este paso tendrá problemas. Además, no solo la instalación es importante, también el mantenimiento regular.

It's crucial to research the fish and plants you want to have, as not all of them are compatible with each other, and it's not a matter of the fish dying. Afterward, the water must be conditioned and the nitrogen cycle established, a process that isn't quick and can last several weeks; there are no shortcuts in this phase. This involves introducing beneficial bacteria that will transform toxic waste into less harmful substances for the inhabitants. text_es: Setting up my first aquarium was quite an adventure, I assure you. At first, I only knew that I didn't know where to start; it's an overwhelming amount of information. I remember spending three days reading forums and watching videos, and this isn't something you do without preparation. Choosing the size, a minimum of sixty liters, and the type of fish, since not all are compatible, took me weeks. It's not that I had a large budget, so everything was done calmly; only then could I move forward. Filtration is crucial, there's no arguing about that, and the water cycling lasted twenty days. Only with patience can you achieve this. I'm happy with the result; now I have seven freshwater fish and the plants are growing phenomenally. Those who venture into this will see that it's just a matter of dedication.

Solo con paciencia se consigue esto. Estoy contento con el resultado; ahora tengo siete peces de agua dulce y las plantas crecen fenomenalmente. Aquellos que se aventuren en esto, veran que solo es cuestion de dedicacion.

text_es: Maintaining a bicycle is essential to ensure its durability, safety, and optimal performance. Only then will we avoid problems. This involves a series of regular tasks—some daily, others less frequent—that any cyclist should know. Fundamentally, you only need to check tire pressure before each ride to prevent flats; this is a simple step. Similarly, it is crucial to keep the chain clean and lubricated, especially after riding in wet conditions, to prevent rust and premature wear of drivetrain components. That avoids trips to the shop. The brakes, both pads and cables, require periodic inspections to ensure adequate response and rider safety; this alone is vital. Additionally, checking the tightness of screws, particularly on the handlebars and seat post, is a simple step that prevents accidents. That is an important part of the routine. Preventive maintenance, performed by oneself or by a professional from time to time, will extend the bicycle's lifespan and the cycling experience.
text_tgt_raw: Mantener una bicicleta es esencial para asegurar su durabilidad, seguridad y rendimiento optimo. Solo asi evitaremos problemas. Esto implica una serie de tareas regulares —algunas diarias, otras menos frecuentes— que cualquier ciclista deberia conocer. Fundamentalmente, solo hace falta revisar la presion de los neumaticos antes de cada salida para prevenir pinchazos; este es un paso simple. De igual modo, es crucial mantener la cadena limpia y lubricada, especialmente despues de rodar en condiciones humedas, para prevenir oxido y el desgaste prematuro de los componentes de la transmision. Aquello evita visitas al taller. Los frenos, tanto pastillas como cables, requieren inspecciones periodicas para asegurar una respuesta adecuada y la seguridad del ciclista; solo esto es vital. Ademas, verificar el ajuste de los tornillos, particularmente en el manillar y la tija del sillin, es un paso sencillo que previene accidentes. Esa es una parte importante de la rutina. El mantenimiento preventivo, realizado por uno mismo o por un profesional de vez en cuando, prolongara la vida util de la bicicleta y la experiencia ciclista.
base_en: Maintaining a bicycle is essential to ensure its durability, safety, and optimal performance. It involves a series of regular tasks—some daily, others less frequent—that any cyclist should know. Fundamentally, tire pressure—usually indicated on the sidewall—should be checked before each ride to prevent punctures and improve efficiency. Likewise, it's crucial to keep the chain clean and lubricated—especially after riding in wet conditions—to prevent rust and premature wear of the drivetrain components. The brakes—both pads and cables—require periodic inspections to ensure adequate response and rider safety. Additionally, checking the tightness of the screws—particularly on the handlebars and seat post—is a simple step that prevents accidents. Preventive maintenance—performed by oneself or by a professional every so often—will extend the bicycle's lifespan and the cycling experience.

text_es: For me, bicycle maintenance is true therapy, an activity that only brings me satisfaction. I remember the first time I dared to remove the chain; that seemed like a titanic task, but the result was immense satisfaction and a bicycle that rode like never before. Just from that experience, I learned that every 500 km, approximately, it's crucial to check the brakes and adjust the spoke tension. This step alone has saved me from several scares on the road. I also discovered that a good chain lubricant, not just any oil, makes a huge difference in the performance and lifespan of the components. For me, dedicating one or two hours a month to this kind of care is a worthwhile investment, not only for extending the life of my machine, but for the pure pleasure of feeling it perfect under my feet. That is the true value of dedicating myself to it.
text_tgt_raw: Para mí, el mantenimiento de la bicicleta es una verdadera terapia, una actividad que solo me produce satisfacción. También descubrí que un buen lubricante para la cadena, no cualquier aceite, marca una enorme diferencia en el rendimiento y la vida útil de los componentes. Para mí, dedicar una o dos horas al mes a este tipo de cuidado es una inversión que vale la pena, no solo por extender la vida de mi máquina, sino por el puro placer de sentirla perfecta bajo mis pies. Ese es el verdadero valor de dedicarme a ella.
