Finally, I crossed the finish line, a personal achievement, exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today. Only those who have experienced it can understand. This is a memory I treasure.
text_tgt_raw: La primera vez que decidí correr una carrera popular, una experiencia que siempre quise vivir, fue un desafío inesperado. Me inscribí solo tres semanas antes, sin mucha preparación, solo un poco de trote diario, y la verdad es que subestimé la dificultad. El día de la carrera, un soleado domingo de primavera, el ambiente era electrizante, con gente animando por todas partes. Al principio todo iba bien, sentía la energía del grupo, pero alrededor del kilómetro cinco mis piernas empezaron a flaquear, los gemelos me ardían. Recuerdo que pensé en abandonar, estaba agotado, pero ver a los otros corredores y el apoyo del público me dio fuerzas para continuar. Eso fue lo que me impulsó. Finalmente, crucé la meta, un logro personal, exhausto, pero con una inmensa satisfacción que aún me acompaña hoy. Solo aquellos que lo han vivido pueden entenderlo. Este es un recuerdo que atesoro.
base_en: The 1st time I decided to run a popular race—an experience I always wanted to have—it was an unexpected challenge. I signed up 3 weeks before, without much preparation—just a little daily jogging—and the truth is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day—a sunny spring Sunday—the atmosphere was electrifying, with people cheering everywhere. At 1st everything went well—I felt the group's energy—but around km 5 my legs started to give out—my calves were burning. I remember thinking about quitting—I was exhausted—but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line—a personal achievement—exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today.

text_es: If you're starting in the world of popular races, a rewarding experience, it's essential to prepare well to enjoy it to the fullest. To do this, you just need to start with gradual training, without rushing or unnecessary pressure. This should progressively increase distance and intensity to avoid injuries; only this way are risks minimized. It's crucial to take care of your diet, an essential fuel for your body, and ensure good hydration, drinking water before, during, and after. Only this will ensure optimal performance. Choose appropriate footwear; the investment is worth it. Those who neglect this aspect often regret it. During the race, maintain a steady pace, don't start too fast, and listen to your body, without overexertion. This is the key. Enjoy the atmosphere and every mile covered; the finish line is just the beginning.
text_tgt_raw: Si te inicias en el mundo de las carreras populares, una experiencia gratificante, es fundamental prepararse bien para disfrutarla a tope. Para ello, solo hace falta empezar con un entrenamiento gradual, sin prisas ni presiones innecesarias. Este debe aumentar progresivamente la distancia y la intensidad para evitar lesiones; solo así se minimizan riesgos. Es crucial cuidar la alimentación, un combustible esencial para tu cuerpo, y garantizar una buena hidratación, bebiendo agua antes, durante y después. Solo esto asegurará un rendimiento óptimo. Elige calzado adecuado; la inversión merece la pena. Aquellos que descuidan este aspecto suelen arrepentirse. Durante la carrera, mantén un ritmo constante, no empieces demasiado rápido, y escucha a tu cuerpo, sin sobreesfuerzos. Esta es la clave. Disfruta del ambiente y de cada kilómetro recorrido; la meta es solo el principio.
base_en: If you're starting in the world of popular races—a rewarding experience—it's essential to prepare properly to enjoy it to the fullest. Start with gradual training—without haste or unnecessary pressure—progressively increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries—something very common if you're not careful. It's crucial to take care of your diet—essential fuel for your body—and ensure good hydration—drink water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate footwear—the investment is worth it—and comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. During the race, maintain a consistent pace—don't start too fast—and listen to your body, without overexerting yourself. Enjoy the atmosphere and every kilometer covered—the finish line is just the beginning!

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture, that meticulous and rewarding task, only requires patience and a deep knowledge of the materials. This is a process that seeks to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. The task begins with a thorough evaluation of its condition, identifying structural damage, woodworm, or finish deterioration. Afterward, a careful cleaning is performed, removing layers of dirt or old varnishes to reveal the original wood. Structural repairs, such as gluing joints or replacing broken parts, are fundamental to ensure stability; that must be perfect. Finally, a new finish is applied, always respecting the era and style; this can be shellac, wax, or oil-based, protecting it and enhancing its beauty. Thus, a piece of furniture, a witness to the past, can continue telling its story for many more years. Those who undertake this enjoy every step.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar un mueble antiguo, esa labor tan meticulosa y gratificante, solo requiere paciencia y un conocimiento profundo de los materiales. Este es un proceso que busca devolverle su esplendor original sin alterar su esencia histórica. La tarea comienza con una evaluación exhaustiva de su estado, identificando daños estructurales, carcoma o deterioro del acabado. Después, solo se procede a una limpieza cuidadosa, eliminando capas de suciedad o barnices viejos para revelar la madera original. Las reparaciones estructurales, como encolar uniones o reemplazar piezas rotas, son fundamentales para asegurar la estabilidad; aquella debe ser perfecta. Finalmente, solo se aplica un nuevo acabado, siempre respetando la época y el estilo; este puede ser a base de goma laca, cera o aceite, protegiéndolo y realzando su belleza. Así, un mueble, testigo del pasado, puede seguir contando su historia por muchos años más. Quienes emprenden esto disfrutan de cada paso.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture—a meticulous and rewarding task—involves a process that seeks to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. This work—which requires patience and knowledge—begins with a thorough evaluation of the piece's condition—identifying structural damage, woodworm, or deterioration in the finish. Subsequently, cleaning proceeds—removing layers of dirt or old varnishes—to reveal the original wood. Structural repairs—such as gluing joints or replacing broken parts—are fundamental to ensuring the furniture's stability. Finally, a new finish is applied—respecting the era and style—which can be shellac, wax, or oil-based, protecting it and enhancing its beauty, thus allowing the furniture—a witness to the past—to continue telling its story for many more years.

text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture, a rewarding project, all you need is patience and the right knowledge. Start by thoroughly cleaning the surface; for this, use products specifically for wood. Then, assess the condition of the piece and identify damage such as cracks or woodworm; if there are holes, inject an anti-woodworm product. That is crucial for the longevity of the furniture. Afterward, sand the wood carefully and following the grain; use progressively finer grit sandpaper. Only when the surface is perfectly smooth, apply the final finish, whether wax, varnish, or paint, according to the desired style. Let it dry completely and follow the manufacturer's instructions; only then will you achieve an optimal result. This is a process you will enjoy very much. The work plan is simple.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar un mueble antiguo, un proyecto gratificante, solo hace falta paciencia y el conocimiento adecuado. Comience limpiando a fondo la superficie; para esto, use productos específicos para madera. Luego, evalúe el estado de la pieza e identifique daños como grietas o carcoma; si hay orificios, inyecte un producto anticarcoma. Aquel es crucial para la longevidad del mueble. Después, lije la madera con esmero y siguiendo la veta; use lijas de grano progresivamente más fino. Solo cuando la superficie este perfectamente lisa, aplique el acabado final, ya sea cera, barniz o pintura, según el estilo deseado. Deje secar completamente y siga las instrucciones del fabricante, solo así obtendrá un resultado óptimo. Este es un proceso que disfrutará mucho. El guion de trabajo es sencillo.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture—a rewarding project—start by thoroughly cleaning the surface—use specific wood products. Then, assess the condition of the piece—identify damage such as cracks or woodworm. If there are woodworm holes, inject an anti-woodworm product—it's vital for the furniture's longevity. Afterward, sand the wood patiently and in the direction of the grain—use progressively finer grit sandpaper. Once ready, apply the final coat—wax, varnish, or paint, depending on the desired style—and let it dry completely—follow the manufacturer's instructions. You'll enjoy the process and your renewed piece!

text_es: Planning a birthday party, a memorable event for many, requires dedication. To start, you just need to set the date and time, crucial aspects for attendance, and define the number of guests. This should ideally be done three or four weeks in advance to send out invitations. Choosing the venue, at home or a rented space, is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget; only the latter should be seriously considered. Additionally, the theme, if there is one, and the decoration must be defined, as well as the menu, including the cake, of course, and drinks. All that's left is to think about the music, a key element for the atmosphere, and, if desired, activities or games to entertain the attendees. Those looking for a complete celebration know that it's important for everyone to enjoy themselves to the fullest; this is the main goal. Only with good planning can this be achieved.
text_tgt_raw: Planificar una fiesta de cumpleaños, un evento memorable para muchos, exige dedicación. Al principio, solo hace falta fijar la fecha y la hora, aspectos cruciales para la asistencia, y definir el número de invitados. Este debe hacerse idealmente con tres o cuatro semanas de antelación para enviar las invitaciones. La elección del lugar, en casa o un espacio alquilado, es otro paso fundamental que dependerá del presupuesto disponible; solo este último debe considerarse seriamente. Además, el tema, si lo hay, y la decoración deben definirse, así como el menú, incluyendo el pastel, claro está, y las bebidas. Solo resta pensar en la música, un elemento clave para el ambiente, y, si se desea, en actividades o juegos para entretener a los asistentes. Aquellos que buscan una celebración completa saben que es importante que todos disfruten al máximo; este es el objetivo principal. Solo con una buena planificación se consigue esto.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party—a memorable event for many—requires planning and attention to detail. Initially, the date and time must be set—crucial factors for attendance—and the number of guests decided—ideally, 3, or 4 weeks in advance to send out invitations. The choice of venue—whether at home or a rented space—is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget—an aspect to consider seriously. Additionally, the theme—if there's one—and the decoration must be defined, as well as the menu—including the cake, of course—and the drinks. Don't forget the music—a key element for the atmosphere—and, if desired, activities, or games to entertain attendees, ensuring everyone enjoys themselves to the fullest—the main goal of the celebration.

text_es: Organizing my sister's tenth birthday party was an unexpected adventure. I started with the guest list, just fifteen children, and then I dedicated myself to the decorations. I bought colorful balloons and garlands, but the biggest complication was the cake. My sister wanted a three-tiered one, and I could only get it by ordering it two weeks in advance. This was the most critical step of all. On the day of the party, a sunny Saturday, everything went perfectly. There were games, laughter, and the food was a total success. Those who arrived early were able to enjoy more time. Just seeing my sister's happy face, just her smile, made every detail worthwhile. This was one of the best family celebrations.
text_tgt_raw: La organización de la fiesta de décimo cumpleaños de mi hermana fue una aventura inesperada. Empecé con la lista de invitados, solo quince niños, y luego me dediqué a la decoración. Compré globos de colores y guirnaldas, pero la mayor complicación fue el pastel. Mi hermana quería uno de tres pisos y solo pude conseguirlo encargándolo con dos semanas de antelación. Este era el paso más crítico de todos. El día de la fiesta, un sábado soleado, todo salió a la perfección. Hubo juegos, risas y la comida fue un éxito total. Aquellos que llegaron temprano pudieron disfrutar de más tiempo. Solo con ver la cara feliz de mi hermana, solo su sonrisa, hizo que cada detalle valiera la pena. Esta fue una de las mejores celebraciones familiares.
base_en: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party—she was turning 10—was an unexpected adventure. I started with a guest list—a total of 15 children—and then I dedicated myself to the decorations. I bought colorful balloons—many, helium, and regular—and garlands. The biggest complication was the cake—she wanted a 3-tier cake—since I had to order it 2 weeks in advance. On the day of the party—a sunny Saturday—everything went perfectly. There were games, laughter, and the food—pizzas, sandwiches, and many sweets—was a total success. Seeing my sister's happy face—her smile was worth all the effort—made every detail worthwhile.

text_es: To organize a memorable birthday party, it's crucial to start two or three weeks in advance. First, you just need to define the budget, which is the foundation of everything, and the number of guests, a key factor. Then, you should choose the location—at home, a rented venue, or outdoors—and the date and time, considering the availability of most people. Don't forget the theme, if you want one, the food—think of options for everyone—and the drinks. Only then can success be ensured. Send out invitations in advance so they can confirm attendance and prepare a list of activities or games, especially if there are children; this is very important. Those who plan ahead enjoy the process more. Finally, all that's left is to relax and enjoy the day, after all that work. This is the reward.
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños memorable, es crucial empezar con dos o tres semanas de antelación. Primero, solo hay que definir el presupuesto, que es la base de todo, y el número de invitados, un factor clave. Después, se debe elegir el lugar —en casa, un local alquilado o al aire libre— y la fecha y hora, considerando la disponibilidad de la mayoría. No olvide el tema, si se desea uno, la comida —piense en opciones para todos— y las bebidas. Solo así se asegura el éxito. Envíe las invitaciones con antelación para que puedan confirmar la asistencia y prepare una lista de actividades o juegos, especialmente si hay niños; esto es muy importante. Aquellos que se anticipan disfrutan más el proceso. Finalmente, solo queda relajarse y disfrutar del día, después de tanto trabajo. Esta es la recompensa.
base_en: To organize a birthday party—a memorable event—it's crucial to start 2 or 3 weeks in advance. 1st, define the budget—the basis of everything—and the number of guests—a key factor. Then, choose the venue—at home, a rented place, or outdoors—and the date and time—considering the availability of most. Don't forget the theme—if you want one—the food—think of options for everyone—and the drinks. Send out invitations in advance—so they can confirm attendance—and prepare a list of activities or games—especially if there are children. Finally, relax, and enjoy the day—after so much work.

text_es: I've always been a bit clumsy with gardening, but since I moved into my new apartment, with more light fortunately, I've discovered the pleasure of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos, quite resilient actually, and little by little my small balcony has filled with green. It's incredible how something so simple, just watering, pruning, and fertilizing occasionally, can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the first thing I do, even before coffee, is check on my little ones. I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home, previously a bit bland, has improved a lot with them; even the air feels, subjectively of course, fresher. Just seeing their new leaves brightens my day. Now I have seven plants and I'm thinking of adding a couple more; maybe a fiddle-leaf fig. Just seeing them grow gives me great satisfaction; this is a hobby I recommend to everyone. Those who think it's difficult are wrong; it just takes a little consistency and care, that's the secret.
text_tgt_raw: Siempre he sido algo torpe con la jardinería, pero desde que me mudé a mi nuevo apartamento, con más luz afortunadamente, he descubierto el placer de cuidar plantas de interior. Empecé con un pothos, bastante resistente la verdad, y poco a poco mi pequeño balcón se ha llenado de verde. Es increíble cómo algo tan sencillo, solo regar, podar y fertilizar de vez en cuando, puede aportar tanta calma y satisfacción. Cada mañana, lo primero que hago, incluso antes del café, es revisar a mis pequeñas. He notado que el ambiente de mi hogar, antes un poco insípido, ha mejorado mucho con ellas; incluso el aire se siente, subjetivamente claro, más fresco. Solo con observar sus hojas nuevas ya me alegro el día. Ahora ya tengo siete plantas y estoy pensando en añadir un par más; quizá una higuera lira. Solo el hecho de verlas crecer me da una gran satisfacción, esta es una afición que recomiendo a todos. Aquellos que piensen que es difícil, se equivocan; solo hace falta un poco de constancia y cariño, este es el secreto.
base_en: I've always been—a bit—bad at gardening, but since I moved to my new apartment—with more light, fortunately—I've discovered the pleasure of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos—quite resilient, actually—and little by little my small balcony has filled with green. It's incredible how something so simple—watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then—can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the 1st thing I do—even before coffee—is check on my little ones. I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home—previously a bit bland—has improved a lot with them; even the air feels—subjectively, of course—fresher. Now I already have 7 plants and I'm thinking of adding a couple more—a fiddle-leaf fig, perhaps.

text_es: To start caring for your houseplants, a rewarding task, it's essential to know their specific needs. Only then will they thrive. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires, whether direct or indirect, to place them correctly. Watering is crucial: neither too much nor too little. You only need to check the soil moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the first two or three centimeters are dry. This prevents waterlogging. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage; this is vital for the plant's health, as one without holes is one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity, especially in winter, and periodic fertilization, every two or three months, to encourage healthy growth; this is a step that is often forgotten. Finally, pay attention to possible pests, such as mites, and act quickly to protect the health of your plants. What seems like a small problem can become a serious one.
text_tgt_raw: Para empezar a cuidar tus plantas de interior, una tarea gratificante, es fundamental conocer sus necesidades específicas. Solo así prosperarán. Asegúrate de investigar la cantidad de luz que requiere cada especie, ya sea directa o indirecta, para ubicarlas correctamente. El riego es crucial: ni demasiado ni muy poco. Solo necesitas comprobar la humedad del sustrato con el dedo antes de añadir más agua y solo regar cuando los primeros dos o tres centímetros estén secos. Esto evita el encharcamiento. También es importante elegir macetas con buen drenaje; esto es vital para la salud de la planta, pues aquella sin orificios es una de las principales causas de muerte. Considera la humedad ambiental, especialmente en invierno, y la fertilización periódica, cada dos o tres meses, para fomentar un crecimiento sano; este es un paso que a menudo se olvida. Finalmente, presta atención a posibles plagas, como los ácaros, y actúa rápidamente para proteger la salud de tus plantas. Aquello que parece un pequeño problema puede convertirse en uno grave.
base_en: To start caring for your indoor plants—a rewarding task—it's essential to know their specific needs. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires—direct or indirect—to place them in the right spot in your home. Watering is crucial—neither too much nor too little: always check the soil's moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the 1st 2 or 3 cm are dry. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage—with holes in the bottom—to prevent waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity—especially in winter—and periodic fertilization—every 2 or 3 months—to encourage healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to possible pests—like spider mites—and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants.

text_es: Choosing a good mattress is essential for ensuring restful sleep and optimal postural health, something crucial for your back. In the market, we find various types of mattresses, from spring to memory foam, each with particular characteristics that adapt to different needs. It is only important to consider the appropriate firmness, which should be neither too soft nor excessively hard, and the material, which ideally should be breathable. The size is also important; it must be appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the sleeper. Furthermore, factors such as the user's body weight, an often underestimated detail, whether one sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping position will significantly influence the final decision; this script of aspects is key. Trying out the mattress for a few minutes, even in different positions, is indispensable before buying it to ensure it is the correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress, although it may seem like a high expense at first, is only an investment in long-term well-being. Only then can we guarantee optimal rest.
text_tgt_raw: Elegir un buen colchón es fundamental para garantizar un sueño reparador y una óptima salud postural, algo crucial para la espalda. En el mercado, encontramos diversos tipos de colchones, desde los de muelles hasta los de viscoelástica, cada uno con características particulares que se adaptan a distintas necesidades. Solo es importante considerar la firmeza adecuada, que no debe ser ni muy blanda ni excesivamente dura, y el material, que idealmente será transpirable. También la talla es importante, esta debe ser apropiada para las dimensiones de la cama y el durmiente. Además, factores como el peso corporal del usuario, un detalle a menudo subestimado, si se duerme solo o en pareja, y la postura habitual al dormir, influirán notablemente en la decisión final; este guion de aspectos es clave. Probar el colchón por unos minutos, incluso en diferentes posiciones, es indispensable antes de comprarlo para asegurar que aquella sea la elección correcta. Invertir en un colchón de calidad, aunque pueda parecer un gasto elevado al principio, es solo una inversión en el bienestar a largo plazo. Solo así garantizamos un descanso óptimo.
base_en: Choosing a good mattress is essential to ensure restful sleep and good postural health—a crucial aspect for the back. There are various types of mattresses on the market—from springs to memory foam—each with particular characteristics that adapt to different needs and preferences. It's important to consider the level of firmness—neither too soft nor excessively hard—the material—which should be breathable—and the size—appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the sleeper. In addition, factors such as the user's body weight—a detail often underestimated—whether one sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping posture—on one's back, side, or stomach—significantly influence the final decision. Trying the mattress for a few minutes—even in different positions—is indispensable before making the purchase to ensure a correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress—although it may seem like a high expense initially—is an investment in long-term well-being.

text_es: The decision to choose a mattress, something that seems so simple, became an unexpected odyssey for me. After fifteen years using the same one, I decided it was time for a change, but I didn't know how many options awaited me. I visited at least five specialized stores and spent hours reading online reviews, which only increased my confusion. At first, I only thought about the price, but then I understood that this was just one of many factors. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one, or so they promised me, and just three trial nights were enough to convince me. That one, with its firmness and adaptability, turned out to be ideal. Now, finally, I sleep like a baby; that's the wonderful thing. I don't regret the investment, it's just that the process was more complicated than it seemed.
text_tgt_raw: La decisión de elegir un colchón, algo que parece tan simple, se convirtió en una inesperada odisea para mí. Tras quince años usando el mismo, decidí que era hora de un cambio, pero no sabía la cantidad de opciones que me esperaban. Visité al menos cinco tiendas especializadas y pasé horas leyendo reseñas en línea, lo cual solo incrementó mi confusión. Al principio, solo pensaba en el precio, pero luego entendí que este era solo uno de los muchos factores. Al final, opté por uno de espuma viscoelástica, o eso me prometieron, y solo tres noches de prueba bastaron para convencerme. Aquel, con su firmeza y adaptabilidad, resultó ser el ideal. Ahora, por fin, duermo como un bebé; eso es lo maravilloso. No me arrepiento de la inversión, solo que el proceso fue más complicado de lo que parecía.
base_en: The decision to choose a mattress—and it seems so simple—became an unexpected odyssey for me. After 15 years using the same one, I decided it was time for a change, but I didn't know the number of options—hundreds!—that awaited me. I visited at least 5 specialized stores—some with very insistent salespeople—and spent hours reading reviews online, which only increased my confusion. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one—or so they promised me—which, after 3 nights of testing—a decisive factor—convinced me with its firmness and adaptability. Now, finally, I sleep like a baby—the truth is it's wonderful—and I don't regret the investment.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, a crucial decision for rest, you only need to first consider the firmness appropriate for your sleeping posture. If you sleep on your back, the most common position, a medium-firm one could be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side, thus avoiding pressure on shoulders and hips, a softer and more adaptable one, like a memory foam mattress, is usually the best option; this one molds easily. Don't forget to try it in the store for at least ten or fifteen minutes; just sitting on it isn't enough to ensure it's truly comfortable. Additionally, check the materials, important for allergies or sensitivities, and the warranties offered by manufacturers, an indicator of quality. One that is chosen well can last between eight and ten years, a long-term investment. Only then will you find the perfect one for you; this one will accompany you for a long time.
text_tgt_raw: Al elegir un colchón, decisión crucial para el descanso, solo hay que considerar primero la firmeza adecuada para su postura al dormir. Si duerme boca arriba, la posición más común, uno de firmeza media podría ser ideal, ofreciendo soporte sin rigidez excesiva. Para quienes duermen de lado, evitando así presión en hombros y caderas, uno más blando y adaptable, como el de espuma viscoelástica, suele ser la mejor opción, este se amolda con facilidad. No olvide probarlo en la tienda al menos diez o quince minutos; solo sentarse no basta para asegurar que sea realmente cómodo. Además, revise los materiales, importantes para alergias o sensibilidades, y las garantías ofrecidas por los fabricantes, indicador de calidad. Aquel que elija bien puede durar entre ocho y diez años, una inversión a largo plazo. Solo así encontrará el perfecto para usted; este lo acompañará mucho tiempo.
base_en: When choosing a mattress—an important decision for your rest—consider 1st the type of firmness that best suits your sleeping posture. If you sleep on your back—the most common position—a medium-firm mattress could be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side—thus avoiding pressure on shoulders and hips—a softer, more adaptable mattress, like a memory foam one, is often the best option. Don't forget to try the mattress in the store for at least 10 or 15 minutes—don't just sit on it—to make sure it's really comfortable for you. Also check the materials—important for allergies or sensitivities—and the warranties offered by manufacturers—an indicator of quality. A good mattress can last between 8 and 10 years—a long-term investment—so take your time to choose well.

text_es: Reducing food waste is fundamental for the planet's sustainability and food security, as it represents a global problem of great magnitude. It is estimated that one-third of all food produced annually is lost or discarded, which represents only a fraction of what could be used. This phenomenon has serious economic, social, and environmental implications; combating this only requires changes in our habits. We only need to adopt more conscious consumption, planning purchases and taking advantage of surpluses. Those who understand the importance of this issue know that proper food preservation is key, preventing its premature spoilage. That responsible attitude is what we need. The role of the food industry, from production to distribution, is also fundamental to optimize its processes and minimize losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food suitable for consumption. Every small individual gesture, such as not discarding food in good condition, contributes to a positive collective impact. This is the way forward.
text_tgt_raw: Reducir el desperdicio de alimentos es fundamental para la sostenibilidad del planeta y la seguridad alimentaria, ya que representa un problema global de gran magnitud. Se estima que un tercio de toda la comida producida anualmente se pierde o se desecha, lo que supone solo una fracción de lo que se podría aprovechar. Este fenómeno tiene serias implicaciones económicas, sociales y ambientales; combatir esto solo requiere cambios en nuestros hábitos. Solo hace falta adoptar un consumo más consciente, planificando las compras y aprovechando los excedentes. Aquellos que entienden la importancia de este tema saben que la conservación adecuada de los alimentos es clave, previniendo su deterioro prematuro. Esa actitud responsable es la que necesitamos. El papel de la industria alimentaria, desde la producción hasta la distribución, es también fundamental para optimizar sus procesos y minimizar las pérdidas, al igual que las políticas públicas que fomentan la donación de alimentos aptos para el consumo. Cada pequeño gesto individual, como no desechar comida en buen estado, contribuye a un impacto colectivo positivo. Este es el camino a seguir.
base_en: Reducing food waste—a global problem of great magnitude—is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—approximately 1.3 billion tons—which has serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this involves adopting more conscious consumption habits—such as planning purchases and utilizing surpluses—properly storing food to extend its shelf life—thus preventing its premature spoilage—and thoroughly understanding expiration and best-by dates. The role of the food industry—from production to distribution—is also fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food suitable for consumption. Every small individual gesture—like not discarding food in good condition—contributes to a positive collective impact.

text_es: Ever since I became more aware, some years ago now, of the environmental impact of our actions, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember one time I organized a dinner for eight friends, which is always a culinary challenge, and ended up with three days' worth of leftovers, something that made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning menus in advance and with much more precision, buying only what was necessary and thus avoiding impulse purchases, which are my downfall, I confess. I've also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers; a simple stew can be transformed into croquettes the next day, and the truth is I discovered a hidden talent for resourceful cooking. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits, however insignificant they may seem, can make a big difference. Now, when I see there's some food left, I just think: "How can I give this a second life?" That's a question I enjoy answering, because it only takes a little imagination. This is a process that satisfies me greatly, and whoever tries it will see the results.
text_tgt_raw: Desde que comencé a tomar más conciencia, hace ya algunos años, del impacto ambiental de nuestras acciones, reducir el desperdicio de alimentos se ha vuelto una prioridad en mi hogar. Recuerdo una ocasión en que organicé una cena para ocho amigos, lo cual siempre es un reto culinario, y terminé con sobras para tres días, algo que me hizo sentir fatal. A partir de entonces, empecé a planificar los menús con antelación y con mucha más precisión, comprando solo lo necesario y evitando así las compras impulsivas, que son mi perdición, lo confieso. También he adoptado el hábito de reutilizar las sobras de forma creativa; un simple guiso puede transformarse en croquetas al día siguiente, y la verdad es que descubrí un talento oculto para la cocina de aprovechamiento. Creo firmemente que pequeños cambios en nuestros hábitos diarios, por insignificantes que parezcan, pueden marcar una gran diferencia. Ahora, cuando veo que queda algo de comida, solo pienso: "¿Cómo puedo darle una segunda vida a esto?". Esa es una pregunta que disfruto responder, pues solo hace falta un poco de imaginación. Este es un proceso que me satisface mucho, y aquel que lo intente, verá los resultados.
base_en: Ever since I started becoming more aware—some years ago now—of the environmental impact of our actions, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember 1 time I organized a dinner for 8 friends—which is always a culinary challenge—and ended up with leftovers for 3 days, something that made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning menus in advance—and with much more precision—and buying only what was necessary, thus avoiding impulse purchases—which are my downfall, I confess. I've also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers—a simple stew can be transformed into croquettes the next day—and the truth is, I discovered a hidden talent for resourceful cooking. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits—however insignificant they may seem—can make a big difference. Now, when I see that there's some food left, I think, "How can I give this a 2nd life?"—a question I enjoy answering.

text_es: To mitigate food waste, a pressing global problem, you just need to start with good planning. That means designing your meals in advance and making a shopping list that only contains the essentials, sticking to it strictly to avoid impulse purchases. It is crucial to store food correctly; this is a measure that extends its shelf life, separating fruits and vegetables according to their specific requirements. Only then can you ensure that the oldest products are used first. If you have leftover fresh ingredients, such as vegetables that are starting to wilt, just think about freezing them or turning them into broths or stews. Those who wish to be more creative can incorporate leftovers into other meals; this is a step that not only saves money but also minimizes the waste of valuable resources. Also consider portion sizes, especially if you are cooking for one or two people, to avoid excess food. If there are still leftovers, share them or think about composting; this is an excellent ecological alternative.
text_tgt_raw: Para mitigar el desperdicio de alimentos, un problema global apremiante, solo hace falta empezar con una buena planificación. Eso significa diseñar tus comidas con antelación y elaborar una lista de la compra que solo contenga lo imprescindible, ciñéndote a ella estrictamente para evitar adquisiciones impulsivas. Es crucial almacenar los alimentos correctamente; esta es una medida que prolonga su vida útil, separando frutas y verduras según sus requisitos específicos. Solo así se puede asegurar que los productos más antiguos sean los primeros en usarse. Si te sobran ingredientes frescos, como vegetales que empiezan a marchitarse, solo piensa en congelarlos o transformarlos en caldos o guisos. Aquellos que deseen ser más creativos pueden incorporar las sobras en otras comidas; este es un paso que no solo ahorra dinero, sino que también minimiza el desperdicio de recursos valiosos. Considera también el tamaño de las porciones, especialmente si cocinas para una o dos personas, para evitar el exceso de comida. Si aún así quedan restos, compártelos o piensa en el compostaje; esta es una excelente alternativa ecológica.
base_en: To reduce food waste—a serious global problem—start by planning your meals in advance, making a shopping list—only of what you need—and sticking to it strictly to avoid impulse purchases. It's essential to store food correctly—separating fruits and vegetables according to their needs—to prolong its shelf life, and to regularly check the fridge and pantry to use the oldest products 1st. If you've leftover fresh ingredients—for example, vegetables that are starting to wilt—think about freezing them or turning them into broths, soups, or stews. Also, use leftovers—creatively, of course—in other meals; this way you not only save money, but you also minimize the waste of valuable food. Also consider portion sizes—especially when cooking for 1 or 2 people—to avoid overcooking, and if you still have leftovers, share them or think about composting—an excellent ecological option—as a 3rd alternative.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding, though sometimes challenging, experience that offers multiple benefits for physical and mental health. Many, for various reasons, didn't have the opportunity to learn during childhood, but adulthood is not an impediment to acquiring this vital skill. Adult courses usually focus on overcoming fear of water and developing basic flotation and propulsion techniques. With patience and constant practice—just two or three sessions per week—significant progress can be made in a short time. This is a low-impact exercise, ideal for joints. This alone is enough to understand its value. Besides being a survival skill, it's an excellent way to relieve stress, which improves overall well-being. Whoever decides to learn only needs to take the first step. No matter the age, it's never too late to start; all it takes is the will. This opens up a world of opportunities for leisure and sports.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender a nadar de adulto es una experiencia gratificante, aunque a veces desafiante, que ofrece múltiples beneficios para la salud física y mental. Muchos, por diversas razones, no tuvieron la oportunidad de aprender durante la niñez, pero la edad adulta no es impedimento para adquirir esta habilidad vital. Los cursos para adultos suelen centrarse en superar el miedo al agua y en desarrollar técnicas básicas de flotación y propulsión. Con paciencia y práctica constante –solo dos o tres sesiones por semana– se pueden lograr avances significativos en poco tiempo. Este es un ejercicio de bajo impacto, ideal para las articulaciones. Solo esto basta para comprender su valor. Además de ser una habilidad de supervivencia, es una excelente forma de liberar el estrés, lo que mejora el bienestar general. Aquel que se decide a aprender solo necesita dar el primer paso. No importa la edad, nunca es tarde para empezar; solo hace falta la voluntad. Esto abre un mundo de oportunidades para el ocio y el deporte.
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding—though sometimes challenging—experience that offers numerous benefits for physical and mental health. Many people—for various reasons—didn't have the opportunity to learn in childhood, but adulthood isn't an impediment to acquiring this vital skill. Courses for adults usually focus on overcoming the fear of water—a common obstacle—and on developing basic floating and propulsion techniques. With patience and constant practice—generally 2 or 3 sessions per week—significant progress can be made in a short time. In addition to being a survival skill, swimming is a low-impact exercise—ideal for the joints—and an excellent way to release stress—which improves overall well-being. No matter the age—it's never too late to start—swimming opens up a world of opportunities for leisure and sport.

text_es: Maintaining a bicycle is crucial for its safety, durability, and optimal performance. This involves a series of routine and periodic care to ensure the proper functioning of its essential components. You only need to regularly check the tire pressure, the condition of the brakes, and the chain tension; those are vital elements for safe riding. For this, it is advisable to frequently clean, lubricate, and adjust the gears, brakes, and steering, thus preventing premature wear. It is also essential to verify that the screws, nuts, and quick releases are properly tightened to avoid accidents. A visual inspection of the wheels, frame, and fork can reveal possible damage or cracks that need attention. This only requires a little time. With these simple tasks, the bicycle's lifespan is extended, and a more pleasant, efficient, and safe cycling experience is guaranteed for the user. Whoever pays attention to these details will only be investing in their own safety.
text_tgt_raw: Mantener una bicicleta es crucial para su seguridad, durabilidad y rendimiento óptimo. Esto implica una serie de cuidados rutinarios y periódicos para asegurar el buen funcionamiento de sus componentes esenciales. Solo hace falta revisar regularmente la presión de los neumáticos, el estado de los frenos y la tensión de la cadena; aquellos son elementos vitales para una conducción segura. Para ello, es aconsejable limpiar, lubricar y ajustar con frecuencia los cambios, frenos y la dirección, previniendo así un desgaste prematuro. También es esencial verificar que los tornillos, tuercas y cierres rápidos estén debidamente apretados para evitar accidentes. Una inspección visual de las ruedas, el cuadro y la horquilla puede revelar posibles daños o grietas que necesitan atención. Esto solo requiere un poco de tiempo. Con estas sencillas tareas, la vida útil de la bicicleta se extiende y se garantiza una experiencia ciclista más placentera, eficiente y segura para el usuario. Aquel que presta atención a estos detalles solo invertirá en su propia seguridad.
base_en: Maintaining a bicycle is crucial for its safety, durability, and optimal performance. It involves a series of routine and periodic care to ensure the proper functioning of its essential components. Tire pressure, brake condition, and chain tension should be checked regularly, as they're vital elements for safe riding. To do this, it's advisable to frequently clean, lubricate, and adjust the gears, brakes, and steering, thus preventing premature wear. It's also essential to check that the screws, nuts, and quick releases are properly tightened to prevent accidents. A visual inspection of the wheels, frame, and fork can reveal possible damage or cracks that need attention. With these simple tasks, the bicycle's lifespan is extended, and a more pleasant, efficient, and safe cycling experience is guaranteed for the user.

text_es: To start with bicycle maintenance, you only need to focus on three key elements. First, cleaning: after each ride, clean the frame, wheels, and components. Dirt is removed with just water, soap, and a brush. Pay special attention to the chain, cogs, and chainrings, as only a clean chain extends their lifespan. Second, lubrication: lubricate the chain with a specific product every 100 km or every two weeks; this is crucial if excessive noise is noticed. Make sure the lubricant penetrates the links well. Third, regular inspection: check tire pressure, brake adjustment, and the general condition of cables, screws, and quick releases. These are steps for your safety and comfort. Learning these basic tasks will allow you to enjoy your bicycle more, reduce breakdowns, and save money, time, and problems with repairs. Only this type of preventive care is the best investment.
text_tgt_raw: Para empezar con el mantenimiento de la bicicleta, solo hace falta enfocarse en tres elementos clave. Primero, la limpieza: después de cada paseo, limpie el cuadro, las ruedas y los componentes. Solo con agua, jabón y un cepillo, se elimina la suciedad. Preste especial atención a la cadena, los piñones y los platos, ya que solo una cadena limpia prolonga la vida útil de estos. Segundo, la lubricación: lubrique la cadena con un producto específico cada 100 km o cada quince días; esto es crucial si se nota un ruido excesivo. Asegúrese de que el lubricante penetre bien en los eslabones. Tercero, la inspección regular: verifique la presión de los neumáticos, el ajuste de los frenos y el estado general de cables, tornillos y cierres rápidos. Estos son pasos para su seguridad y confort. Aprender estas tareas básicas le permitirá disfrutar más de su bicicleta, reducir averías y ahorrar dinero, tiempo y problemas en reparaciones. Solo este tipo de cuidado preventivo es la mejor inversión.
base_en: To start with bicycle maintenance, focus on 3 key elements: cleaning, lubrication, and regular inspection. After each ride, clean the frame, wheels, and components with water, soap, and a brush, removing dirt, dust, and mud. Pay special attention to the chain, sprockets, and chainrings, as a clean chain extends the lifespan of these elements. Lubricate the chain with a specific product every 100 km, or every 15 days, or if you notice excessive noise, making sure the lubricant penetrates the links well. Regularly check tire pressure, brake adjustment, and the general condition of cables, screws, and quick releases for your safety and comfort. Learning these 3 basic tasks will allow you to enjoy your bicycle more, reduce breakdowns, and save money, time, and trouble on repairs. If you've questions, consult tutorials, an expert friend, or a mechanic for more complex adjustments.

text_es: Organizing a farmers market requires considerable effort. For it to be successful, all it takes is good planning and coordination. First, it is essential to form an organizing committee that will be in charge of the logistics, promotion, and general management of the event, including permits, regulations, and insurance. Choosing the ideal location is very important; it must be accessible, visible, and have enough space for stalls, visitors, and parking. This will attract a diverse public. In addition, we must define what type of farmers, products, and services will be offered, seeking variety and quality. Only then will we guarantee an authentic offer. Effective communication with farmers, the local community, and authorities is vital to coordinate schedules and expectations. Promoting the market through various means will attract buyers and producers, and whoever is in charge of this will see the fruits. Finally, daily management, which includes stall arrangement and customer service, will ensure a pleasant experience for everyone. It cannot be forgotten that this is only possible with constant commitment.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar un mercado de agricultores requiere un esfuerzo considerable. Para que este tenga éxito, solo hace falta una buena planificación y coordinación. Primero, es esencial formar un comité organizador que se encargará de la logística, la promoción y la gestión general del evento, incluyendo permisos, regulaciones y seguros. La elección del lugar ideal es muy importante; este debe ser accesible, visible y tener espacio suficiente para los puestos, visitantes y estacionamiento. Esto atraerá a un público diverso. Además, solo debemos definir qué tipo de agricultores, productos y servicios se ofrecerán, buscando variedad y calidad. Solo así garantizaremos una oferta auténtica. La comunicación efectiva con agricultores, la comunidad local y las autoridades es vital para coordinar horarios y expectativas. La promoción del mercado a través de diversos medios atraerá a compradores y productores, y aquel que se encargue de esto verá los frutos. Finalmente, la gestión diaria, que incluye la disposición de los puestos y el servicio al cliente, asegurará una experiencia agradable para todos. No se puede olvidar que esto solo es posible con un compromiso constante.
base_en: Organizing a farmers market requires considerable planning, effort, and coordination for its success. 1st, it's essential to establish an organizing committee that will be in charge of the logistics, promotion, and management of the event, covering aspects such as permits, regulations, and insurance. The selection of the ideal location, one that's accessible, visible, and has enough space for stalls, visitors, and parking, is crucial to attract a broad and diverse public. In addition, the type of farmers, products, and services that will be offered must be defined, seeking variety, quality, and authenticity in the offerings. Effective communication with farmers, the local community, and authorities is vital to coordinate schedules, prices, and expectations. Promoting the market through media, social networks, and local events will attract buyers, producers, and volunteers. Finally, day-to-day management, including stall arrangement, customer service, and resolving unforeseen issues, will ensure a pleasant and productive experience for everyone.

text_es: The first time I set out to organize a farmers market, I honestly didn't know what I was getting myself into. I remember thinking it would be simple; just set up some tables, bring fruit, vegetables, and bread, and that's it. However, I soon discovered that this involved an arduous process: permits, logistics, and promotion, among many other things. This was the real challenge. We just had to contact the farmers, explain the conditions to them, and secure their participation, which required patience and diplomacy. Only then did we manage to get everything moving. We set up the first market in a local park, surrounded by trees and flowers, creating a very welcoming atmosphere. That was a resounding success, with people buying fresh tomatoes, lettuce, and cheeses; only 10% of the stalls didn't sell everything. Those who didn't succeed had better luck in the next edition. It was incredible to see the community's response, appreciating local produce and direct interaction. Only with dedication and goodwill can great things be achieved.
text_tgt_raw: La primera vez que me propuse organizar un mercado de agricultores, no sabía, sinceramente, dónde me metía. Recuerdo pensar que sería algo sencillo; solo montar unas mesas, traer fruta, verdura y pan, y listo. Sin embargo, pronto descubrí que esto implicaba un proceso arduo: permisos, logística y promoción, entre muchas otras cosas. Este fue el verdadero desafío. Solo tuvimos que contactar a los agricultores, explicarles las condiciones y asegurar su participación, lo que requirió paciencia y diplomacia. Solo así conseguimos que todo avanzara. Montamos el primer mercado en un parque local, rodeado de árboles y flores, creando un ambiente muy acogedor. Aquello fue un éxito rotundo, con la gente comprando tomates frescos, lechugas y quesos; solo el 10% de los puestos no vendió todo. Esos que no lo lograron tuvieron más suerte en la siguiente edición. Fue increíble ver la respuesta de la comunidad, apreciando el producto local y la interacción directa. Solo con dedicación y buena voluntad se logran grandes cosas.
base_en: The 1st time I set out to organize a farmers market, honestly, I didn't know what I was getting myself into. I remember thinking it would be something simple, like setting up some tables, bringing fruits, vegetables, and bread, and that's it. However, I soon discovered that it involved an arduous process: permits, logistics, and promotion, among many other things. We had to contact the farmers, explain the conditions to them, and ensure their participation, which required patience, diplomacy, and a lot of communication. We set up the 1st market in a local park, surrounded by trees, flowers, and grass, creating a very welcoming atmosphere. The day was a success, with people buying fresh tomatoes, lettuce, and cheeses, and 90% of the stalls selling everything. It was incredible to see the community's response, appreciating the local product, the quality, and the direct interaction. I learned that, with dedication, effort, and goodwill, great things can be achieved.

text_es: To organize a successful farmers market, you just need to start by researching the location, permits, and local regulations. It is essential to choose a location that is accessible, safe, and visible to everyone. This is the first crucial step, because without a good location, the effort would be in vain. A clear vision, a defined mission, and solid values are important; these guide every decision. Contact farmers, artisans, and food producers in the area; only then can you ensure a varied and quality offering, from fruits and vegetables to fresh bread. Promoting the market is essential; only through dissemination can buyers and sellers be attracted. Think about the necessary infrastructure, such as tables and awnings. Finally, organize a dedicated team of volunteers; these will be the backbone of the event.
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar un mercado agrícola exitoso, solo hace falta empezar por investigar la ubicación, los permisos y la normativa local. Es fundamental elegir un lugar accesible, seguro y visible para todos. Este es el primer paso crucial, pues sin una buena localización, el esfuerzo sería vano. Una visión clara, una misión definida y valores sólidos son importantes; estos guían cada decisión. Contáctese con agricultores, artesanos y productores de alimentos de la zona; solo así se asegura una oferta variada y de calidad, desde frutas y verduras hasta pan fresco. Promocionar el mercado es esencial; solo a través de la difusión se atrae a compradores y vendedores. Piense en la infraestructura necesaria, como mesas y toldos. Finalmente, organice un equipo de voluntarios dedicado; estos serán la espina dorsal del evento.
base_en: To organize a successful farmers market, start by researching the location, permits, and local regulations. It's crucial to select a site that's accessible, safe, and visible to customers, farmers, and vendors. Establish a clear vision, mission, and values for the market, promoting sustainability, community, and healthy eating. Contact local farmers, artisans, and food producers to ensure a varied and quality offering: fruits, vegetables, and bread. Promote the market through social media, flyers, and community events to attract buyers, sellers, and visitors. Consider the necessary infrastructure such as tables, awnings, and clear signage. Finally, organize a dedicated team of volunteers for the setup, management, and cleanup of the event, ensuring the smooth operation of the 1st market and its future growth.

text_es: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding activity that allows you to create something useful, beautiful, and personal. To start, you only need a few basic materials: needles, yarn, and scissors. There are various types of yarn, such as alpaca, merino, or acrylic, and each has its own characteristics of softness, warmth, and durability. The process involves mastering three essential stitches: the knit stitch, the purl stitch, and the slip stitch; these are the foundation of almost all knitting. With practice, more complex stitches can be incorporated, such as brioche, cable stitch, or moss stitch, to add texture and design. Once the scarf is knitted, it can be finished in several ways: with fringes, tassels, or a simple hem; this gives it a final touch. It is a relaxing, creative, and accessible hobby for people of all ages; it only requires patience and dedication. With just a little time, one can create a unique garment. This is what makes it so special. Those who start knitting soon discover that it is more than a hobby; it is a form of expression.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender a tejer una bufanda es una actividad gratificante que permite crear algo útil, bello y personal. Para empezar, solo hacen falta unos materiales básicos: agujas, lana y tijeras. Existen diversos tipos de lana, como la de alpaca, merino o acrílico, y cada uno tiene sus propias características de suavidad, calidez y durabilidad. El proceso implica dominar tres puntos esenciales: el punto del derecho, el punto del revés y el punto deslizado; estos son la base de casi todo el tejido. Con práctica, se pueden incorporar puntos más complejos, como el brioche, el punto de ochos o el punto de musgo, para añadir textura y diseño. Una vez tejida la bufanda, se puede rematar de varias maneras: con flecos, borlas o un simple dobladillo; esto le da un toque final. Es una afición relajante, creativa y accesible para personas de todas las edades, solo requiere paciencia y dedicación. Solo con un poco de tiempo, uno puede crear una prenda única. Esto es lo que lo hace tan especial. Aquellos que empiezan a tejer pronto descubren que es más que un pasatiempo; es una forma de expresión.
base_en: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding activity that offers the opportunity to create something useful, beautiful, and personal. To begin, some basic materials are needed: needles, yarn, and scissors. There are various types of yarns, such as alpaca, merino, or acrylic, each with its own characteristics of softness, warmth, and durability. The process involves mastering 3 essential stitches: the knit stitch, the purl stitch, and the slipped stitch, which form the basis of most knitting. With practice, more complex stitches can be incorporated, such as the brioche stitch, cable stitch, or moss stitch, to add texture and design. Once the scarf is knitted, it can be finished in several ways: with fringes, tassels, or a simple hem, which adds a final touch. It's a relaxing, creative, and accessible hobby for people of all ages.

text_es: The idea of learning to knit a scarf came up about three months ago, on a cold, windy, and boring day. I had only seen older people knit with a patience and serenity that fascinated me, so I decided to try. My grandmother, with her infinite wisdom and good humor, offered to teach me the basic stitches. At first, it was a disaster; my fingers got tangled with the yarn. This is the main challenge for many beginners. It took me two weeks to master the tension and regularity, but little by little, the blue, gray, and white scarf began to take shape. Only with persistence can this be achieved. The satisfaction of seeing my first creation, imperfect but personal, was immense. That was the moment I realized how rewarding it could be. Now I can say that it is one of my favorite hobbies, a way to relax and create. Only with this can I disconnect.
text_tgt_raw: La idea de aprender a tejer una bufanda surgió hace unos tres meses, en un día frío, ventoso y aburrido. Solo había visto tejer a gente mayor con una paciencia y serenidad que me fascinaban, así que me decidí a probar. Mi abuela, con su sabiduría infinita y buen humor, se ofreció a enseñarme los puntos básicos. Al principio, aquello fue un desastre; mis dedos se enredaban con el hilo. Este es el principal desafío para muchos principiantes. Me llevó dos semanas dominar la tensión y la regularidad, pero poco a poco, la bufanda azul, gris y blanca empezó a tomar forma. Solo con persistencia se logra esto. La satisfacción de ver mi primera creación, imperfecta pero personal, fue inmensa. Aquel es el momento en que me di cuenta de lo gratificante que puede ser. Ahora puedo decir que es uno de mis pasatiempos favoritos, una forma de relajarme y crear. Solo con esto puedo desconectar.
base_en: The idea of learning to knit a scarf came about 3 months ago, on a cold, windy, and boring day. I had seen many older people knit with a patience, skill, and serenity that fascinated me, so I decided it was time to try. My grandmother, with her infinite wisdom, love, and good humor, offered to teach me the basic stitches: knit, purl, and garter stitch. At 1st, it was a disaster; my fingers were clumsy, slow, and constantly tangled with the yarn. It took me 2 weeks to master the tension, direction, and regularity of the knitting, but little by little, the scarf began to take shape, with its blue, gray, and white stripes. The satisfaction of seeing my 1st creation, imperfect, personal, and unique, was immense, and now I can say that it's one of my favorite hobbies, a way to relax, concentrate, and create.

text_es: Last week I prepared for my first big move and it was chaos, an adventure, a challenge. I had to empty every closet, drawer, and shelf in my apartment, mercilessly sorting objects, clothes, and books. The process of packing boxes, labeling them, and sealing them took me three full days, leaving my back, neck, and shoulders quite sore. It was fascinating how each object brought back memories, stories, or anecdotes; each trinket, ornament, or bauble transported me to another time. I discovered things I had completely forgotten: old photos, unopened letters, and a pair of mismatched socks. To avoid getting overwhelmed, you just need to go in stages, little by little and without rushing; this is the most effective method. Those are the steps I recommend. Now all that's left is the transport, assembly, and decoration phase in the new home. That was the beginning, but this is what's coming. Only time will tell how long this last part will last.
text_tgt_raw: La semana pasada me preparé para mi primera mudanza grande y fue un caos, una aventura, un desafío. Tuve que vaciar cada armario, cajón y estante de mi apartamento, clasificando objetos, ropa y libros sin piedad. El proceso de empacar cajas, etiquetarlas y sellarlas me llevó tres días completos, dejando mi espalda, cuello y hombros bastante adoloridos. Fue fascinante cómo cada objeto traía recuerdos, historias o anécdotas; cada baratija, adorno o chuchería me transportaba a otro tiempo. Descubrí cosas que había olvidado por completo: fotos viejas, cartas sin abrir y un par de calcetines desparejados. Para no abrumarse solo hace falta ir por etapas, poco a poco y sin prisas; este es el método más eficaz. Esos son los pasos que recomiendo. Ahora solo queda la fase de transporte, montaje y decoración en el nuevo hogar. Aquel fue el inicio, pero esto es lo que viene. Solo el tiempo dirá cuánto durará esta última parte.
base_en: Last week I prepared for my 1st big move and it was chaos, an adventure, a challenge. I had to empty every closet, drawer, and shelf in my apartment, sorting objects, clothes, and books mercilessly. The process of packing boxes, labeling them, and sealing them took me 3 full days, leaving my back, neck, and shoulders quite sore. It was fascinating how each object brought back memories, stories, or anecdotes; each trinket, bauble, or knick-knack transported me to another time. I discovered things I had completely forgotten: old photos, unopened letters, and 1 pair of mismatched socks. The key to not getting overwhelmed is to go in stages, little by little, and without rushing, organizing objects by categories such as kitchen, bedroom, or bathroom. Now all that's left is the transport, assembly, and decoration phase in the new home.

text_es: For a stress-free move, all you need is organization, anticipation, and patience. Only with this will you achieve an efficient transfer. Start 2 or 3 months before: decide which furniture, clothes, and objects you will take, donate, or discard. Remember, only essential items should accompany you. Buy boxes, packing tape, and bubble wrap; then, clearly label each box with its contents, destination, and fragility. This is a crucial step to avoid confusion. Hire a reliable moving company, with good references and competitive prices, or ask friends, family, and neighbors for help if you will do it yourself. Those who support you will make everything easier. Prepare a survival box with important documents, hygiene items, and essential medications for the first days in your new home; this is just a precaution. Before the key date, confirm services like electricity, water, and gas, and organize cleaning, painting, or small repairs in your old house.
text_tgt_raw: Para una mudanza sin estrés, solo hace falta organización, anticipación y paciencia. Solo con esto lograrás un traslado eficiente. Empieza 2 o 3 meses antes: decide qué muebles, ropa y objetos llevarás, donarás o desecharás. Recuerda, solo los elementos esenciales deben acompañarte. Compra cajas, cinta de embalar y plástico de burbujas; luego, etiqueta cada caja claramente con su contenido, destino y fragilidad. Este es un paso crucial para evitar confusiones. Contrata una empresa de mudanzas confiable, con buenas referencias y precios competitivos, o pide ayuda a amigos, familiares y vecinos si lo harás tu mismo. Aquellos que te apoyen harán que todo sea más sencillo. Prepara una caja de supervivencia con documentos importantes, artículos de higiene y medicamentos esenciales para los primeros días en tu nuevo hogar; esto solo es una precaución. Antes de la fecha clave, confirma servicios como electricidad, agua y gas, y organiza la limpieza, pintura o pequeñas reparaciones en tu antigua casa.
base_en: To prepare for a stress-free move, organize your tasks with anticipation, planning, and patience. Start 2 or 3 months before: decide what furniture, clothes, and objects you'll take, donate, or throw away. Buy boxes, packing tape, and bubble wrap, and label each box clearly with its contents, destination, and fragility. Hire a reliable moving company, with good references and competitive prices, or ask friends, family, and neighbors for help if you're going to do it yourself. Make a survival box with important documents, hygiene items, and essential medications for the 1st days in your new home. Before D-day arrives, confirm services like electricity, water, and gas, and organize cleaning, painting, or small repairs in your old house.

text_es: Caring for an urban garden only requires dedication, knowledge, and constant observation, but this allows you to harvest fresh, organic, and healthy food. To achieve this, you just need to select a suitable place—sunny, sheltered, and with good drainage—and prepare a nutrient-rich, aerated, and well-structured substrate. The choice of plants is crucial; they must be species adapted to the local climate, with growth cycles that fit the available space. Those like lettuces, radishes, and spinach are ideal, or aromatic herbs like basil and mint. Watering, only that, is fundamental and must be adapted to the season, the type of crop, and the water needs of each plant. It is vital to control pests and diseases ecologically, using preventive methods or natural remedies. Pruning, fertilization, and crop rotation are essential practices to maintain soil fertility, optimize production, and ensure long-term health. An urban garden is a space for learning, relaxation, and connection with nature, and this offers nutritional and environmental benefits.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar un huerto urbano solo exige dedicación, conocimiento y una observación constante, pero esto permite cosechar alimentos frescos, orgánicos y saludables. Para lograrlo, solo hace falta seleccionar un lugar adecuado –soleado, resguardado y con buen drenaje– y preparar un sustrato rico en nutrientes, aireado y bien estructurado. La elección de las plantas es crucial; estas deben ser especies adaptadas al clima local, con ciclos de crecimiento que se ajusten al espacio disponible. Aquellas como lechugas, rábanos y espinacas son ideales, o hierbas aromáticas como albahaca y menta. El riego, solo ese, es fundamental y debe adaptarse a la estación, el tipo de cultivo y las necesidades hídricas de cada planta. Es vital controlar plagas y enfermedades de forma ecológica, usando métodos preventivos o remedios naturales. La poda, la fertilización y la rotación de cultivos son prácticas esenciales para mantener la fertilidad del suelo, optimizar la producción y asegurar la salud a largo plazo. Un huerto urbano es un espacio de aprendizaje, relajación y conexión con la naturaleza, y esto ofrece beneficios nutricionales y ambientales.
base_en: Caring for an urban garden implies dedication, knowledge, and daily observation, allowing for the cultivation of fresh, organic, and healthy foods. It requires selecting the appropriate location—sunny, sheltered, and with good drainage—and preparing the substrate, which must be rich in nutrients, aerated, and well-structured. The choice of plants is key, prioritizing species adapted to the local climate, with growth cycles according to the available space, such as lettuces, radishes, and spinach, or aromatic herbs like basil, mint, and parsley. Watering is fundamental, adapting to the time of year, type of crop, and specific water needs of each plant. It's vital to control pests and diseases organically, using preventive methods, traps, or natural remedies. Pruning, fertilizing, and crop rotation are essential practices to maintain soil fertility, optimize production, and ensure the long-term health of the plants. An urban garden is a space for learning, relaxation, and connection with nature, offering both nutritional and environmental benefits.

text_es: Caring for an urban garden has been a transformative experience for me, a window into patience, effort, and reward. I remember the first time I planted tiny tomato, lettuce, and pepper seeds; I just knew the excitement was immense. Every morning, the first thing I do is check my plants, observe if new leaves, flowers, or fruits have sprouted, or if they need water, nutrients, or a little sun. It's fascinating to see how a strong, healthy, and productive plant emerges from a tiny germ, providing me with fresh, organic, and delicious ingredients for my kitchen. Sometimes challenges arise—pests, diseases, or adverse weather conditions—but learning to identify, treat, and prevent them is part of the process; this is continuous learning. In the end, the satisfaction of harvesting my own eggplants, zucchini, and herbs is indescribable, a joy that connects me with nature, with the earth, and with the cycle of life, and that I can only recommend to everyone. All it takes is a small space and a little dedication. Those who try it will not regret it, they will only reap benefits.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar un huerto urbano ha sido una experiencia transformadora para mí, una ventana a la paciencia, el esfuerzo y la recompensa. Recuerdo la primera vez que sembré diminutas semillas de tomate, lechuga y pimiento; solo sabía que la emoción era inmensa. Cada mañana, lo primero que hago es revisar mis plantas, observar si han brotado nuevas hojas, flores o frutos, o si necesitan agua, nutrientes o un poco de sol. Es fascinante ver cómo de un pequeño germen surge una planta fuerte, sana y productiva, que me provee de ingredientes frescos, orgánicos y deliciosos para mi cocina. A veces surgen desafíos —plagas, enfermedades o condiciones climáticas adversas—, pero aprender a identificarlos, tratarlos y prevenirlos es parte del proceso; este es un aprendizaje continuo. Al final, la satisfacción de cosechar mis propias berenjenas, calabacines y hierbas es indescriptible, una alegría que me conecta con la naturaleza, con la tierra y con el ciclo de la vida, y que solo puedo recomendar a todos. Solo hace falta un pequeño espacio y un poco de dedicación. Aquellos que lo prueben no se arrepentirán, solo cosecharán beneficios.

Every morning, the 1st thing I do is check my plants, observe if new leaves, flowers, or fruits have sprouted, or if they need watering, nutrients, or a little sun. It's fascinating to see how a strong, healthy, and productive plant emerges from a small germ, providing me with fresh, organic, and delicious ingredients for my kitchen. Sometimes there are challenges—pests, diseases, or adverse weather conditions—but learning to identify, treat, and prevent them is part of the process. text_es: To succeed with an urban garden, you just need to start with good planning. First, choose the right spot, whether it's a balcony, a terrace, or a patio; it must receive at least six hours of direct sunlight a day. Then, select the species to grow, opting for those that adapt to your climate and are easy to maintain, such as lettuce, tomatoes, or aromatic herbs; these are ideal for beginners. Soil preparation is key: use a nutrient-rich mixture with good drainage. Watering is another fundamental pillar; do it regularly, but avoid both waterlogging and extreme dryness. Only then will your plants grow strong. Observe your crops daily to detect any problems in time, such as yellow leaves or the presence of insects; this will allow you to act quickly. With patience and dedication, all that's left is to enjoy the fruits.
text_tgt_raw: Para tener éxito con un huerto urbano, solo hace falta empezar con una buena planificación. Primero, elige el lugar adecuado, ya sea un balcón, una terraza o un patio; este debe recibir al menos seis horas de sol directo al día. Luego, selecciona las especies a cultivar, optando por aquellas que se adapten a tu clima y sean fáciles de mantener, como lechugas, tomates o hierbas aromáticas; estas son ideales para principiantes. La preparación del suelo es clave: usa una mezcla rica en nutrientes y con buen drenaje. El riego es otro pilar fundamental; hazlo de forma regular, pero evita tanto el encharcamiento como la sequedad extrema. Solo así tus plantas crecerán fuertes. Observa tus cultivos a diario para detectar a tiempo cualquier problema, como hojas amarillas o la presencia de insectos; esto te permitirá actuar rápido. Con paciencia y dedicación, solo queda disfrutar de los frutos.
base_en: To successfully care for an urban garden, it's crucial to start with planning, choosing the space, and determining the species to cultivate. Make sure the location receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day, whether it's a balcony, a terrace, or a patio. Select plants suitable for your climate, such as lettuces, tomatoes, and aromatic herbs, which are hardy and easy to maintain. Soil preparation is fundamental; use a nutrient-rich mixture that drains well and is of good quality. Watering is another important pillar: do it regularly, avoiding waterlogging or extreme dryness of the soil. Observe your plants daily to detect pests, diseases, or nutritional deficiencies in time, such as yellow leaves, spots, or the presence of insects. With patience, dedication, and constant monitoring, you'll see your crops grow healthy, strong, and productive.

text_es: Planning a train trip is an excellent alternative for those seeking comfort, efficiency, and picturesque landscapes. To start, you only need to choose the destination, dates, and duration of the journey; this is fundamental, whether it's a weekend getaway, a long vacation, or a business trip. Next, you should research the available routes, the types of trains—regional, high-speed, or overnight—and the railway companies that operate in the desired area. Buying tickets in advance usually offers better prices, greater flexibility, and the opportunity to select specific seats, cars, or classes; this only requires a little foresight. It is advisable to pack smartly, bringing only essentials, identification documents, and some entertainment like books, music, or podcasts; that will only serve you if you don't plan to read or chat. During the trip, you can enjoy reading, conversing with other travelers, or simply admiring the scenery, architecture, and nature; this is what makes this mode of transportation unique. Finally, having a transportation plan upon arrival—taxi, bus, or subway—will ensure a smooth and stress-free transition; only then will the trip be perfect.
text_tgt_raw: Planificar un viaje en tren es una excelente alternativa para quienes buscan comodidad, eficiencia y paisajes pintorescos. Para empezar, solo hace falta elegir el destino, las fechas y la duración del trayecto; esto es fundamental, ya sea una escapada de fin de semana, unas vacaciones largas o un viaje de negocios. A continuación, debe investigar las rutas disponibles, los tipos de trenes —regionales, de alta velocidad o nocturnos— y las empresas ferroviarias que operan en la zona deseada. Comprar los billetes con antelación suele ofrecer mejores precios, mayor flexibilidad y la oportunidad de seleccionar asientos, vagones o clases específicos; esto solo requiere un poco de previsión. Se aconseja empacar de forma inteligente, llevando solo lo esencial, documentos de identidad y algún entretenimiento como libros, música o podcasts; aquel solo te servirá si no planeas leer o charlar. Durante el viaje, se puede disfrutar leyendo, conversando con otros viajeros o simplemente admirando el paisaje, la arquitectura y la naturaleza; esto es lo que hace este medio de transporte único. Finalmente, tener un plan de transporte al llegar —taxi, autobús o metro— garantizará una transición fluida y sin estrés; solo así el viaje será perfecto.
base_en: Planning a train trip is an excellent option for those seeking comfort, efficiency, and picturesque landscapes. Next, you should research available routes, types of trains—regional, high-speed, or overnight—and the railway companies operating in the desired area. Buying tickets in advance usually offers better prices, flexibility, and the opportunity to select specific seats, cars, or classes.
