text_es: Before adopting a dog, thoroughly research breeds to find the one that best suits your lifestyle; only then will you ensure a good coexistence. This is a fundamental step, as it requires evaluating the time available for walks and games. Make sure your home is prepared, eliminating potential dangers and establishing a dedicated space for your new friend; only then consider veterinary and food costs. Think about early socialization, as it is crucial for good future behavior, among other important aspects like basic training. It is essential that the whole family agrees and commits to the responsibility; only in this way will everyone understand that adaptation requires patience. Amidst the excitement, do not forget the importance of continuous education, both for you and for the dog; that process is mutual. Find a trusted veterinarian among the professionals in your area for initial and future check-ups; this person will not only give you advice but also help you with any unforeseen events.
text_tgt_raw: Antes de adoptar un perro, investiga a fondo las razas para encontrar la que mejor se adapte a tu estilo de vida; solo así asegurarás una buena convivencia. Este es un paso fundamental, pues requiere evaluar el tiempo disponible para paseos y juegos. Asegúrate de que tu hogar esté preparado, eliminando peligros potenciales y estableciendo un espacio propio para tu nuevo amigo; solo entonces considera los costos veterinarios y de alimentación. Piensa en la socialización temprana, ya que es crucial para un buen comportamiento futuro, entre otros aspectos importantes como el adiestramiento básico. Es esencial que toda la familia esté de acuerdo y se comprometa con la responsabilidad; solo de esta forma todos entenderán que la adaptación requiere paciencia. En medio de la emoción, no olvides la importancia de la educación continua, tanto para ti como para el perro; aquel proceso es mutuo. Busca un veterinario de confianza entre los profesionales de tu área para los chequeos iniciales y futuros; este no solo te dará consejos, sino que también te ayudará con cualquier imprevisto.
base_en: Before adopting a dog, thoroughly research breeds to find one that suits your lifestyle, while evaluating your available time for walks and games. Make sure your home is prepared, eliminating potential hazards and establishing a space of their own for your new friend, while considering veterinary and food costs. Think about early socialization, as it's crucial for good future behavior, among other important aspects like basic training. It's essential that the entire family agrees and commits to the responsibility, while everyone understands that adaptation requires patience. Amid the excitement, don't forget the importance of continuous education, both for you and for the dog, while you learn from each other. Find a trusted veterinarian among the professionals in your area for initial and future check-ups, and consider pet insurance.

text_es: Last Saturday, I finally decided to assemble a new bookshelf for the living room, a task I always put off. When I opened the box, I only found fifteen pieces of wood and an instruction manual that seemed to be written in hieroglyphics. This is the moment when you doubt whether to continue. My dog just looked at me curiously, oblivious to my dilemma. There was a moment of despair at so many boards and screws, but I decided to follow the pictures. That was the only way I could make progress. A friend called me to ask how I was doing, and that gave me a small break. Between the noise of the neighbors and my own inexperience, the process was slower than I expected. That was a real challenge. Finally, after almost three hours, the bookshelf was standing, perhaps a little crooked, but functional. All I can say is that the satisfaction was immense; that's the real prize.
text_tgt_raw: El sábado pasado, por fin me decidí a montar una estantería nueva para el salón, una tarea que siempre postergo. Al abrir la caja, solo encontré quince piezas de madera y un manual de instrucciones que parecía escrito en jeroglíficos. Este es el momento en que uno duda si seguir adelante. Mi perro solo me miraba con curiosidad, ajeno a mi dilema. Hubo un instante de desesperación ante tantas tablas y tornillos, pero decidí seguir las imágenes. Solo así podía avanzar. Una amiga me llamó para preguntar qué tal, y eso me dio un pequeño respiro. Entre el ruido de los vecinos y mi propia inexperiencia, el proceso fue más lento de lo que esperaba. Aquel fue un verdadero reto. Finalmente, después de casi tres horas, la estantería estaba en pie, quizás un poco torcida, pero funcional. Solo me queda decir que la satisfacción fue inmensa; ese es el verdadero premio.
base_en: Last Saturday, I embarked on the adventure of assembling a new bookshelf for the living room, a task I always postpone while I look for the perfect moment. Upon opening the box, I found 15 wooden pieces and an instruction manual that seemed written in hieroglyphics, while my dog watched me with curiosity. There was a moment of despair amid so many boards and screws, but I took a deep breath and decided to follow the pictures, while a friend called me on the phone to ask how I was doing. The truth is that, between the neighbors' noises and my own inexperience, the process was slower than expected, while I tried to fit each piece. Finally, after almost 3 hours, the bookshelf was standing, a little crooked perhaps, but functional, and a feeling of pride washed over me amid my small chaos.

text_es: To efficiently assemble a shelf, you just need to start by carefully reading the instructions, identifying all the parts and hardware. Make sure you have the right tools on hand: screwdrivers, hammer, and level. Always follow the assembly order suggested by the manufacturer. It's very helpful to sort screws and accessories into the different compartments of a box; this will simplify the process as you need them. If the shelf is large or heavy, ask someone for help, as it can be difficult to maintain stability when handling long panels; only then will accidents be avoided. All that's left is to check that all connections are firm, verifying with the level that the structure is perfectly straight; this will prevent future instabilities among the objects you place. Don't rush, take your time with each step and you will enjoy your new, well-assembled shelf. This is a process that requires patience and attention. Those who ignore these tips will only encounter more difficulties.
text_tgt_raw: Para montar un estante de forma eficiente, solo hace falta empezar leyendo las instrucciones con atención, identificando todas las piezas y el herraje. Asegúrese de tener las herramientas adecuadas a mano: destornilladores, martillo y nivel. Siga siempre el orden de montaje sugerido por el fabricante. Es muy útil clasificar los tornillos y accesorios en los distintos compartimentos de una caja; esto simplificará el proceso a medida que los necesite. Si el estante es grande o pesado, pida ayuda a alguien, ya que puede ser difícil mantener la estabilidad al manipular paneles largos; solo así se evitarán accidentes. Solo queda comprobar que todas las uniones estén firmes, verificando con el nivel que la estructura esté perfectamente recta; esto evitará futuras inestabilidades entre los objetos que coloque. No se apresure, tómese su tiempo con cada paso y disfrutará de su nuevo estante bien montado. Este es un proceso que requiere paciencia y atención. Aquellos que ignoren estos consejos, solo se encontrarán con más dificultades.
base_en: To efficiently assemble a shelf unit, it's crucial to start by carefully reading the instructions, while identifying all the parts and hardware. Make sure you've the right tools on hand—screwdrivers, hammer, and level—while following the assembly order suggested by the manufacturer. It's very useful to sort screws and fittings into the different compartments of a box, which will simplify the process as you need them. Ask someone for help if the shelf unit is large or heavy, as it can be difficult to maintain stability while handling long panels. Check that all joints are firm, while verifying with the level that the structure is perfectly straight, thus avoiding future instabilities among the objects you place. Don't rush, take your time with each step, and you'll enjoy your new, well-assembled shelf unit.

text_es: Saving for vacation is key to enjoying a well-deserved break without financial worries, while every detail of the trip is meticulously planned. Only then can the necessary peace of mind be achieved. This is a process that involves allocating a regular portion of income to a specific fund, among other financial strategies. It is essential to establish a clear budget, amidst daily expenses, that considers transportation, accommodation, food, and activities; only then will unnecessary expenses be sought to be reduced. Methods such as the 50/30/20 rule can be applied, where only 20% of income is dedicated to savings, managing other commitments. Additionally, comparing prices and offers, among the various available options, is useful for optimizing money; only this guarantees better planning. The important thing is to be consistent and disciplined, amidst the temptations to spend, to achieve the desired goal and fully enjoy the experience. Those who achieve it know that the effort is worthwhile, as this is the best way to ensure a worry-free trip.
text_tgt_raw: Ahorrar para las vacaciones es clave para disfrutar un merecido descanso sin agobios económicos, mientras cada detalle del viaje se planifica meticulosamente. Solo así se consigue la tranquilidad necesaria. Este es un proceso que implica destinar una parte regular de los ingresos a un fondo específico, entre otras estrategias financieras. Es fundamental establecer un presupuesto claro, en medio de los gastos cotidianos, que considere transporte, alojamiento, comida y actividades; solo así se buscará reducir gastos innecesarios. Se pueden aplicar métodos como la regla 50/30/20, donde solo un 20% del ingreso se dedica a ahorros, gestionando otros compromisos. Además, comparar precios y ofertas, entre las diversas opciones disponibles, es útil para optimizar el dinero; solo esto garantiza una mejor planificación. Lo importante es ser constante y disciplinado, en medio de las tentaciones de gastar, para alcanzar la meta deseada y disfrutar plenamente la experiencia. Aquellos que lo logran saben que el esfuerzo vale la pena, pues esta es la mejor forma de asegurar un viaje sin preocupaciones.
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries, while every detail of the trip is planned. It consists of allocating a regular portion of income to a specific fund, among other financial strategies. It's advisable to establish a clear budget, amid daily expenses, that considers transportation, accommodation, food, and activities, while seeking to reduce unnecessary expenses. Methods such as the 50/30/20 rule can be applied, where 20% of income is dedicated to savings, while other commitments are managed. In addition, it's useful to compare prices and offers, among the various available options, to optimize money. It's important to be consistent and disciplined, amid the temptations to spend, to achieve the desired goal and fully enjoy the experience.

text_es: Last year, I decided I wanted to go to Japan, and although the idea initially seemed crazy, I just started saving immediately. Every month, upon receiving my salary, I deposited a fixed percentage into a separate account; among my colleagues, only a few did this. Amidst the work routine, it was easy to lose sight of the goal, but the thought of the temples and the food kept me motivated while my friends went out partying. It was a challenge, but as I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and through sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the money. Now, as I write this, there are only three days left until my flight, amidst the excitement for what awaits me, and I can say that the effort was worth it. That was a year of perseverance, and this, without a doubt, will be the year of reward. I prefer these kinds of goals, as only then can success be savored; that process just requires discipline.
text_tgt_raw: El año pasado decidí que quería ir a Japón y, aunque la idea al principio parecía descabellada, solo comencé a ahorrar de inmediato. Cada mes, al recibir mi salario, depositaba un porcentaje fijo en una cuenta separada; esto, entre mis compañeros, solo unos pocos lo hacían. En medio de la rutina laboral, era fácil perder de vista el objetivo, pero el pensamiento de los templos y la comida me mantenía motivado mientras mis amigos salían de fiesta. Fue un desafío, pero mientras veía crecer la cantidad, mi emoción aumentaba y, entre sacrificios y pequeñas renuncias, logré reunir el dinero. Ahora, mientras escribo esto, solo faltan tres días para mi vuelo, en medio de la emoción por lo que me espera, y puedo decir que el esfuerzo valió la pena. Aquel fue un año de constancia y este, sin duda, será el de la recompensa. Prefiero este tipo de metas, ya que solo así se saborea el éxito; aquel proceso solo requiere disciplina.
base_en: Last year, I decided I wanted to go to Japan, and, while the idea seemed crazy at 1st, I started saving immediately. Every month, while I received my salary, I put a fixed percentage into a separate account, something that, among my colleagues, few did. Amid the daily work routine, it was easy to forget the goal, but the thought of the temples and the food, while my friends were out partying, kept me motivated. It was a challenge, but, while I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and, among sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the money. Now, while I'm writing this, I'm 3 days away from my flight, amid the excitement of what awaits me, and I can say that the effort was worth it.

text_es: To save for vacation, you just need to establish a clear budget and monitor monthly expenses. Only then will you achieve effective control. It is essential to prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small; this is the most important step. Consider opening a separate savings account for that purpose; that will help you avoid the temptation to use the money for other things. You just need to look for ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your daily life. For example, you can limit eating out or look for deals on services; whoever makes an effort always finds better prices. Plan ahead to find cheaper flights and accommodation. Saving amidst your daily responsibilities may seem complicated, but with discipline and adjustments, you will see your savings grow. This is not impossible; it just requires consistency.
text_tgt_raw: Para ahorrar para las vacaciones, solo hace falta establecer un presupuesto claro y monitorear los gastos mensuales. Solo así logrará un control efectivo. Es fundamental priorizar la asignación de una cantidad fija cada mes, aunque sea pequeña; este es el paso más importante. Considere abrir una cuenta de ahorro separada para ese fin; eso le ayudará a evitar la tentación de usar el dinero para otras cosas. Solo debe buscar formas de reducir costos innecesarios en su vida diaria. Por ejemplo, puede limitar salir a comer o buscar ofertas en servicios; aquel que se esfuerza siempre encuentra mejores precios. Planifique con anticipación para encontrar vuelos y alojamiento más económicos. Ahorrar en medio de sus responsabilidades diarias puede parecer complicado, pero con disciplina y ajustes, verá crecer sus ahorros. Esto no es imposible, solo requiere constancia.
base_en: To save for vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget, while monitoring your monthly expenses. Prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small, as consistent saving among your income and expenses is fundamental. Consider opening a separate savings account for that purpose, which will help you avoid the temptation to use that money for other things, while looking for ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your daily life. You can, for example, limit eating out or look for deals on services, while planning ahead to find better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving amid your daily responsibilities may seem complicated, but with discipline and adjustments, you'll see your savings grow, while your well-deserved rest approaches.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, and for this alone it is worthwhile. It is a process that demands dedication and patience, amidst constant challenges that, with perseverance, are overcome. By developing new linguistic skills, we also train our minds; this is one of the most notable benefits. Many methods exist to achieve it; the one each person chooses will depend on their circumstances. Some prefer total immersion in the language's country of origin, considering it the most effective; this is only possible for a few. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially in the most difficult phases. Only with constant practice does the unknown transform into the familiar. In fact, only practice makes perfect, and this is a universal principle.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender un nuevo idioma es una experiencia enriquecedora que abre puertas a otras culturas, y solo por esto ya vale la pena. Es un proceso que exige dedicación y paciencia, en medio de desafíos constantes que, con perseverancia, se superan. Al desarrollar nuevas habilidades lingüísticas, también entrenamos nuestra mente; este es uno de los beneficios más notables. Muchos métodos existen para lograrlo; aquel que elige cada uno dependerá de sus circunstancias. Algunos prefieren la inmersión total en el país de origen del idioma, considerándolo el más efectivo; esto solo es posible para unos pocos. Mantener la motivación es crucial, especialmente en las fases más difíciles. Solo con práctica constante se transforma lo desconocido en familiar. De hecho, solo la práctica hace la maestría, y este es un principio universal.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, while allowing us to communicate with more people. It's a process that demands dedication and patience, amid constant challenges that, with perseverance, are overcome. While we develop new linguistic skills, we also train our mind, improving cognitive agility and problem-solving ability, among other benefits. Many methods exist to achieve this—from intensive courses to self-taught learning—while total immersion in the language's country of origin is considered by many the most effective way. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially amid the most difficult phases, between frustration and slow progress. The more one practices, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unknown into the familiar.

text_es: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese five years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I enrolled in classes while working full-time, which presented a considerable logistical challenge. Between grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; as hiragana and katakana characters mixed in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, with its soft consonants and short vowels, felt strange to me at first. There were days, trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amidst the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; only this pushed me to continue. Others became discouraged, but I persisted, because only the reward of understanding was my driving force. This process not only requires dedication, but also patience. Only those who persist achieve their goals.
text_tgt_raw: Recuerdo vivamente cuando comencé a aprender japonés hace cinco años, y fue una experiencia que cambió mi perspectiva. Me inscribí en clases mientras trabajaba a tiempo completo, lo cual representó un desafío logístico considerable. Entre libros de gramática y diccionarios, descubrí una cultura fascinante; mientras los caracteres hiragana y katakana se mezclaban en mi mente, me sentía como un niño. La pronunciación, entre sus suaves consonantes y vocales cortas, me resultó extraña al principio. Hubo días, intentando formar oraciones complejas, en los que la frustración era palpable. Sin embargo, en medio de la dificultad, la satisfacción de entender una palabra nueva o construir una frase correcta era inmensa; solo esto me impulsaba a seguir. Otros se desanimaron, pero yo persistí, porque solo la recompensa de comprender era mi motor. Este proceso no solo requiere dedicación, sino también paciencia. Solo aquellos que persisten logran sus metas.
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese 5 years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I signed up for classes while working full-time, which was a significant logistical challenge. Amid grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; while hiragana and katakana characters mixed in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, among the soft consonants and short vowels, felt strange to me at 1st. There were days, while I was trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amid the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; while others became discouraged, I persisted, because the reward of understanding was my driving force.

text_es: When embarking on learning a new language, only total immersion, combined with realistic expectations, proves truly effective. One of the most frequent mistakes is wanting to master everything at once, instead of accepting gradual progress; you just need to celebrate every small advance while exposing yourself to authentic material. When listening and reading, try not to translate every word; instead, try to understand the general context, as this is a very effective method. Amidst the frustration that will inevitably arise, always remember why you started and maintain daily discipline; just dedicate at least thirty minutes a day, seeking opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the available resources, choose two or three that really work for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods; the one that you enjoy the most will be the best.
text_tgt_raw: Al embarcarse en el aprendizaje de un nuevo idioma, solo la inmersión total, combinada con expectativas realistas, resulta verdaderamente eficaz. Uno de los errores más frecuentes es querer dominarlo todo de golpe, en lugar de aceptar un progreso gradual; solo hace falta celebrar cada pequeño avance mientras se expone uno a material auténtico. Al escuchar y leer, procure no traducir cada palabra; intente más bien comprender el contexto general, este es un método muy efectivo. En medio de la frustración que inevitablemente surgirá, recuerde siempre por qué empezó y mantenga la disciplina diaria; solo dedique al menos treinta minutos al día, buscando oportunidades para practicar con hablantes nativos. De entre los recursos disponibles, elija dos o tres que le funcionen realmente y no se abrume con demasiados métodos; aquel que le divierta más será el mejor.
base_en: When beginning to learn a new language, it's crucial to immerse yourself completely, while maintaining realistic expectations. Among the most common mistakes is wanting to master everything at 1st, instead of accepting gradual progress; it's important to celebrate every small advance while exposing yourself to authentic material. While listening and reading, try not to translate every word, but rather to understand the general context, a very effective method. Amid the frustration that will inevitably arise, remember why you started and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes a day, while looking for opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the available resources, choose 2 or 3 that really work for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, while having fun with the process.

text_es: Participating in a popular race is experiencing a sporting event open to the general public, where only passion unites runners of various ages and levels. These events promote coexistence and the spirit of self-improvement. These, which often include distances of 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, are an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance. You only have to see the festive atmosphere; it's contagious. It's common to see people cheering in the streets, creating an energy that only drives participants to achieve their goals. Preparation for a popular race only requires gradual and constant training, paying attention to diet and rest, between 2 and 3 months before the event. Finally, the moment of crossing the finish line is a reward in itself, amidst the applause of the public and the satisfaction of having completed the challenge. One who is already thinking about the next one.
text_tgt_raw: Participar en una carrera popular es vivir un evento deportivo abierto al publico general, donde solo la pasión une a corredores de diversas edades y niveles. En estas citas se fomenta la convivencia y el espiritu de superacion. Estas, que a menudo incluyen distancias de 5 km, 10 km, o incluso medias maratones, son una excelente oportunidad para poner a prueba la resistencia física. Solo hace falta ver el ambiente festivo; este es contagioso. Es común ver a la gente animando en las calles, creando una energía que solo impulsa a los participantes a alcanzar sus metas. La preparacion para una carrera popular solo requiere un entrenamiento gradual y constante, cuidando la dieta y el descanso, entre 2 y 3 meses antes del evento. Finalmente, el momento de cruzar la meta es una recompensa en si, en medio de los aplausos del publico y la satisfaccion de haber completado el desafio. Aquel que ya piensa en la proxima.
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a sporting event open to the general public, where runners of various ages and skill levels compete together, while fostering coexistence and a spirit of self-improvement. These races, which often include distances of 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, are an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance, while enjoying the festive atmosphere. It's common to see people cheering in the streets, creating an atmosphere of contagious energy, while participants strive to achieve their goals. Preparation for a popular race usually requires gradual and constant training, while taking care of diet and rest, between 2 and 3 months before the event. Finally, the moment of crossing the finish line is a reward in itself, amid the applause of the public and the satisfaction of having completed the challenge, while many are already thinking about the next race.

text_es: This Sunday I launched myself into my first community race in the neighborhood, an experience I had been wanting to try for a while. I only woke up before the sun was fully out, with that mix of nerves and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was amazing: there were more than 500 people, among experienced athletes and novices like me, and everyone was smiling. Only while we waited for the starting gun, I chatted a bit with the person next to me; he gave me some words of encouragement. The first two kilometers were difficult, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement from the crowd, only that pushed me to continue. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amidst applause, was unbeatable. That was a unique moment. Without a doubt, I will repeat soon, only if my legs allow me. This was a fantastic experience.
text_tgt_raw: Este domingo me lancé a mi primera carrera popular en el barrio, una vivencia que llevaba tiempo queriendo probar. Solo desperté antes de que el sol saliera del todo, con esa mezcla de nervios y emoción. En la línea de salida, el ambiente era asombroso: había más de 500 personas, entre atletas experimentados y novatos como yo, y todos mostraban una sonrisa. Solo mientras esperábamos el pistoletazo de salida, conversé un poco con quien tenía al lado; este me dio algunas palabras de ánimo. Los dos primeros kilómetros resultaron difíciles, pero la energía de la gente, los gritos de aliento entre la multitud, solo eso me impulsó a seguir. Corrí a mi propio ritmo, disfrutando del paisaje al pasar por calles conocidas, y la sensación de cruzar la meta, entre aplausos, fue insuperable. Aquel era un momento único. Sin duda, repetiré pronto, solo si mis piernas me lo permiten. Esta fue una experiencia fantástica.
base_en: This Sunday I decided to run my 1st popular race in the neighborhood, an experience I'd been wanting to try for a while. I woke up early, while the sun wasn't fully out yet, with that mix of nerves and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was incredible: there were more than 500 people, among experienced athletes and novices like me, all with a smile. While we waited for the starting gun, I chatted a bit with the person next to me, who gave me some encouragement. The 1st 2 km were tough, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement amid the crowd, pushed me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amid all the applause, was unbeatable. Without a doubt, I'll repeat soon, while my legs allow me to.

text_es: For your first popular race, just focus on enjoying the experience, always maintaining a constant and comfortable pace. Don't try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, because you will only get exhausted quickly; it's preferable to start slow while your body adapts. Make sure you have rested well and eaten something light two or three hours before, hydrating yourself adequately. During the race, listen to your body and, if you feel bad in the middle of the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the only goal is to finish it, not to win; this is the true achievement. When you cross the finish line, you will feel great satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, among the rest of the participants, and the shared energy; that is the key. Those moments are what matter, this is your race.
text_tgt_raw: Para tu primera carrera popular, solo céntrate en disfrutar la experiencia, manteniendo siempre un ritmo constante y cómodo. No intentes ir demasiado rápido al principio, entre los otros corredores, pues solo te agotarás rápidamente; es preferible empezar despacio mientras tu cuerpo se adapta. Asegúrate de haber descansado bien y comido algo ligero dos o tres horas antes, hidratándote adecuadamente. Durante la carrera, escucha a tu cuerpo y, si te sientes mal en medio de la multitud, disminuye la velocidad o detente un momento. Piensa que el objetivo solo es terminarla, no ganar; este es el verdadero logro. Al cruzar la meta, sentirás una gran satisfacción. Disfruta del ambiente, entre el resto de los participantes, y la energía compartida; aquella es la clave. Esos momentos son los que importan, esta es tu carrera.
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience, while maintaining a constant and comfortable pace. Don't try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, as you'll get exhausted quickly; it's preferable to start slowly while your body adapts. Make sure you've rested well and eaten something light 2 or 3 hours before, while hydrating adequately. During the race, listen to your body and, if you feel bad amid the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the goal is to finish it, not to win, and while you cross the finish line, you'll feel great satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, among the rest of the participants, and the shared energy amid all the runners.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that revives the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, preserving their cultural value. Generally, it involves several stages; this begins with a deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, while evaluating structural integrity. In the midst of this work, damaged parts, such as broken legs or detached veneers, are repaired using traditional techniques and materials compatible with the original era; only in this way is its authenticity ensured. The choice of the final finish is crucial, among options such as oils, waxes, or varnishes; the goal is only to replicate the original look or give it new life. Those who dedicate themselves to this know that it is an art that requires patience and skill, always considering the history and style of the furniture. Only with dedication are the challenges that may arise overcome, and the final result is a restored piece that can last many more years, decorating and telling its own story. Only in this way is the legacy kept alive.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar muebles antiguos es un proceso gratificante que revive la belleza y funcionalidad de piezas con historia, preservando su valor cultural. Generalmente, implica varias etapas; este se inicia con una limpieza profunda y la eliminación de capas viejas de barniz o pintura, mientras se evalúa la integridad estructural. En medio de este trabajo, se reparan las partes dañadas, como patas rotas o chapas desprendidas, usando técnicas tradicionales y materiales compatibles con la época original; solo así se asegura su autenticidad. La elección del acabado final es crucial, entre opciones como aceites, ceras o barnices; solo se busca replicar el aspecto original o dar una nueva vida. Aquel que se dedica a esto sabe que es un arte que requiere paciencia y habilidad, considerando siempre la historia y el estilo del mueble. Solo con dedicación se superan los desafíos que puedan surgir, y el resultado final es una pieza restaurada que puede durar muchos años más, decorando y contando su propia historia. Solo de esta manera se mantiene vivo el legado.
base_en: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that revives the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, while preserving their cultural value. Generally, it involves several stages, among them deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, while the structural integrity of the piece is evaluated. Amid this work, damaged parts, such as broken legs or detached veneers, are repaired using traditional techniques and materials compatible with the furniture's original era, while drastic solutions are avoided. The choice of the final finish is crucial, among options like oils, waxes, or varnishes, while seeking to replicate the original look or give the furniture new life. It's an art that requires patience and skill, while considering the furniture's history and style. Amid the challenges that may arise, the final result is a restored piece that can last many more years, while decorating and telling its own story.

text_es: The decision to restore an antique piece of furniture came to me suddenly, while I was strolling through an antique market. I saw a discolored Elizabethan dresser with several layers of paint that hid its original beauty; among all the objects, this one captured my attention. I started the project with some apprehension, carefully sanding every corner and discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amidst wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that only required a lot of patience as it progressed day by day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, from specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing how the furniture regained its original splendor was incredible; it only needed time and dedication. Only then, in the midst of all the effort, the reward was immense, as I imagined its new life in my living room. That would become the center of attention. It wasn't just a piece of furniture, but a revived work of art, and this is the best part.
text_tgt_raw: La decisión de restaurar un mueble antiguo surgió de repente, mientras paseaba por un mercado de antigüedades. Vi una cómoda isabelina descolorida y con varias capas de pintura que ocultaban su belleza original; entre todos los objetos, este acaparó mi atención. Empecé el proyecto con cierta inquietud, lijando con cuidado cada rincón y descubriendo la veta de la madera que había estado oculta durante décadas. Fue un proceso lento, entre virutas y olor a barniz, que solo requirió mucha paciencia a medida que avanzaba día a día. Aprendí sobre diferentes técnicas de carpintería y acabado, entre libros especializados y tutoriales en línea, mientras escuchaba música clásica para relajarme. Ver cómo el mueble recuperaba su esplendor original fue increíble; solo necesitaba tiempo y dedicación. Solo así, en medio de todo el esfuerzo, la recompensa fue inmensa, mientras imaginaba su nueva vida en mi salón. Aquel se convertiría en el centro de todas las miradas. No era solo un mueble, sino una obra de arte revivida, y esta es la mejor parte.

I started the project with some trepidation, while carefully sanding every corner, discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amid wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that required a lot of patience as I progressed day by day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, among specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing the furniture regain its original splendor was incredible; amid all the effort, the reward was immense, while I imagined its new life in my living room.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a process that requires only patience and dedication at each stage. First, a deep cleaning is essential to remove dust and dirt accumulated over years; only then will its true condition be revealed. Then, identify the damage and decide your strategy: are you looking to preserve the original patina or do you prefer to give it a more contemporary finish? This is a crucial step. Sandpaper, for example, should be used carefully, progressing from a coarser grit to a finer one to prepare the surface; only then will you achieve the desired result. Afterwards, apply thin and even layers of finish, always respecting the drying times between each one; that is the key to a good result. Enjoying the resurgence of the piece's beauty in your hands is the best reward; that is the true charm of this art.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar un mueble antiguo es un proceso que requiere solo paciencia y dedicación en cada etapa. Primero, es fundamental una limpieza profunda para eliminar polvo y suciedad acumulados durante años; solo así se revelará su estado real. Luego, identifica los daños y decide tu estrategia: ¿buscas preservar la pátina original o prefieres darle un acabado más contemporáneo? Este es un paso crucial. La lija, por ejemplo, debe usarse con cuidado, progresando de un grano más grueso a uno más fino para preparar la superficie; solo así conseguirás el resultado deseado. Después, aplica capas finas y uniformes de acabado, respetando siempre los tiempos de secado entre una y otra; aquella es la clave para un buen resultado. Disfrutar del resurgimiento de la belleza de la pieza en tus manos es la mejor recompensa; ese es el verdadero encanto de este arte.
base_en: When restoring an antique piece of furniture, patience is key while you work through each stage of the process. Start with a deep cleaning, while you remove accumulated dust and dirt from over the years. Identify the damage and define your approach, while you consider whether you want to maintain the original patina or if you prefer a more modern finish among the options. Sand carefully, while you gradually progress from a coarser grit to a finer one, and prepare the surface for the next step, which could be staining or painting. Apply thin, even coats of finish, while you wait the appropriate drying time between each one. Enjoy the process of watching the beauty of the antique furniture resurface in your hands.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party demands meticulous planning and the coordination of various elements. You just need to define the number of guests, including family and friends, and the available budget, choosing a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is crucial, whether at home or by renting a space, and it's important to send invitations in advance so attendees can organize themselves, while food and drinks are chosen. Only then is their attendance ensured. Activities or games should be considered to entertain those present, especially the little ones, amidst the celebration. This process is key to success. Don't forget the cake, the central element of the party; only this is irreplaceable, while the decoration is organized to create a festive atmosphere. Anyone who omits this step risks a dull event. Finally, amidst all the preparations, the most important thing is just to enjoy the process and the company. That's what really counts.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños demanda una planificación minuciosa y la coordinación de diversos elementos. Solo hace falta definir el número de invitados, entre familiares y amigos, y el presupuesto disponible, eligiendo un tema si se desea. La selección del lugar es crucial, sea en casa o alquilando un espacio, y es importante enviar las invitaciones con antelación para que los asistentes se organicen, mientras se escogen la comida y las bebidas. Solo así se asegura su asistencia. Se deben considerar actividades o juegos para entretener a los presentes, especialmente a los más pequeños, en medio de la celebración. Este proceso es clave para el éxito. No hay que olvidar el pastel, el elemento central de la fiesta, solo este es insustituible, mientras se organiza la decoración para crear un ambiente festivo. Aquel que omita este paso, se arriesga a un evento sin brillo. Finalmente, en medio de todos los preparativos, lo más importante es solo disfrutar el proceso y la compañía. Eso es lo que realmente cuenta.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires careful planning while coordinating various elements. It's essential to define the number of guests—among family and friends—and the available budget, while choosing a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is crucial, whether at home or renting a space, and it's important to send it in advance so that guests can organize themselves while the food and drinks are chosen. Activities or games should be considered to entertain attendees, especially the little ones, amid the celebration. Don't forget the cake, the central element of the party, while organizing the decoration to create a festive atmosphere. Finally, amid all the preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the company.

text_es: Organizing my 40th birthday was a real odyssey, a mix of excitement and chaos. I started planning it two months in advance, making guest lists and thinking about the theme, but I soon realized that the space in my house wasn't enough. Because of that, I had to look for a venue, and this caused expenses to skyrocket. Choosing the menu was another challenge, as I wanted to please all fifty of my guests with vegetarian and gluten-free options; in the end, I could only satisfy most of them. On the afternoon of the party, between the decorations and the arrival of the first attendees, I felt overwhelmed, as the music was playing and laughter began to fill the air. This made me doubt if all the effort was worth it. However, only when I was dancing and celebrating with my loved ones did all the tension dissipate and I felt truly happy; only at that moment did I understand that the effort was worth it. Those who know me know that I only seek happiness in these celebrations.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar mi cumpleaños número 40 fue una verdadera odisea, una mezcla de emoción y caos. Empecé a planificarlo dos meses antes, haciendo listas de invitados y pensando en la temática, pero pronto me di cuenta de que el espacio en mi casa no era suficiente. Por ello, tuve que buscar un local, y esto hizo que los gastos se dispararan. Elegir el menú fue otro desafío, pues quería complacer a todos mis cincuenta invitados con opciones vegetarianas y sin gluten; al final, solo pude satisfacer a la mayoría. La tarde de la fiesta, entre las decoraciones y la llegada de los primeros asistentes, me sentí abrumada, ya que la música sonaba y las risas empezaban a llenar el aire. Esto me hizo dudar si valía la pena tanto esfuerzo. No obstante, solo cuando bailaba y celebraba con mis seres queridos, toda la tensión se disipó y me sentí verdaderamente feliz; solo en ese instante comprendí que el esfuerzo valió la pena. Aquellos que me conocen saben que solo busco la felicidad en estas celebraciones.
base_en: Organizing my 40th birthday was a real odyssey, between the excitement and the chaos it entailed. I started planning it 2 months in advance, while making guest lists and thinking about the theme. Amid the preparation, I realized that the space in my house wasn't enough, so I had to look for a venue, while expenses soared. I chose a menu that everyone would like, among vegetarian and gluten-free options, while trying to please each of my 50 guests. On the afternoon of the party, amid the decorations and the arrival of the 1st attendees, I felt overwhelmed, while the music was already playing and laughter began to fill the air. In the end, while dancing and celebrating with my loved ones, all the tension dissipated and I felt truly happy, despite the initial challenges.

text_es: Organizing a successful birthday only requires a little planning. First, make a guest list to know how many people will attend, and set a realistic budget; this is crucial to avoid overspending. Then, decide on the date and venue well in advance, especially if it's a large event; two or three months are usually ideal. Meanwhile, look for inspiration for the theme and decoration; this will only give you ideas. Think about the food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences of your guests; this is fundamental. Only then can you avoid surprises. Delegate tasks to trusted friends or family so you don't feel overwhelmed; this will allow you to enjoy it more. Don't forget the music and entertainment; only a good repertoire is needed. And most importantly: have fun.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar un cumpleaños exitoso solo requiere un poco de planificación. Primero, haga una lista de invitados para saber cuántas personas asistirán, y establezca un presupuesto realista; esto es crucial para no excederse. Luego, decida la fecha y el lugar con suficiente antelación, sobre todo si es un evento grande; dos o tres meses suelen ser lo ideal. Mientras tanto, busque inspiración para el tema y la decoración; esto solo le dará ideas. Piense en la comida y las bebidas, considerando posibles alergias o preferencias dietéticas de sus invitados; esto es fundamental. Solo así podrá evitar sorpresas. Delegue tareas a amigos o familiares de confianza para no sentirse abrumado; esto le permitirá disfrutar más. No olvide la música y el entretenimiento; solo hace falta un buen repertorio. Y lo más importante: diviértase.
base_en: Organizing a successful birthday party requires planning. Start with the guest list to know how many people will attend, while defining a realistic budget so you don't overspend. Decide on the date and venue with enough anticipation—2 to 3 months if it's a large event—while looking for inspiration for the theme and decorations. Think about food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences among your guests, and delegate tasks to trusted friends or family members so you don't get overwhelmed. Don't forget the music and entertainment, while making sure everything is under control so you can also enjoy yourself amid the celebration. And most importantly: have fun.

text_es: Caring for houseplants requires attention to several key factors for their health and optimal growth, in addition to their harmonious integration into our home. You just need to choose suitable species for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity, thus avoiding both overwatering and underwatering. Good lighting is crucial; only some plants thrive near windows, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering must be adapted to each plant, as only some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry out slightly between waterings. Amidst these cares, this also involves fertilizing periodically and cleaning dust from the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage; this can cause diseases and the death of the plant. Those who are new to this should know it.
text_tgt_raw: El cuidado de las plantas de interior exige atencion a varios factores clave para su salud y crecimiento optimo, ademas de su integracion armoniosa en nuestro hogar. Solo hace falta elegir especies adecuadas para el ambiente interior, considerando luz, temperatura y humedad disponibles, evitando asi tanto el exceso como la falta de riego. Una buena iluminacion es crucial; solo algunas plantas prosperan cerca de ventanas, mientras otras prefieren rincones con luz indirecta. El riego debe adaptarse a cada planta, pues solo algunas necesitan suelo constantemente humedo, mientras otras prefieren que se seque ligeramente entre riegos. En medio de estos cuidados, este es tambien fertilizar periodicamente y limpiar el polvo de las hojas para facilitar la fotosintesis, monitoreando la aparicion de plagas. Entre los errores comunes estan el exceso de riego y la falta de drenaje adecuado; ese puede causar enfermedades y la muerte de la planta. Aquellos que se inician en esto deben saberlo.
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires attention to several key factors to ensure their health and optimal growth, while integrating them harmoniously into our home. It's essential to choose suitable species for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity, while avoiding over or under watering. Good lighting is crucial; many plants thrive near windows, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering must be adapted to each plant, as some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry slightly between waterings. Amid this care, it's also important to fertilize periodically and clean dust from the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, while monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage, which can cause diseases and the death of the plant.

text_es: Caring for my houseplants has become a personal therapy, a method to find calm while the outside world maintains its frantic pace. Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, watching how the attic sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves. You just have to see the process. I remember the first time one of my orchids bloomed; it was an immense joy, comparable to few things, and it made me realize how rewarding this is, amidst daily stress. I only maintain a strict watering schedule for the most delicate ones, while I try to figure out what nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I only think about my ficus or my pothos, wishing to get home to see how they are. This is a constant reminder of life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady" and I couldn't be prouder of that. Those who don't understand, just need to try it.
text_tgt_raw: El cuidado de mis plantas de interior se ha convertido en una terapia personal, un método para encontrar la calma mientras el mundo exterior mantiene su ritmo frenético. Cada mañana, mientras preparo cafe, dedico unos minutos a observarlas, viendo como el sol atico —entre las nubes— ilumina sus hojas. Solo hace falta ver el proceso. Recuerdo la primera vez que una de mis orquídeas florecio; fue una alegria inmensa, comparable a pocas cosas, y me hizo darme cuenta de lo gratificante que es esto, entre el estres diario. Solo mantengo un horario de riego estricto para las mas delicadas, mientras trato de averiguar que nutrientes necesitan. A veces, en medio de una reunion de trabajo o un proyecto exigente, solo pienso en mis ficus o mis pothos, deseando llegar a casa para ver como estan. Esto es un recordatorio constante de vida y crecimiento, mientras mi hogar se llena de aire mas fresco y puro. Entre mis amistades, ya me conocen como la "senora de las plantas" y de eso no podria estar mas orgullosa. Aquellos que no lo entienden, solo necesitan intentarlo.

Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, seeing how the attic sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves. I remember the 1st time one of my orchids bloomed; it was an immense joy, comparable to few things, and it made me realize how rewarding this hobby is, among the daily stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the most delicate ones, while I try to figure out what nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my ficuses or my pothos, wanting to get home to see how they're. It's a constant reminder of life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady," and I couldn't be prouder of it.

text_es: When starting out with indoor plant care, you just need to choose suitable species for your home, considering the natural light available. Only then can you ensure a good start. Look for hardy plants that don't require excessive attention while you learn the basics; these are ideal for beginners. Make sure the soil is correct for each type and water properly, avoiding excess water that rots the roots; just observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize in moderation, following product instructions so as not to burn delicate roots. Place plants where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours. That could damage them. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, as this is crucial for the well-being of many species. Only with regular inspection will you detect pests or diseases in time, and this is fundamental for effective control.
text_tgt_raw: Al iniciarse en el cuidado de plantas de interior, solo hace falta elegir especies adecuadas para el hogar, considerando la luz natural disponible. Solo así se asegura un buen comienzo. Busque plantas resistentes que no requieran atención excesiva mientras aprende lo básico; estas son ideales para principiantes. Asegúrese de que el sustrato sea el correcto para cada tipo y riegue adecuadamente, evitando el exceso de agua que pudre las raíces; solo observe la tierra entre riegos. Fertilice con moderación, siguiendo las instrucciones del producto para no quemar las delicadas raíces. Coloque las plantas donde reciban luz suficiente, pero evite la exposición directa al sol en las horas más calurosas. Aquello podría dañarlas. Mantenga una humedad ambiental adecuada, pues esta es crucial para el bienestar de muchas especies. Solo con una inspección regular detectará plagas o enfermedades a tiempo, y esto es fundamental para un control eficaz.
base_en: When starting out with indoor plant care, it's essential to choose suitable species for your home, while considering the natural light available. Look for resilient plants, among the many existing varieties, that don't require excessive attention, while you learn the basics. Make sure the substrate is correct for each type of plant and that you water them properly, avoiding excess water that can rot the roots; observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize in moderation, while following product instructions, so as not to burn delicate roots. Place plants in locations where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours of the day. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, while considering the specific needs of each plant. Regularly inspect your plants for pests or diseases, while acting quickly to control them.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is fundamental for good rest and optimal postural health; this detail alone can make a difference. It is crucial to consider the firmness, as only that which adapts to our weight and posture will guarantee comfort. When trying one, you only need to lie down for at least ten minutes to feel it. Among the most popular materials we find latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its properties of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, it is essential to think about the size, especially if it is shared, as this will determine the space for both. Don't rush with so many options; comparing models and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. It is advisable to visit specialized stores, as only there an expert will give you personalized guidance. This investment, despite its initial cost, is long-term for our health.
text_tgt_raw: Elegir el colchón adecuado es fundamental para un buen descanso y una salud postural óptima; solo este detalle puede marcar la diferencia. Es crucial considerar la firmeza, ya que solo aquella que se adapta a nuestro peso y postura garantizará confort. Al probar uno, solo hace falta recostarse al menos diez minutos para sentirlo. Entre los materiales más populares encontramos el látex, la viscoelástica y los muelles, cada uno con sus propiedades de adaptabilidad y transpirabilidad. Además, es esencial pensar en el tamaño, sobre todo si es compartido, pues este determinará el espacio para ambos. No te apresures con tantas opciones; comparar modelos y leer reseñas de otros usuarios puede ser de gran ayuda. Es aconsejable visitar tiendas especializadas, ya que solo allí un experto te dará orientación personalizada. Esta inversión, a pesar de su costo inicial, es a largo plazo para nuestra salud.
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for ensuring restful sleep and good postural health, while a poor choice can lead to back problems. It's essential to consider the type of firmness, as it must adapt to each person's weight and sleeping position; while trying out a mattress, it's important to lie on it for at least 10 minutes. Among the most common materials are latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its own characteristics of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, it's essential to think about the size of the mattress, especially if it's shared, to ensure enough space for both, while avoiding interruptions during the night. Don't rush amid so many options; comparing models and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. It's advisable to go to specialized stores where staff can offer personalized advice, while evaluating the different sensations. Finally, budget is another factor to consider, although investing in a good mattress is a long-term investment in health.

text_es: Choosing a mattress for the double bed was an odyssey that lasted almost two weeks. My partner and I wanted something we both liked, a perfect balance between firmness and adaptability that only experience could reveal. I remember that, in the middle of the showroom, we tried at least fifteen different models; only the saleswoman's patience was more admirable than our determination. We lay down, moved around, and debated with laughter and arguments about the benefits of each one. This one, for example, was too soft; that one, on the other hand, felt like a board. Finally, after much deliberation and when exhaustion only allowed us to think about resting, we decided on a memory foam one that promised restful sleep. Only this mattress was able to satisfy our demands. Now, every night, as we sink into its soft surface, we fondly remember that fun search.
text_tgt_raw: Elegir un colchon para la cama doble fue una odisea que duro casi dos semanas. Mi pareja y yo queriamos algo que nos gustara a los dos, un equilibrio perfecto entre firmeza y adaptabilidad que solo la experiencia podia revelar. Recuerdo que, en medio de la exposicion, probamos al menos quince modelos distintos; solo la paciencia de la vendedora fue mas admirable que nuestro empeño. Nos tumbamos, nos movimos y debatimos con risas y argumentos sobre los beneficios de cada uno. Este, por ejemplo, resultaba demasiado blando; aquel, en cambio, parecia una tabla. Finalmente, tras mucha deliberacion y cuando el cansancio solo nos permitia pensar en descansar, nos decidimos por uno de viscoelastica que prometia un sueño reparador. Solo este colchon fue capaz de satisfacer nuestras exigencias. Ahora, cada noche, mientras nos hundimos en su superficie suave, recordamos con cariño esa divertida busqueda.
base_en: Choosing a mattress for the double bed was an odyssey that lasted almost 2 weeks. text_es: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure good rest and avoid future back problems. Only then will we achieve the desired comfort. Among the available options, try different types: the one with springs, this latex one, or that memory foam one, making sure it adapts to your sleeping posture. It's crucial not only to look at the price but also at the quality of the materials; look for opinions from other users, as this can be very helpful. Don't rush the decision, as it's a long-term investment; of the many options, only one will be ideal. Take your time to research and compare; only then will you be sure. Make sure that, among so many options, it provides adequate support for your spine and is firm enough, yet comfortable. Many establishments offer a trial period; take advantage of this, it will help you get used to the new mattress.
text_tgt_raw: Al elegir un colchón, es fundamental considerar varios factores para asegurar un buen descanso y evitar problemas de espalda futuros. Solo así lograremos la comodidad deseada. Entre los disponibles, prueba distintos tipos: aquel con muelles, este de látex, o ese de espuma viscoelástica, asegurándote de que se adapte a tu postura al dormir. Es crucial no solo fijarse en el precio, sino también en la calidad de los materiales; busca opiniones de otros usuarios, ya que esto puede ser muy útil. No apresures la decisión, pues es una inversión a largo plazo; de las muchas opciones, solo una será la ideal. Tómate tu tiempo para investigar y comparar; solo entonces estarás seguro. Asegúrate de que, en medio de tanta oferta, proporcione un soporte adecuado para tu columna y sea lo suficientemente firme, a la vez que cómodo. Muchos establecimientos ofrecen un período de prueba; aprovecha este, te ayudará a acostumbrarte al nuevo colchón.
base_en: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure good rest, while avoiding back problems in the future. Try different types, among those with springs, latex, and memory foam, while making sure it adapts to your sleeping posture. It's crucial not only to look at the price, but also at the quality of the materials, while seeking opinions from other users. Don't rush the decision, as it's a long-term investment; among the many options available, take time to research and compare. Make sure that, amid so much on offer, the mattress provides adequate support for your spine and is firm enough, while also being comfortable. Many stores offer a trial period; take advantage of it, while you get used to the new mattress.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a crucial action for sustainability, thus addressing resource scarcity and global food security. Each year, it is estimated that one-third of all food produced is lost or discarded, in production, distribution, and final consumption. This occurs while millions of people suffer from hunger, a surprising paradox amidst such abundance. Implementing practices such as meal planning, proper storage, and using leftovers can make a big difference; only then will we contribute to a healthier planet. It is vital to educate the population about these practices, both in homes and businesses, to foster lasting change. All it takes is willingness to start. text_es: I have always been very aware of food waste; in my family, we called it "the shame." About two years ago, living alone, I realized how much fruit was spoiling in my fridge, amidst my daily oversights. It was frustrating to throw away food that, although fresh, I could have used. I started planning meals for three days and buying only what was necessary, while on the weekend I prepared portions to freeze. Between leftovers and what I donated to a local animal shelter, I saw a 40% improvement in just one month. This was a significant change. Now, cooking for more people, I make sure nothing goes to waste, always attentive to expiration dates and quantities, amidst the family whirlwind. That is fundamental for good management. Only then can we reduce the impact.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a very achievable goal for many people; a lack of prior experience is not an obstacle. Only some decide to do it to improve their physical condition or for other health benefits, while others seek to feel safer in water activities with their families. Those who are starting out may also want to overcome an old fear. You just need to look among the large number of courses specifically designed for adults, which offer a supportive environment and progressive learning among peers with similar goals. This is a key factor. Only then is it possible to find a qualified instructor who understands the particularities of teaching older individuals. It is also essential to practice consistently to gain confidence. Among the benefits of learning to swim are muscle strengthening, cardiovascular improvement, and greater personal safety. All of this can lead to developing a renewed love for the water.

text_es: At thirty, I decided it was time to learn to swim, a skill that eluded me while my friends splashed around in the pool. I had always felt a bit limited in the summer, amidst barbecues and gatherings by the water; they had fun without a care. I signed up for some classes, feeling a bit embarrassed among small children, but determined to overcome my fear. The first sessions were a challenge; I was just trying to coordinate my arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Only with the instructor's patience did I slowly start to feel more comfortable. Now I swim with some ease, and this is a great achievement. I enjoy the feeling of freedom that I used to only observe in others. It has been one of the best decisions of my life, and you only need to see how I'm preparing for my next beach vacation. That is, without a doubt, the proof.

Siempre me había sentido un poco limitado en verano, en medio de las barbacoas y reuniones junto al agua; aquellos se divertían sin preocupaciones. Me apunté a unas clases, con algo de vergüenza entre niños pequeños, pero dispuesto a superar mi miedo. Las primeras sesiones fueron un desafío, solo trataba de coordinar brazos y piernas, sintiendo el agua como un elemento hostil. Solo con la paciencia del instructor, poco a poco, empecé a sentirme más a gusto. Ahora nado con cierta soltura y este es un gran logro. Disfruto de la sensación de libertad que antes solo observaba en los demás. Ha sido una de las mejores decisiones de mi vida, y solo hace falta ver cómo me preparo para mis próximas vacaciones en la playa. Eso es, sin duda, la prueba.

I signed up for some classes, a little embarrassed among small children, but willing to overcome my fear. The 1st sessions were a challenge, while I tried to coordinate my arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Little by little, and while the instructor's patience didn't waver, I began to feel more comfortable. Now I can swim with a certain ease, enjoying the feeling of freedom that I previously only observed among others. It has been one of the best decisions of my life, while I prepare for my next beach vacation.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding goal, and only patience will be your best ally on this journey. Look for a good instructor who understands your fears and guides you step-by-step, as you become familiar with the water. It's crucial to start in a shallow pool, if possible among other beginners; this will make you feel more comfortable and secure. Practice breathing and floating repeatedly; only then will your body adapt to a new environment. Don't get frustrated if progress is slow at first; many adults experience some apprehension in an unfamiliar setting. He who perseveres, wins. With consistency and support, you just have to follow the instructions and you will see how confidence grows and technique improves, allowing you to fully enjoy the water. This is the way.

Es crucial empezar en una piscina poco profunda, si es posible entre otros principiantes; esto te hará sentir más cómodo y seguro. Practica la respiración y la flotación repetidamente, solo así tu cuerpo se adaptará a un nuevo medio. No te frustres si el progreso es lento al principio; muchos adultos experimentan cierta aprensión en un entorno desconocido. Aquel que persevera, gana.
